jobs.title: Field Services Technician
jobs.description:
The Field Service Technician is responsible for carrying out services and maintenance at Customer Installations and where applicable as well for assembly and dismantling.
Will maintain, repair and perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance of Air Liquide installations (PG,Cryo, bulk & On Sites) and equipment at customer sites within the assigned budget.
He/She executes the maintenance work according to procedures and standards. After each work execution, the technician manages his intervention report signed by the customers and communicates with the Maintenance Planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data.
Provide On-site support for testing, and troubleshooting.
He/she provides a high level of quality of service to customers in the assigned area and ensures legal and IMS compliance.
He/she implements the environmental legislation, works in line with the ISO 14001 standard, , respects the good environmental practices and shows a positive attitude with regard to the preservation of the environment

Performs preventive & corrective maintenance

  • Executes preventive maintenance according to planning, with sub-contractor if required.
  • Performs the all kind of maintenance work on PG, Bulk & On Sites according procedure and standard
  • Contact the maintenance planners if corrective maintenance is required.
  • Prepares reports and obtains the customer signature on maintenance intervention report.
  • Confirms data in SAP (kilometers-time-spare parts used-cause of failure...)

Repairs and troubleshooting of equipment failures

  • The FST will execute the intervention once the work is confirmed by the maintenance planner and spare parts are available.
  • Will analyzes and identifies malfunctions as well determines the necessary repairs, and carries them out (with subcontractor if applicable).
  • Will communicate the spare parts used and obtain the intervention report signed by the customer.

Ensures all quality & safety procedures are followed

  • Understands and adheres to all relevant IMS procedures within the scope of their qualifications
  • Ensures Compliances and applies IMS and legal rules.
  • Knows and respects the country SOPs and standards

Reports accurate and up-to-date maintenance information

  • Communicates with the Maintenance planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data.
  • Confirms completion of work after site visit
  • Writes consolidated reports on quality defects and customer complaints

Communicates potential problems that may affect safety, reliability & quality

  • Identifies through experience and troubleshooting analysis the dysfunctionment of gas equipments
  • Observes work area(s) and is alert to and avoids unsafe behaviors and conditions or other hazards
  • Participates in corrective measures when appropriate or authorized

Face to face with the customers & internal sales force

  • Communicates professionally and respectfully with customers.
  • Supports the project team with assembly and dismantling if applicable, as well as new or retrofit PG, Bulk, on Site, cryo or MGPS projects.
  • Respects and promotes the Zero safety incident goal
  • Ensure operational readiness of service vehicles, PPE, tools, and work equipment.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of normal business hours

Experience

  • Good troubleshooting skills
  • Good understanding of operations & safety procedures
  • Capable to analyse trends, problems & cause-effects
  • Understanding of procedures and regulatory for new and existing industrial installations
  • Good knowledge maintenance activities
  • Technical understanding of gas physical and production processes
  • Good understanding of Safety procedures

Competencies:

Hard skills:

  • Language proficiency
  • Fluent in Dutch
  • Pre-intermediate English
  • Maintenance tools & methods (SAP)
  • IMS
  • Google tools
  • Telemetry applications
  • Mechanical and /or electrical and / or automation knowledge

Soft skills :

  • Promoting and supporting actions towards Safety, Health and environment protection
  • Encourages questioning of established ideas and practices and ask why regularly and provide deliverables on time
  • Good communication with the different stakeholders
  • Customer mindset & team player
  • Team player
  • Striving for continuous improvement

jobs.title: Daglig leder
jobs.description:
Vi søker en leder som gjør en forskjell

Vi søker en daglig leder som setter barnets beste først, omsetter strategi til handling og bygger en kultur preget av mot, nysgjerrighet og utvikling.

Vi vet at de første årene i et barns liv har stor betydning. Derfor søker vi deg som hver dag skaper de beste forutsetningene for barns lek, læring og utvikling gjennom høy kvalitet, sterke fagmiljøer og godt samarbeid med foresatte og samarbeidspartnere.

Vi søker en leder som skaper retning, tar beslutninger og følger opp slik at strategier blir til handling og kvalitet blir en naturlig del av hverdagen.

Om Norlandia Barnehagene

Hos oss blir du en del av Norlandia Barnehagene, en av Norges ledende barnehageorganisasjoner med høye ambisjoner på barnas vegne.

Vi utvikler kvalitet gjennom forskning, systematisk kvalitetsarbeid, kompetanseutvikling og implementering av beste praksis. Vi tror at høy kvalitet skapes når dyktige medarbeidere får utvikle seg sammen, deler kunnskap og bygger en kultur preget av læring og refleksjon.

CLASS er en sentral del av kvalitetsarbeidet vårt. Som daglig leder får du opplæring og sertifisering i CLASS, og blir en viktig pådriver for å utvikle kvaliteten i samspillet mellom barn og voksne.

Vi tror at gode ledere utvikles sammen med andre. Derfor deler vi kunnskap og erfaringer på tvers av barnehager over hele landet, fordi vi vet at de beste løsningene skapes når vi lærer av hverandre.

Et sterkt lederfellesskap

Som daglig leder står du ikke alene.

Du blir en del av et regionalt lederfellesskap med daglige ledere fra 37 Norlandia-barnehager. Sammen utvikler vi kvalitet, deler erfaringer og støtter hverandre i lederrollen.

Alle daglige ledere inngår i faste lederteam med 4–6 kolleger. Lederteamene er arenaer for refleksjon, støtte og utvikling, hvor dere deler erfaringer, utfordrer hverandre og lærer sammen.

Hver måned deltar lederteamene i scalacoaching. Gjennom gode spørsmål, refleksjon og erfaringsdeling utvikler vi lederpraksis, handlingskompetanse og kvalitet sammen.

Om Norlandia Skogstunet

Norlandia Skogstunet ligger i naturskjønne omgivelser på Strusshamn i Askøy kommune. Barnehagen har 114 barn fordelt på seks avdelinger og rundt 30 medarbeidere.

Skogstunet har et stort og variert uteområde med kupert skogsterreng, lavvo, gapahuk og gode muligheter for lek, utforsking og fysisk aktivitet. Naturen er en viktig del av barnas hverdag, og vi ønsker å gi barna gode opplevelser og erfaringer ute gjennom hele året.

Hos oss setter vi barnets beste først. Vi legger stor vekt på lek, gode relasjoner, trygghet og fysisk aktivitet. Gjennom Jump legger vi til rette for daglig fysisk aktivitet, samtidig som vi bruker naturen aktivt til utforsking, undring og læring. Bærekraft og respekt for naturen er også en naturlig del av det pedagogiske arbeidet.

Skogstunet er en fullkostbarnehage med egen matansvarlig, og gode måltider og matopplevelser er en viktig del av hverdagen.

Vi er stolte av et stort og kompetent fagmiljø med medarbeidere som hver dag arbeider for å skape gode opplevelser og utviklingsmuligheter for barna. Vi søker en leder som ønsker å bygge videre på dette fundamentet, samtidig som du skaper ny utvikling sammen med medarbeiderne.

Om stillingen

Dette er en 100 % stilling som daglig leder med det overordnede ansvaret for kvalitet, medarbeidere, drift og resultater.

Du leder utviklingen av barnehagen i tråd med Norlandias strategi og verdier. Du skaper retning gjennom tydelig ledelse, bygger en kultur preget av tillit, mot og utvikling, og legger til rette for at medarbeiderne lykkes sammen.

Vi søker en leder som er tett på praksis, nysgjerrig på egen lederrolle og som bruker observasjon, refleksjon og dialog som grunnlag for utvikling og gode beslutninger.

Hovedansvarsområder

  • Lede og videreutvikle barnehagen i tråd med Norlandias strategi, verdier og kvalitets- og miljøpolicy.

  • Sikre høy pedagogisk kvalitet gjennom systematisk kvalitetsarbeid og forskningsbaserte metoder.

  • Lede barnehagens pedagogiske utviklingsarbeid gjennom observasjon, refleksjon og bruk av CLASS.

  • Sikre god økonomistyring og bærekraftig drift.

  • Ha personalansvar, inkludert veiledning, oppfølging og kompetanseutvikling.

  • Bidra aktivt i Norlandias utviklings- og strategiarbeid.

  • Videreutvikle et godt samarbeid med foresatte og samarbeidspartnere.

Vi søker deg som

  • Har barnehagelærerutdanning og gjerne ledererfaring.

  • Setter barnets beste først og har høye ambisjoner på barnas vegne.

  • Har mot til å ta beslutninger og stå i dem.

  • Skaper retning og følger opp slik at planer blir til handling.

  • Bygger sterke team og en kultur preget av tillit, læring og samarbeid.

  • Er nysgjerrig på egen lederpraksis og ønsker kontinuerlig utvikling.

  • Har god økonomiforståelse og evner å lede en bærekraftig drift.

  • Er strukturert, beslutningsdyktig og god til å prioritere.

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull lederrolle med stor mulighet til å påvirke barns hverdag.

  • Et av Norges ledende fagmiljøer innen barnehage.

  • Opplæring og sertifisering i CLASS.

  • Et sterkt nasjonalt og regionalt fagfellesskap der kunnskap og erfaring deles på tvers av barnehager.

  • Et fast lederteam med 4–6 kolleger og månedlig scalacoaching.

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og pensjonsordninger, inkludert AFP i privat sektor.

  • Bedriftsavtale med SATS og tilgang til Visma fordelsprogram.

Vil du være med og gjøre en forskjell?

Hos oss får du muligheten til å lede en stor barnehage med høye ambisjoner på barnas vegne. Du blir en del av et sterkt fag- og lederfellesskap som utfordrer, støtter og inspirerer hverandre, og som hver dag arbeider for å gi barn den beste starten på livet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Norlandia Barnehagene er vårt mål er at alle barn skal ha et likeverdig tilbud og gå i en høykvalitetsbarnehage. Nøkkelen til det er kompetente ansatte som er omsorgsfulle og utviklingsorienterte, derfor deler vi kunnskap med hverandre og er stolte av arbeidsplassen vår.

Vi baserer vårt arbeid på kunnskap og innovasjon, som omhandler at vår praksis utvikler seg i tråd med ny forskning og erfaring. God ledelse, felles kultur og standard, samt et rikt leke- og læringsmiljø er viktig for barna, og for oss.

Derfor har vi valgt ut noen felles satsningsområder som vi vet har stor betydning for barns utvikling og progresjon. Vi jobber helthetlig og systematisk med intern kompetanseutvikling og ekstern barnehagevurdering med blant annet CLASS som verktøy.

jobs.title: Embedded-utvecklare inom försvarsindustrin
jobs.description:
Vill du utveckla robusta C++-system för Sveriges försvar och totalförsvar? Här kombinerar du teknisk spets med AI-assisterade arbetssätt i långsiktiga projekt.

Tillsammans med ledande aktörer inom svensk och europeisk försvarsindustri utvecklar du säkra och tillförlitliga system för bland annat kommunikation, ledningsstöd och sensorer. Uppdragen präglas av höga krav på cybersäkerhet, realtidsprestanda, kvalitet och spårbarhet.

Du följer utvecklingen genom hela livscykeln och får möjlighet att påverka teknikval och arkitektur i tekniskt komplexa projekt. Arbetet omfattar bland annat att:

    

designa, implementera och underhålla programvara i C++

    

utveckla robusta lösningar för inbyggda system eller realtidssystem

    

arbeta med utveckling och felsökning i Linux-miljö

    

genomföra testning, verifiering och teknisk dokumentation

    

utforska hur AI-assisterade verktyg kan användas inom utveckling, analys, testning och dokumentation

Du behöver inte vara AI-specialist. Däremot ser vi gärna att du är nyfiken på nya verktyg och vill bidra till att utveckla hur teamet arbetar med modern mjukvaruutveckling.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

    

minst fem års erfarenhet av utveckling i C++, gärna inom inbyggda system eller realtidssystem

    

god vana av att arbeta i Linux-miljö

    

erfarenhet av end-to-end-utveckling, från design och implementation till test, verifiering och dokumentation

    

erfarenhet av att utveckla robusta lösningar i tekniskt komplexa miljöer

    

svenskt medborgarskap och möjlighet att genomföra och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll

    

god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet från försvarssektorn eller har arbetat med Ada. Erfarenhet av enhets-, integrations- och systemtestning är också relevant, liksom arbete med kravframtagning, kravanalys, modellbaserad utveckling eller systemarbete.

Vad får du hos oss?

Du får arbeta med avancerade systemlösningar i långsiktiga projekt, ofta tillsammans med våra samarbetspartner inom försvar, rymd och säkerhet. Här finns utrymme att påverka tekniska beslut och utveckla både din specialistkompetens och dina arbetssätt.

Moderna AI-drivna verktyg är en del av arbetet med att stärka kvalitet, effektivitet och innovation. Din individuella utvecklingsplan kan därför omfatta AI, moderna utvecklingsmetoder och framtidens ingenjörsverktyg.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat och lösningsorienterat team där lärande och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Tech-forum, workshops, lunch & learns, gemensamma resor och afterworks ger fler tillfällen att utvecklas och lära känna kollegorna.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan. Tjänsten kräver svenskt medborgarskap samt att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.

Om Knowit

Jobba hos oss på Knowit Connectivity, där vi arbetar med tekniskt avancerade system inom embedded och uppkopplade lösningar. Hos oss får du arbeta med komplexa produkter tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer i uppdrag som ligger i teknisk framkant.

Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.

Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

jobs.title: AI Harness Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Harness Engineer based in United Kingdom.

As an AI Harness Engineer, you will build the systems and integrations that connect people with powerful local AI capabilities. You’ll work at the intersection of AI tooling, agent infrastructure, and peer-to-peer technology, helping create scalable experiences for the next generation of AI assistants. Your work will include developing reusable tools and modules, supporting diverse AI model types and sizes, and building reliable systems for non-deterministic environments. You’ll contribute to the evolution of P2P technology designed to enable local AI at scale. The role combines deep software engineering with experimentation and rapid technical exploration. You’ll join a remote, globally distributed environment where autonomy, technical curiosity, and continuous innovation are highly valued.


Accountabilities
  • Build and deliver new features and bug fixes with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and user satisfaction.
  • Design and develop reusable tools, modules, and integrations that enable new AI capabilities across different model types and sizes.
  • Build and maintain AI agent harnesses, including tool calling, agent loops, context management, and structured outputs.
  • Develop evaluation frameworks and testing infrastructure for AI systems with non-deterministic behavior.
  • Implement and evolve peer-to-peer technology to support local AI and distributed use cases.
  • Maintain a high-quality codebase through consistent coding standards, code reviews, modular architecture, and automated testing.
  • Design systems that can reliably handle failures such as network partitions, model errors, timeouts, and retries.
  • Develop and maintain reusable npm modules and shared software components.
  • Experiment with new technologies and approaches to continuously expand AI and P2P capabilities.
  • Collaborate effectively with a globally distributed engineering team while communicating technical ideas clearly.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software.
    • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, including experience modeling complex state across synchronization protocols, agent loops, or similar systems.
    • Strong ability to write modular, maintainable, and reusable code.
    • Hands-on experience building AI agent harnesses, including tool calling, context management, agent loops, and structured outputs.
    • Experience developing evaluation systems and test infrastructure for non-deterministic AI or other complex systems.
    • Experience creating and managing reusable npm modules.
    • Strong testing and debugging skills, with a focus on reliability and production quality.
    • Strong understanding of and practical experience developing and using AI tools.
    • Deep interest or professional experience with peer-to-peer technologies, networking, or distributed systems.
    • Experience designing resilient systems that account for network failures, model errors, timeouts, retries, and other failure scenarios.
    • Contributions to open-source projects related to P2P, networking, AI tooling, or adjacent technologies are valued.
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment.
    • A highly experimental, hands-on mindset with a willingness to continuously test ideas, explore emerging technologies, and solve challenging technical problems.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Opportunity to work on emerging AI, agent infrastructure, and peer-to-peer technologies.
      • Exposure to complex distributed systems and non-deterministic AI applications.
      • Opportunity to contribute to open-source P2P, networking, and AI tooling ecosystems.
      • International and globally distributed engineering environment.
      • High degree of autonomy and room for experimentation and technical innovation.

jobs.title: Truckförare | Lernia | Vimmerby
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren truckförare som söker nya utmaningar? Vi söker nu en engagerad och ansvarstagande truckförare till ett ledande industriföretag i Vimmerby. Här får du en viktig roll i den dagliga logistiken och möjlighet att arbeta i en modern produktionsmiljö. Låter det intressant? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

Om tjänsten

    

Placeringsort: Vimmerby

    

Arbetstider: Dagtid

    

Anställningsform: Visstidsanställning (heltid)

    

Tillträde: Omgående / enligt överenskommelse

Som truckförare hos vår kund i Vimmerby blir du en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten där du ansvarar för att material och produkter hanteras säkert, effektivt och med hög kvalitet. Rollen innebär främst truckkörning i produktions- och lagermiljö, där du arbetar med att förse verksamheten med material, lasta och lossa gods samt säkerställa att flödet fungerar smidigt genom hela processen. Du samarbetar tätt med kollegor inom produktion och logistik och bidrar till att skapa en säker, välorganiserad och effektiv arbetsplats. Här får du arbeta i en varierad roll där noggrannhet, ansvarstagande och ett gott säkerhetstänk är avgörande för att lyckas.

Om dig

Som person är du noggrann, ansvarstagande och strukturerad, med förmåga att hålla fokus även i ett högt tempo. Du arbetar metodiskt, löser problem på ett lugnt och genomtänkt sätt och tvekar inte att ställa frågor när det behövs. Du trivs i en miljö där kvalitet, säkerhet och samarbete står i centrum, och du bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat genom att vara hjälpsam, kommunikativ och lätt att samarbeta med.

Formell kompetens

    

Körkort B & tillgång till bil

    

Goda kunskaper i svenska

    

Truckkort A1-4 B1-4 (särskilt A2 och B1  är ett krav för tjänsten) och erfarenhet av att köra olika truckar, särskilt motviktstruck.

Meriterande

    

Tidigare erfarenhet som truckförare inom tillverkningsindustri, verkstad eller produktion.

Som en av oss

Som anställd bemanningskonsult hos oss får du alltid en marknadsmässig lön, semester, pensionsavsättning, försäkringar och anslutning till vårt kollektivavtal. Vi vill att du ska må bra hos oss så självklart erbjuder vi våra konsulter friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Under din anställning har du en konsultchef som ansvarar för ditt uppdrag, stöttar och utvecklar dig i din yrkesroll och ser till att du trivs på din arbetsplats.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på lång och kort sikt.

Hur du söker tjänsten

För att söka tjänsten, scrolla ner till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Om du har några frågor eller funderingar, vänligen kontakta oss via e-post på bemanning.vimmerby@lernia.se. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Bakgrundskontroll

För vissa tjänster ingår bakgrundskontroll som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Om du går vidare i processen kommer du att behöva verifiera din identitet via BankID innan kontrollen genomförs.

jobs.title: Er du den nye nattvakten ved Narvesen Storgt. 67, Tromsø?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en selger på deltid som trives med kundekontakt, liker å jobbe bak kassa og brenner for å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder. Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å bidra til et entusiastisk og godt arbeidsmiljø. Som selger hos Narvesen vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, en hektisk og spennende arbeidshverdag og gode kolleger som fort kan bli venner for livet.

Vi søker to personer som kan jobbe natt, både i helgene og på ukedager.

Nattvakt i helg (30% stilling):

  • Natt til lørdag og natt til søndag annenhver helg

  • Arbeidstid: kl. 00:00–08:00

Nattvakt på ukedager (40& stilling):

  • To netter i uken

  • Arbeidstid: kl. 23:30–07:30

Uavhengig av om du jobber helg eller ukedager, vil arbeidsoppgavene blant annet bestå av tilberedning og salg av mat og drikke, kundebehandling og kassaarbeid, varepåfylling, renhold og rydding samt å sørge for at butikken er innbydende og klar for kundene. Stillingen passer perfekt for deg som ønsker en ekstrajobb ved siden av studiene, og som trives med å jobbe selvstendig i et hektisk miljø. Merk at nattvakt på ukedager er en sesongbassert stilling og opphører 31.03.2026.

Vi følger Landsoverenskomstens tariffavtale. Har du studiekompetanse kan du forvente timelønn på 197,96kr, samt ett nattillegg på 115kr pr. time.

 

Vi søker hovedsaklig personer over 20 år. Søkere under 18år vil ikke bli vurdert til stillingen.   This position is also available if you do not speak Norwegian, applicants with the right qualifications may be considered.     Hvem er du?
Kanskje du har butikkerfaring, eller du er klar for din første jobb i butikk? Uansett kan du være den riktige for jobben, så lenge du er
  • Effektiv. Du takler stress godt, og liker høyt tempo
  • Selvstendig. Du trives med å ha ansvar, og finner lett egne løsninger
  • Glad i mennesker. Du får påfyll i møte med kundene, og bryr deg om hver eneste en
  • Et ordensmenneske. Du liker å ha det rent og ryddig rundt deg
  • Positiv. Du er en humørspreder – blant kolleger så vel som kunder
  • Tilgjengelig. Du er fleksibel i forhold til arbeidsoppgaver og arbeidstid.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Verdifull erfaring innen salg og teamarbeid som du kan dra nytte av hele yrkeslivet
  • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter. Vi ser positivt på ansvar og interne karriereveier, og mulighetene er mange for deg som ønsker en karriere innen convenience. Mange av oss har gått stegene fra selger til butikksjef eller kjøpmann
  • Trivelig arbeidsmiljø med verdens beste kunder og kollegaer
  • Nært samarbeid med butikkleder og resten av teamet
  • Grundig opplæring og trygghet i arbeidsoppgavene
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Som en del av Reitan Convenience har vi alltid vært opptatt av å bygge en vennlig kultur. Ditt gode humør smitter over på kundene, og vi vet at når de er glade og fornøyde vender de også tilbake. Ja, Narvesen stiller krav til deg som selger, men vi vil også at du skal ha høye forventninger til oss.

Ble du litt nysgjerrig nå? Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

 


Narvesen er den originale kiosken i Norge. Vi har vært en del av hverdagen til det norske folk siden 1894. I dag er vi en fleksibel, smidig og fremoverlent convenience-kjede som leder utviklingen fremover med stadig nye tanker, ideer og løsninger. Vi er der for dem som raskt og enkelt ønsker å forenkle hverdagen på en måte som gir god samvittighet. Våre kunder er på farten, og vi skal hjelpe dem med påfyll i en ellers så travel hverdag. Narvesen er en del av Reitan Convenience Norway.

Many assignments involve AUTOSAR and ASPICE, where traceability, testing, and structured quality processes are integral to development.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

    

several years of experience in embedded software development or automotive software

    

solid knowledge of C and C++

    

a strong understanding of embedded systems and low-level behavior

    

experience working with RTOS, Linux, QNX, or a similar environment

    

the ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across software, systems, testing, and hardware disciplines

Preferred qualifications

Experience with AUTOSAR, ASPICE, automotive communication protocols, or tools from Vector is valuable. Knowledge of Rust is also a plus.

Fluency in Swedish is beneficial for some assignments.

What can you expect from us?

You will work on technically challenging assignments that allow you to deepen your expertise, influence technical direction, and continue growing as an engineer. Rather than working alone in customer projects, you will have opportunities to join teams with experienced colleagues in embedded and automotive systems.

A close local team provides day-to-day support and knowledge sharing, while Knowit’s broader network connects you with expertise across technologies and industries.

Application

Let’s start a conversation. We would be happy to tell you more about our projects, how we work, and what you would like to take on next.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

jobs.title: Senior Embeddedutvecklare
jobs.description:
Vill du påverka hur tekniskt avancerade embedded-system byggs? Som senior embeddedutvecklare i Lund arbetar du nära både mjukvara och hårdvara i långsiktiga uppdrag.

Du arbetar med system där prestanda, timing och tillförlitlighet är avgörande. Rollen kombinerar praktisk implementation med tekniska beslut om hur lösningarna ska utformas och utvecklas över tid.

En del av uppdragen bedrivs som extended R&D, där team från Knowit ansvarar för en funktion eller en avgränsad del av utvecklingen. Det ger dig möjlighet att följa samma system under längre tid, påverka tekniska vägval och se resultatet av arbetet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat innebära att:

    

utveckla och optimera embedded-programvara i C och C++

    

arbeta nära operativsystem som Embedded Linux eller RTOS

    

felsöka system där timing, resurser och beteenden är kritiska

    

bidra till designval och tekniska avvägningar i komplexa system

    

samarbeta med systemingenjörer, testare och hårdvaruteam

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

    

flera års praktisk erfarenhet av embeddedutveckling

    

goda kunskaper i C och C++

    

erfarenhet av Embedded Linux och/eller RTOS

    

vana att arbeta nära hårdvara och förstå samspelet mellan mjukvara och system

Din förmåga att förstå komplexa system, väga olika tekniska alternativ och arbeta metodiskt med problem över tid är viktigare än erfarenhet av en specifik teknisk plattform.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har utvecklat system med höga krav på prestanda, tillförlitlighet eller lång livslängd.

Vad får du hos oss?

Du får arbeta med tekniskt komplexa embedded-system och bidra till hur lösningarna byggs, inte enbart implementera enskilda delar utifrån en färdig specifikation. Uppdragen ger utrymme för långsiktighet, tekniskt inflytande och nära samarbete med andra kompetenser.

Arbetssättet kombinerar variationen mellan olika uppdrag med stabiliteten i att ingå i ett team där ni tar ett gemensamt ansvar för utvecklingen.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan. Vi ser fram emot att få veta mer om din erfarenhet av embeddedutveckling och vad du vill arbeta med framöver.

Om Knowit

Jobba hos oss på Knowit Connectivity, där vi arbetar med tekniskt avancerade system inom embedded och uppkopplade lösningar. Hos oss får du arbeta med komplexa produkter tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer i uppdrag som ligger i teknisk framkant.

Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.

Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive
jobs.description:
Senior Sales Executive

Location: London, UK

Reporting to: Head of Inbound Sales

Love the thrill of matching clients with the perfect space and want to take your sales career to the next level? We're looking for a motivated, results-driven Senior Sales Executive to join our London Sales team. In this role, you'll be the critical first point of contact for incoming enquiries—qualifying exciting opportunities, owning the end-to-end sales process for mid-sized events, and partnering with our Senior Account Managers on major global accounts. If you have 1–3 years of commercial experience, a sharp business mind, and a passion for premium hospitality, we want to hear from you!

We're Here For You:

At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect:

Health & Wellness: Private medical insurance, subsidised fitness and eye care, plus well-being and personal support programs. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work.
Time Off & Balance: 25 days annual leave, bank holidays, and company sick pay.
Financial Benefits: Bonus scheme, interest-free loans for rail travel or further education, and a Cycle to Work program. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally.
Growth & Recognition: Career development opportunities and programs to celebrate your achievements.
Community & Impact: Volunteer, donate, and make a real impact through your work.
 

What You'll Do: 
- Lead Qualification & Opportunity Management: Manage a high volume of inbound enquiries across Senior Account Manager owned and target accounts via telephone, email, and e-RFP channels. Qualify opportunities against client requirements ensuring a timely and professional response. - Perform rigorous qualification to ensure alignment with Convene Hospitality Group's physical and hybrid product solutions.
- Revenue Generation: Own the end-to-end sales process for event enquiries of up to 50 attendees within assigned owned and targeted accounts. Develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms where appropriate, and convert opportunities in line with individual and team revenue objectives.
- Account Support & Opportunity Development: Partner closely with Senior Account Managers to identify growth opportunities within existing client accounts. Ensure strategic opportunities are efficiently qualified, documented, and transitioned to the appropriate account owner while maintaining a seamless client experience.
- Site Visits & Client Engagement: Conduct professional site visits for small group opportunities and support Senior Account Managers with site inspections, client presentations, and account-specific initiatives for larger programmes and strategic accounts where needed. 
- CRM Management & Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities, client interactions, and opportunities within Salesforce and HubSpot. Ensure data integrity to support forecasting, pipeline management, performance reporting, and strategic decision-making.
- Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively participate in sales meetings, pipeline reviews, and commercial planning sessions. Gather and share client feedback, market trends, and competitive insights to help refine sales strategies and improve overall performance.
- Operational & Administrative Support: Provide proactive administrative and operational support to the Senior Account Manager team, assisting with proposals, client communications, reporting, and account management activities to maximise team effectiveness and revenue generation.

What We're Looking For: 
- 1–3 years' experience in a sales, business development, venue sales, hospitality, events, or customer-facing commercial environment.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering against performance targets.
Technical Skills
- Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications.
Industry Knowledge
- Experience within events, hospitality, commercial real estate, flexible workspace, or related industries is highly desirable.
- Understanding of corporate event planning and venue sales is advantageous.
Key Competencies
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
- Commercially minded with a proactive approach to identifying sales opportunities.
- Ability to build relationships and establish credibility with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate data and reporting.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Collaborative team player with a customer-first mindset.

Success Measures
- Achievement of individual revenue and conversion targets.
- Speed and quality of lead qualification and response times.
- Growth of revenue from Senior Account Manager-owned & targeted accounts through effective opportunity management.
- Accuracy and completeness of Salesforce and HubSpot records.
- Quality of handover and support provided to Senior Account Managers.
- Positive client feedback and contribution to account retention and growth.

At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team.

Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Commercial Manager, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain

We're looking for a Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain to join our team. This is a global role spanning the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem, with Deliveroo as the hiring entity. This is a hybrid role based in our London office.

In this role, you'll help shape what our global supply chain looks like as DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt increasingly act as one unified company — building a highly efficient commercial approach to how physical goods, logistics, and courier equipment move across our operations worldwide. Rather than three brands running separate playbooks, you'll help design the single commercial model that brings them together, turning fragmented regional practices into one coherent, scalable supply chain.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Global Supply Chain team, responsible for getting physical goods—courier apparel, equipment, in-store technology, and consumables—to our riders, merchants, and partners across every market. Sitting underneath the Senior Commercial Manager, you will build and execute sourcing strategies, lead complex international negotiations, and manage supplier performance across the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem.

 

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 

Sourcing Strategy & Execution

  • Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.

     

  • Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing events, utilizing spend analytics, market intelligence, and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling to secure optimal commercial outcomes.

     

  • Build and execute robust negotiation positions, focusing on unit cost, freight, duty, quality protections, and working capital impact.

     

Contract & Supplier Management

jobs.title: Raw Materials Specialist
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

The future is here. At Volvo Group, we are taking the knowledge from building vehicles, automotive systems and creating new technology that will not only make our cities less noisy and polluted, but also change the world of construction forever. If you would like to be part of this change journey, we would like you to join us. Read on…

This is us, your new colleagues

We are part of business controlling at Volvo Trucks Technology and Industrial. We develop and deploy raw material market expertise, tools, methods, and governance. These enable the Volvo Group to secure and enhance its raw material-related performance and thus provide a competitive advantage to its brands.

Our team is globally spread across Asia, Europe and the Americas and is considered a center of excellence on raw material (commodity) markets. As part of our scope today, we cover various materials like flat steel, ferrous castings, forging steel, base metals, precious metals, plastics, rubber, battery materials, energy etc. Our expertise is used to support and ensure Volvo Group’s competitiveness and eventually our customers’ success. Working together in a global team is a great opportunity for some interesting cross-cultural experiences.

What you will do ?

Now, we have an opening and are looking for a person to join our team of commodity market analysts for battery materials & base metals. This position is to be the knowledge center on the raw material market for battery materials and base metals across our major geographies i.e., Europe & Americas primarily but also Asia.  

As part of the job, you will consolidate and use all internal and external business intelligence available to understand the position/influence of different related factors in the commodity market. Based on identified, reliable business intelligence you will provide periodic market forecasts. You will on a regular basis support buyers in negotiation, participate in cost workshops, supply chain activities, and provide contractual guidance to the Volvo Group Purchasing organization. Keeping sustainability in perspective on these commodities, is key. You will contribute as needed to the segment strategies within Trucks Technology and Industrial and you will work closely with the Purchasing team.

In this position you will be part of the raw material business controlling team and report to the head of raw material.  

Who are you ?

We believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference within our organization. We are looking for a person who understands that the key to success is curiosity. A person who is able to look at the bigger picture, as well as go down in details when needed. To be successful in this position you need to have/build solid business acumen together with cross-functional networking agility. Teamwork, collaboration & cross-cultural sensitivity are key to succeed in this position. As we are a global and diverse team, all our meetings and e-mails will be in English, hence you need to be fluent in both speaking and writing in English.  

To be successful in your new role it’d be helpful if you had the following knowledge/experience:

    University/Master’s degree in science, engineering, economics or finance
    Analytical & critical thinking
    Ability to work efficiently independently as well as in a team
    Commodity market knowledge/experience in battery materials/base metals



Are we a perfect match?

We can’t promise you an effortless job, but what we can promise you are some skilled colleagues and truly exciting challenges to work with. You will work in a global environment that provides you with developmental opportunities both professionally and personally. We at Volvo Group want you to prosper and be happy, because when you succeed, we succeed. Together we drive prosperity. We are eager to learn from you and you will get fantastic opportunities to learn and develop with us.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.title: Evner du å kombinere elkraftkompetanse med kundedialog og teknisk salg?
jobs.description:
Priess Norway styrker laget og søker en teknisk selger som vil være med på å utvikle gode løsninger for fremtidens kraftdistribusjon.

Elektrifiseringen av samfunnet stiller stadig større krav til kapasitet, driftssikkerhet og smarte løsninger i strømnettet. For Priess betyr det økende aktivitet og behov for flere dyktige fagfolk som forstår både teknologien og kundenes behov.

Nå søker vi en Teknisk Selger - Nettstasjoner som skal jobbe tett med kunder, prosjektmiljø og leverandører for å utvikle og tilby komplette løsninger innen nettstasjoner og distribusjonsanlegg.

Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som har bakgrunn fra elektro, energi eller elkraft og som liker å bruke fagkompetansen din i møte med kunder. Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å komme fra en rendyrket salgsrolle – det viktigste er at du forstår teknikken, kommuniserer godt og motiveres av å finne gode løsninger sammen med kunden.

Fra kundebehov til ferdig løsning

Som teknisk selger får du en sentral rolle tidlig i kundens prosjekter. Du skal forstå behovet, se hvilke løsninger som er mulige og bidra til å sette sammen et tilbud som fungerer både teknisk og kommersielt.

Løsningene kan blant annet omfatte mellomspenningsanlegg, lavspenningsanlegg, transformatorer og systemer for overvåkning og kontroll.

Du blir en viktig faglig sparringspartner for kundene og samarbeider tett med kolleger innen prosjekt og engineering, samt med Priess' leverandører og samarbeidspartnere.

Du får blant annet ansvar for å:
  • kartlegge kundens behov og omsette disse til gode tekniske løsninger
  • dimensjonere og sette sammen løsninger for nettstasjoner og tilhørende systemer
  • utarbeide kalkyler, tilbud og teknisk dokumentasjon
  • følge opp tilbud og kunder gjennom salgsprosessen
  • gi teknisk rådgivning og være en faglig sparringspartner for kundene
  • samarbeide tett med prosjektledere, engineering, produksjon og leverandører
  • bidra til at løsningene tilfredsstiller relevante forskrifter, normer og standarder
  • følge utviklingen i markedet og bidra med innspill til videreutvikling av Priess' produkter og løsninger
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har teknisk utdanning innen elektro, energi, elkraft, e-verk, automasjon eller tilsvarende, enten fra teknisk fagskole, høyskole eller universitet.

Du kan allerede ha erfaring med nettstasjoner, distribusjonsnett, tavler, transformatorer eller andre deler av elkraftbransjen. Kanskje arbeider du i dag hos et nettselskap, en entreprenør, leverandør, rådgiver eller i en teknisk prosjektorganisasjon – og ønsker å komme nærmere kundene og den kommersielle siden av virksomheten.

Erfaring med teknisk salg eller tilbudsarbeid er en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav. Relevant fagkompetanse og evnen til å forstå helheten i en teknisk løsning kan være minst like viktig.

Vi ser gjerne at du har:

  • relevant teknisk utdanning
  • god forståelse for elektriske anlegg og tekniske løsninger
  • kjennskap til relevante forskrifter, normer og standarder
  • interesse for kundedialog, salg og kommersielle problemstillinger
  • gode IT-kunnskaper og erfaring med Office, ERP-systemer og tekniske dokumentasjonssystemer
  • gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig
Teknisk nysgjerrig og god med mennesker

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi du både liker å fordype deg i tekniske problemstillinger og å samarbeide med mennesker.

Du er strukturert og analytisk, men samtidig pragmatisk og løsningsorientert. Du evner å stille de riktige spørsmålene, forstå hva kunden faktisk trenger og gjøre komplekse tekniske problemstillinger forståelige. Vi tror også du kjenner deg igjen i at du:

  • tar ansvar og følger opp det du har startet
  • trives med å samarbeide på tvers av fagområder
  • bygger gode og langsiktige kunderelasjoner
  • er nysgjerrig og interessert i å utvikle egen kompetanse
  • har kommersiell forståelse og ser sammenhengen mellom tekniske valg, kvalitet og økonomi
Bli med i et marked i sterk utvikling

Hos Priess får du jobbe med produkter og løsninger som er en viktig del av infrastrukturen samfunnet er avhengig av. Samtidig får du bli med i et selskap med vekstambisjoner og et sterkt fagmiljø.

Priess tilbyr blant annet:

  • en sentral rolle med stor kontaktflate mot kunder og fagmiljøer
  • spennende og varierte tekniske prosjekter
  • mulighet til å påvirke løsningene allerede fra tidlig fase
  • gode faglige og personlige utviklingsmuligheter
  • et kompetent og uformelt arbeidsmiljø
  • konkurransedyktige betingelser

Stillingen har arbeidssted ved Priess Norway sin fabrikk i Skien, men reising må påregnes.

Om Priess

Priess er en nordisk leverandør av prefabrikerte nettstasjoner, teknikkskap og teknikkbygg. Selskapet hjelper kundene med å utvikle effektive og kostnadsgunstige løsninger gjennom høy kvalitet, teknisk kompetanse og nærhet til kunden. Priess har et tydelig fokus på bærekraft og er stolte av å bidra til omstillingen og videreutviklingen av energiforsyningen.

Priess leverer kritisk infrastruktur, og personsikkerhet er derfor viktig både for selskapet og kundene. Det gjennomføres bakgrunnssjekk av kandidater som får tilbud om ansettelse. Dette gjøres for å sikre etterlevelse av selskapets retningslinjer for rekruttering og personsikkerhet, samt relevante lovkrav knyttet til blant annet handelssanksjoner.

Interessert i å vite mer?

Ta kontakt med Batne v. Stig A. Gåre Andresen eller Tommy Westby for ytterligere informasjon. 

 

Din CV og søknad registreres ved å trykke på søknadslinken. Av hensyn til personvern/GDPR har vi ikke mulighet til å behandle søknader mottatt per e-post. Alle henvendelser blir behandlet konfidensielt, om ønskelig også overfor oppdragsgiver frem til en søknad foreligger.

 

Vi er Batne, et rekrutterings- og bemanningsbyrå som siden 2008 har rekruttert ledere, fagspesialister og medarbeidere til næringslivet i Vestfold og Telemark. Kundene får hjelp med å finne de rette folka og kandidatene med å finne den rette jobben, enten det gjelder et vikariat, et midlertidig engasjement eller en kollega for livet. Vi tror på at alle ønsker å investere tiden sin sammen med folk som gjør dem bedre, og vi skaper arbeidsforhold man ser tilbake på med glede. Dette kaller vi å være nøkkelen til riktige ansettelser.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Priess er en nordisk leverandør av prefabrikerte nettstasjoner, teknikkskap og teknikkbygg. Vi hjelper våre kunder til å få effektive og kostnadsgunstige løsninger gjennom fokus på kundenærhet og kvalitet. Vi har fokus på bærekraft i løsningene våre, og vi er stolte av å kunne bidra til omstillingen i energiforsyningen.

jobs.title: ICT Outsourcing Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

 

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

 

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

 

Your Mission

As our ICT Outsourcing Manager, you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to improve our third-party management process adding automation and AI supported assessments across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes.

In this role you will:

  • Act as the first line competence centre for ICT outsourcing and third-party governance topics, working across Technology, Compliance, Operations, business owners, and external partners to ensure risks and responsibilities are transparent and well managed.

  • Own the operational execution of our ICT third-party and outsourcing governance framework across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing arrangements, so that key relationships are assessed, documented, and monitored in line with regulatory expectations.

  • Drive risk assessments, due diligence processes, and recurring reviews for new and existing third parties, coordinating relevant stakeholders and turning findings into clear actions, decisions, and follow-ups.

  • Maintain and improve the outsourcing register, governance documentation, and supporting evidence base, creating the level of clarity and traceability needed for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and partners.

  • Prepare, structure, and run governance and review routines, including reporting, meeting preparation, escalation tracking, and action follow-up, to make third-party oversight more consistent, measurable, and decision-useful.

  • Identify and advance process improvements, standardisation opportunities, and selective AI-supported automation in recurring third-party management workflows, helping the function become more scalable and effective over time.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Bring hands-on experience in ICT outsourcing, third-party management, vendor risk, IT governance, compliance-related operations, or a similar function in a regulated environment.

jobs.title: Backend Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
HEY THERE

At Yazio, we help millions of users every day on their journey to healthy nutrition and greater well-being. We're hiring a Backend Engineering Manager to lead our Backend Team, a small, senior team behind Yazio's API and all of the AI features in the app. This role is for an engineering manager who has led a team before and enjoys helping experienced engineers take full ownership of their work, including the conversations with Product.

 

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

 

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our Backend Team works with the product squads across Yazio, including Monetization, Growth, Tracking Experience, Mobile Platform and Web, as well as Internal Tools and our CRM team. As its manager, you'll give the engineers the context and support they need to own their initiatives end to end, from planning through to conversations with each squad.

 

In your first year, you'll:

  • Take ownership of the team's rituals in your first couple of months (stand-ups, refinements, sprint planning, retros and a bi-weekly written sync) and keep improving how the team works

  • Build close working relationships with squad leads and product managers, so backend work is part of each squad's plans from the start of the quarter

  • Own the team's part of our OKR process: build the quarterly roadmap with the engineers and keep progress visible to the teams that depend on it

  • Grow the team through regular 1:1s, development goals and timely feedback, and step in early when accountability slips

  • Hire for the team as it grows, together with our Talent Acquisition team

  • Keep an eye on production: when an issue or outage comes up, make sure it gets to the right person and is resolved

YOUR PROFILE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You've led an engineering team with direct reports, and you've helped that team take on new responsibilities or change the way it works

  • Before moving into management, you spent several years as a senior backend engineer, so you're comfortable discussing system design, infrastructure and technical trade-offs with a very experienced team

  • You get results through your team: you coach engineers to make decisions and handle stakeholder conversations themselves, and you give them the room to do it

  • You're a clear, friendly communicator who stays calm under pressure, including during an outage

  • You build strong relationships with other leads and stakeholders, and you hold your ground when someone has a strong opinion while staying open to the best solution

  • You have a strong product mindset and connect the team's work to what users and the business need

  • You notice when a topic has gone quiet and follow up before it stalls

Bonus points for:

  • Leading a team that supports several product squads at the same time

  • Working on high-traffic consumer products

  • Setting up, or working in, a model where backend engineers are embedded in product squads

  • Steering the business with KPIs and running A/B tests to improve them

 

OUR CORE TECH STACK

  • Backend: PHP (REST APIs) and Go (async processing and high-concurrency features)

  • Ways of working: Jira and Notion, with a Scrum-like process

  • AI features: daily tips, meal summaries and food search by voice, text and image

  • AI in development: agentic coding as part of the team's everyday workflow

  • Scale: up to one million API requests per minute

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

jobs.title: Enhetschef till SiS ungdomshem Nereby, Bergsjön
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS ungdomshem Nereby har verksamhet i Harestad och i Bergsjön. Vi bedriver differentierad och högkvalitativ skol-, vård- och behandlingsarbete. Verksamheten inbegriper en mängd professioner, såsom lärare, behandlingspedagog, psykolog, sjuksköterska med flera. SiS ungdomshem Nereby tar emot såväl skolpliktiga som icke skolpliktiga pojkar och flickor med psykosocial problematik samt kriminalitet och missbruk.

Arbetsbeskrivning

SiS befinner sig mitt i en omfattande förändring där verksamheten utvecklas på flera plan samtidigt. Vi utvecklar och anpassar vårt arbete utifrån nya och förändrade behov i såväl samhället som i vår egen verksamhet. Vi vet att utvecklande och engagerade chefer är en avgörande förutsättning för att klara dagens och framtidens uppdrag.

Som enhetschef leder, planerar, följer upp och förfinar du arbetet på avdelningen så att ni når uppställda mål. Som enhetschef har du det övergripande behandlingsansvaret för de unga som vistas på avdelningen. Du ansvarar för att gemensamma arbetssätt och metoder används och efterlevs och stödjer medarbetare i sitt arbete. Du ser till att medarbetarna har kompetens för den vård och behandling som avdelningen bedriver och förutsättningar att genomföra sina uppgifter i en god och säker arbetsmiljö.

Som enhetschef har du verksamhets-, personal- och budgetansvar för avdelningens medarbetare. För att skapa en stabil och effektiv avdelningsledning finns det på din avdelning, utöver dig, en gruppledare och en behandlingssekreterare. Gruppledarens främsta uppgift är att planera, samordna och operativt leda och fördela det dagliga arbetet på avdelningen, samt att stötta avdelningens medarbetare i deras arbete. Behandlingssekreteraren har i uppgift att samordna och planera vården och behandlingen för de barn och unga som vårdas på avdelningen. Tillsammans utgör ni ett avdelningsteam som i tätt samarbete leder avdelningen.

Du ingår i institutionens ledningsgrupp där du tillsammans med institutionschefen och dina chefskollegor tar ett gemensamt ansvar för hela verksamheten.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

    Akademisk examen om minst 180 hp med inriktning mot samhälls-, vård- eller beteendevetenskap eller annan relevant akademisk examen.
    Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom verksamheter med fokus på vård, behandling och säkerhet, såsom exempelvis socialtjänst, vård och behandling, kriminalvård eller annan relevant verksamhet.
    Dokumenterad aktuell erfarenhet av arbetsledande roll.
    B-körkort

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av chefskap med verksamhetsansvar, budgetansvar och personalansvar.

Då verksamheten ofta är händelsestyrd behöver du vara bekväm med att fatta beslut, göra omprioriteringar och snabbt kunna växla både tempo och riktning. Du är lugn och professionell även i krävande situationer och har förmågan att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar. Samtidigt ställs höga krav på att du har helhetssyn och kan arbeta strukturerat och systematiskt för att säkerställa kvalitén i vården utifrån myndighetens mål, riktlinjer, värdegrund och gällande lagar. Du vet hur man prioriterar och har lätt för att sätta mål och följa upp resultat.

För att passa i rollen ser vi att du tar ansvar för helheten och förverkligar SiS vision och mål. Du skapar förutsättningar för goda resultat och tar tag i utmaningar och agerar med mod när det behövs. Du är en god förebild och visar tillit till dina medarbetares och kollegors kompetens och uppmuntrar dem till utveckling och att ta eget ansvar. Du involverar dina medarbetare i vårt utvecklingsarbete och skapar förutsättningar för ett aktivt medarbetarskap och för en lärande organisation. Du främjar ett gott samarbete inom SiS och med andra samarbetspartners. Du är kommunikativ och skapar dialog, delaktighet och engagemang.

På SiS månar vi om ett gott ledarskap. Det innebär att du som chef och ledare tar ansvar för helheten, agerar som en god förebild, driver utveckling, främjar ett gott samarbete och är tydlig i din kommunikation. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/

Vi fäster stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Beredskapstjänstgöring ingår i tjänsten.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Our world is a world of change

Our organization is built by people and great teamwork. We are a truly global company, and we believe in the advantage of diversity and together we create a workplace that brings the best out of everyone.

We believe in a sustainable future and with the global Transport industry as our arena, we work together with our customers to turn this belief into reality for people everywhere. That is our purpose, and we live and breathe it, every day.

Manufacturing Engineering in COTE encompasses the production of state-of-the-art products for the truck brands of the Volvo Group. Within manufacturing you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust and embrace change to stay ahead.

We are now looking for a Manufacturing Strategy Manager (MSM) Product Strategy & Preparation (PSP) team.

PSP Strategy team consists of 10 highly engaged colleagues situated in Sweden, France, Belgium, India, and USA. Our target is to secure and develop the manufacturing process globally covering Europe, Asia, and America.

We define and drive strategies for both products and processes to improve the quality, efficiency, and flexibility. We are expected to comprehend the growing competence needs and support/develop the products and processes to ensure the organizations success. Our focus is both on existing product and processes and on Industry 4.0 and the new technologies related to Electromobility and Vehicle Automation.

As an MSM you will have a global role and work in a multibrand and multicultural environment, you will be part of a global team responsible for defining, developing, and implementing manufacturing strategies and visions within the Hardware Area.

To enable future technology transfers you will also be responsible for identifying/supporting Technology development initiatives both within COTE.

You will be part of a global and multicultural team where trust, curiosity and performance are important cornerstones.

Mission

    To be the manufacturing primary interface towards product development in the Agile structure covering the HW area.
    To be actively involved in the early phases of product technology development including Advanced Engineering projects and development of Product roadmaps.
    To secure global alignment of product technology and process roadmaps across the regions, mainly the North America Manufacturing, Europe and Brazil Manufacturing, and International Manufacturing.
    To support project managers in the creation and implementation of project prerequisites and driving requirements.
    To work in close cooperation with the Manufacturing Technology Managers and Specialists, supporting them in the development of new technologies and process visions.



Main activities and responsibilities

    Drive the development of manufacturing product-related strategies (e.g. Physical Modules, Marriage Points, Interfaces).
    Early phases and Advanced Engineering initiatives
    Concept evaluation and selection
    Support the development of the Product Platform by representing manufacturing in the creation of the Product strategies and roadmaps
    Define and develop project prerequisites and driving requirements.
    Represent manufacturing in the Sub Technology structures.
    Anchoring of product concepts regarding process with the three regions
    Provide input to technology roadmap based on identified business potentials.
    Provide technical solutions according to technology roadmap.
    Secure System and Tools requirements in early phases.

Experience and competence

    Engineering University degree or equivalent
    Proven knowledge in Truck Architecture and modularity
    Proven leadership and networking experience in a multi-cultural environment
    You have experience from driving change in a global environment
    Proven knowledge in Manufacturing processes
    Project Management experience
    Experience in VPS tools and practice
    As all documentation is in English, proficiency in the English language is required.

Personal Skills

As a Manufacturing Strategy Manager you are expected to be skilled in driving networks and work in teams. You take responsibility are creative, autonomous, and innovative. You have good communication skills and are generous and share knowledge.

You should have a drive to develop yourself and your surrounding within your area of expertise.

Ready for your next move?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? We are looking for talented, motivated people who want to grow, take on new challenges, and make a real contribution. If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can develop your skills, work with great people, and be part of an inspiring environment, we’d love to hear from you. Take the next step and explore your opportunities with us!
