Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte koordinator Agnethe Lynn Ytrøy på ay@assent.no.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Assent har organisert BPA-tjenester siden 2014. I dag har vi konsesjon på levering av BPA i flere kommuner over hele landet. Vi har medarbeidere med god kjennskap til ordningen og arbeidsgiverrollen, samt lang erfaring med organisering av individuelle tjenester både i og utenfor hjemmet. For oss er det viktig at arbeidleder i størst mulig grad kan leve et uavhengig og selvstendig liv. Assent er medlem i NHO og våre tjenester er i henold til ISO 9001,ISO 14001 og OHSAS 18001.

jobs.title: Har du godt humør og lyst til å hjelpe? Da vil jeg gjerne høre fra deg!
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkallingsvikar
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og helg

Heisann!

Jeg er en positiv og omgjengelig dame i 60-årene som bor i naturskjønne Odda sammen med mannen min og vår kosete katt. Nå er jeg på jakt etter noen dyktige og hjertevarme assistenter med godt humør til mitt BPA-team!

Jeg har MS, som betyr at jeg trenger litt ekstra bistand i hverdagen for å leve livet slik jeg ønsker. Selv om jeg sitter i rullestol, er jeg fortsatt aktiv og forflytter meg godt på egen hånd. Jeg jobber en dag i uken, noe som gir meg stor glede og mening.

Jeg er interessert i håndarbeid, som strikking, og liker å se på gode filmer og serier. Jeg setter stor pris på en god samtale over en kopp kaffe. Jeg liker musikk og skulle gjerne gått på konsert av og til.

Som min assistent vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver – ingen dag vil være helt lik! Jeg trenger hjelp med praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, som husarbeid, stell av hagen, rengjøring av hjelpemidler, og litt snømåking om vinteren. Du vil også bistå med matlaging, baking, handling, trening og kjøring til og fra sosiale aktiviteter og jobb.

Jeg ser etter noen med godt humør, som er positiv, fleksibel og gjerne har noen av de samme interessene som meg. Om du i tillegg er selvstendig og kan ta initiativ på dager hvor jeg ikke er i toppform, vil det være et stort pluss.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg at du sender inn en søknad! Jeg gleder meg til å bli kjent med deg.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker nå etter en tilkallingsvikar som kan stille opp i ferier eller ved sykdom

Personlige egenskaper:

· Godt humør og positiv

· Løsningsorientert

· Selvstendig

· Initiativrik

Kvalifikasjoner:

· Førerkort klasse B

· Gode norskkunnskaper

· Plettfri politiattest

· Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

· Ønskelig med gode datakunnskaper

· Ikke allergisk mot katt

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hedda Bringedal på epost: hedda.bringedal@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Juriste transfrontalier franco-allemand (H/F)

jobs.title: BPA-assistent søkes – hovedsakelig våken nattevakt
jobs.description:
Jeg søker etter flere BPA-assistenter som hovedsakelig kan jobbe våken nattevakt, men jeg trenger også assistenter som kan ta ekstravakter på dag og kveld.

Alle som begynner hos meg, starter som ekstravakt. Dette gjør vi for at både du og jeg skal få mulighet til å bli kjent og finne ut om vi trives sammen. Selv om du begynner som ekstravakt, er det mange vakter å få for den som ønsker å jobbe.

Jeg er en hyggelig og sosial dame i 40-årene. Når formen tillater det, liker jeg å shoppe, være kreativ og ta en kopp kaffe over en hyggelig prat. Jeg har også en sosial og glad hund som er veldig glad i assistentene mine – derfor må du selvfølgelig være glad i hund og kunne ha hund rundt deg. 🐶

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg ønsker meg en assistent som er:

- Omsorgsfull, rolig og trygg på seg selv
- En trygg voksen som kan være stabil når ting er vanskelig
- Gjerne 30 år eller eldre, men yngre søkere med livserfaring og trygghet er også hjertelig velkomne
- God i norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
- Fleksibel og pålitelig
- Komfortabel med å jobbe alene på våken nattevakt
- I stand til å håndtere stress og krevende situasjoner på en rolig måte
- Det er en fordel om du har førerkort
- Jeg ønsker primært kvinnelige assistenter

Jeg har perioder med mye smerter, og da kan situasjonene være utfordrende både for meg og for den som er på jobb. Det er derfor viktig at du klarer å bevare roen og samtidig møte meg med omsorg, trygghet og tålmodighet.

Arbeidsoppgavene kan blant annet være litt hjelp med medisinering etter mine rutiner, lett hjelp med av- og påkledning og å være til stede og skape trygghet når jeg har det vondt.

Jeg har våken nattevakt, og vi legger godt til rette for at du skal få en turnus som passer deg så langt det lar seg gjøre.

Jeg har et veldig godt team med hyggelige kollegaer, som vil ta godt imot en ny assistent. ❤

Hvis dette høres ut som en jobb som kunne passet for deg, håper jeg du tar kontakt!

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg.

jobs.title: Product Manager at Semine
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about understanding business domains and translating market insights into impactful product strategies? Semine is seeking a Product Manager to join their growing team and help them drive innovation in Accounts Payable Automation.

About the job

This is a direct recruitment, which means that the recruitment process takes place through Bravura and you are employed directly by Semine.

About the company


Semine is a fast-growing tech company helping businesses automate their financial operations through innovative use of artificial intelligence. Founded in Norway in 2015, the company was built on the idea of bridging the gap between people and technology by eliminating repetitive and time-consuming tasks. The platform leverages proprietary AI technologies and offers an end-to-end solution on a hyperautomation platform that is revolutionizing traditional financial management. 

Since its launch in 2020, Semine has experienced strong growth and gained significant interest from leading companies across the Nordics. Today, Semine has over 60 employees and offices in Norway, Sweden, and Finland. With a leading position in the Norwegian market, the company is now expanding internationally and is looking for talent eager to help shape the future of financial automation. As part of the Semine team, you will work in a dynamic and inclusive environment where innovation and collaboration are at the core.

Tasks and responsibilities

As a Product Manager you will leverage your deep understanding of Semines business domain to identify market trends, customer needs, and opportunities for product innovation in Accounts Payable Automation.

You will translate industry insights into actionable product strategies, ensuring that Semine’s solutions remain relevant and valuable for their customers. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization to drive the roadmap for your domain and deliver features that set us apart in the market.

• Own and manage the product roadmap for your domain in Accounts Payable Automation, ensuring alignment with business strategy and market needs

• Prioritize features and initiatives based on impact and feasibility to determine priorities and sequencing, balancing short-term objectives with long-term growth strategies

• Gather, document, and analyze customer and business needs to inform product decisions and requirements

• Act as the bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring R&D delivers on defined requirements

Education, experience and personal characteristics

• Several years of experience in Product Management, preferably within SaaS or ERP-related products

• Strong understanding of financial processes and business domains

• Experience working with product development in fast-paced, growing companies

• Fluent in English and knowing a Nordic language is an advantage

We are looking for individuals who thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact. You are naturally curious and eager to learn, always seeking to understand new technologies, market trends, and customer needs. Your proactive mindset means you don’t wait for instructions. You take initiative, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward independently.

Collaboration is at the heart of how you work. You value open communication, enjoy building strong relationships across teams, and are comfortable engaging with stakeholders from different backgrounds and areas of expertise. You are empathetic and attentive, able to listen to others’ perspectives and translate them into actionable solutions.

You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, balancing long-term vision with attention to detail in daily execution. You are adaptable and resilient, embracing change and seeing challenges as opportunities for growth. Your problem-solving skills are matched by your ability to stay organized and focused, even when juggling multiple priorities.

Above all, you have a genuine passion for innovation and continuous improvement. You are driven by the ambition to help shape not just products, but also the future direction of the company. You bring energy, positivity, and a growth mindset to everything you do, inspiring those around you and contributing to a collaborative, forward-thinking culture at Semine.

Other information

Start: Upon agreement

Location: Oslo or Kristiansand

Salary: Upon agreement

We recommend that you submit your application immediately as we make a continuous selection. Welcome with your application!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi jobber med bemanning og rekruttering, men først og fremst jobber vi med mennesker. Vår oppgave er å matche alle som søker interessante jobber og utfordringer med bedrifter der deres talent og erfaring kommer til sin rett og kan utvikles. Vi skiller oss ut ved å sette våre ansatte, og dem vi formidler, i første rekke. Dette har siden starten vist seg å være det beste for deg som oppdragsgiver, for deg som søker jobb, og for oss selv som selskap.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI Driven MAC Control for Integrated Terrestrial NTN 6G Networks
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to pursue a doctoral degree and contribute to cutting-edge research at the intersection of artificial intelligence and next-generation wireless communications like 6G?

The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU has a vacancy for a PhD candidate in AI‑Driven & Self-healing MAC Control for Integrated Terrestrial-NTN 6G networks. The position is fully funded and will run for four years (100 % employment), including teaching duties. Your immediate leader is the Head of the Communication Technology Unit at the department of Information Security and Communication Technology. The workplace will be located in Trondheim.


About the project

Future 6G and beyond communication systems are expected to integrate terrestrial cellular networks with non-terrestrial platforms, including Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Satellites, High Altitude Platform Stations (HAPS), and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). While such integrated networks can provide ubiquitous connectivity and improved resilience, they also introduce significant challenges due to highly dynamic radio environments, heterogeneous backhaul infrastructures, mobility, resource constraints, and service disruptions.

The core research focuses on the MAC layer and its techniques – the candidate will design, implement and evaluate an AI-driven MAC-control framework that self‑heals in integrated terrestrial-NTN (LEO, HAPS, UAV) 6G networks. The work will be hands-on and system-oriented; a closed-loop, verifiable prototype will be built, tested under realistic degradations and examined for different metrics such as latency, reliability, fairness and SLA‑violation. 

For example, the candidate will do some of the tasks including:

  • AI-driven Link Adaptation and MAC control – develop AI-based mechanism that proactively anticipate and respond to rapidly changing conditions in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks (LEO satellites, HAPS, and UAVs) and to cascading radio access networks (RAN) failures/degradations.
  • AI-Driven self-healing MAC – develop algorithms and techniques at the MAC layer for fast anomaly detection, failure prediction, autonomous recovery, and performance resilience.
  • Service-aware MAC layer techniques – develop novel MAC-layer mechanisms that integrate queueing theory, traffic modelling, machine learning, and network-performance prediction for improving latency, reliability and fairness to support mission‑critical services.

The proposed algorithms and mechanisms will be implemented and validated on the B5G Lab infrastructure at the IIK department, NTNU. The lab provides industry‑grade 5G equipment, open‑source RAN stacks, programmable OpenFlow/P4 switches and AI‑Boxes for fast inference, together with NetFPGA/DAG hardware for sub‑millisecond failure detection and a Timeseries‑DB/Grafana monitoring platform for closed‑loop testing. One or multiple satellite ground stations (e.g., Starlink, OneWeb) will be installed and connected to the core network soon to support NTN testing.


Duties of the position
  • Complete all the doctoral courses work, a condition to obtain the doctorate degree
  • Carry out high‑quality research within the scope described above
  • Publish enough scientific results in recognized venues and contribute to research disseminations
  • Actively participate in the Networking Research Group and its activities
  • Engage in international activities (conferences, research stays at foreign educational institutions)
  • Teach and support learning activities in courses related to communications and networking

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant master’s degree in wireless communications and mobile networks, computer networks and distributed systems, telecommunication engineering, computer science with a networking focus, or equivalent, with a strong background in theory, ML/AI, and mathematics
  • Your master’s degree must correspond to a five-year Norwegian degree, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level
  • Master students can still apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position, and no later than 1st of August 2027 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master’s degree study or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to  NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background (not worse than C), you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • A scientific proposal (max. 1000 words / 3 pages) 
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the PhD program in Information Security and Communication Technology.
  • Applicants who do not master a Scandinavian language and are not native English speakers must provide evidence of good written and spoken English language skills. The following tests can be used as such documentation: 
    • TOEFL: 600 (paper-based test), 92 (Internet-based test).
    • IELTS: 6.5, with no section lower than 5.5 (only Academic IELTS test accepted).
    • CAE/CPE: grade B or A 

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNU's guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • High skills in applied mathematics, problem mathematicalising and solving
  • Practical experiences with networked systems and multi-vendor softwarized environments
  • Experience with 5G radio access and core testbeds including open-source solutions
  • Relevant publications and dissemination will be considered an advantage
  • Experience in teaching, preferably on master level
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

We are seeking applicants who are:

  • Highly motivated by fundamental research of practical relevance
  • Well organized and have interest beyond their own research
  • Capable to work independently with clear goals and plans to achieve them 
  • Eager to present and discuss their research with other professionals
  • Eager to disseminate research results in both local and international venues

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation, in terms of the qualifications specified in the advertisement.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Access to the B5G Lab’s state‑of‑the‑art infrastructure
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)  
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work including teaching duties. Integrated PhD study candidates are welcome to apply. For more information on the Integrated PhD program you may check here.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD program in Information Security and Communication Technology within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral program throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • Curriculum Vitae (clear, up to date)
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position
  • A scientific proposal (max. 1000 words / 3 pages, written in English) including a brief problem formulation, research questions, theoretical perspective, methodological approach, and an initial progress plan for the project
  • Your motivation letter (max. 400 words/1 page, written in English)
  • Names and contact information of three relevant references
  • Publications or other relevant research work (e.g., conferences, journals) (if applicable)
  • Certificates or other relevant documentation (e.g., hands-on work with 5G network) (if applicable)
  • Link(s) to public GitHub (or similar) repositories or other code portfolios demonstrating relevant programming experience (e.g., in C++ and/or Python) (if applicable)

If all or parts of your education have been completed abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you find this position interesting and believe it aligns with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tu Dac Ho, email: tu.d.ho@ntnu.no. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR consultant Julie Lindland, email: julie.lindland@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 23.10.2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Information Security and Communication Technology

Research is vital to the security of our society. We teach and conduct research in cyber security, information security, communications networks and networked services. Our areas of expertise include biometrics, cyber defence, cryptography, digital forensics, security in e-health and welfare technology, intelligent transportation systems and malware. The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till glad och mysig tjej i Sjöbo
jobs.description:
Om Kurera Assistans
Kurera Assistans är ett ungt och modernt assistansbolag. Företaget är del av Kurera Omsorg som även innefattar Individ- och familj samt Rusta och Matcha. Kurera Assistans har kontor i Malmö, Västervik och Stockholm!

För oss är våra medarbetare allt. Utan engagerade, kreativa och hjärtliga kollegor är vi ingenting. Därför tar vi varje rekrytering på största allvar och vill finnas där för vår personal under hela anställningen – med ärliga samtal, närvaro och ett genuint intresse för att alla ska trivas och utvecklas. När våra medarbetare mår bra, mår också våra kunder bra.

Vi strävar alltid efter att arbeta med engagemang, ansvar, nytänkande och glädje. Vi vill göra skillnad på riktigt. Hos oss finns kollektivavtal, friskvård och närvarande chefer.

Vi hoppas att du vill bli en del av vårt team!

Vi söker nu en personlig assistent till en glad och mysig flicka född 2013, som bor tillsammans med sin mamma och sina syskon i ett hus i Sjöbo.

Flickan har en intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, en skelettsjukdom och en svår synnedsättning på båda ögonen. Hon har inget verbalt tal och får sin mat via sond. Hon sitter i en specialanpassad rullstol och behöver hjälp och stöd i alla delar av sin vardag, bland annat vid förflyttningar, på- och avklädning, personlig hygien och andra dagliga moment.

Hon kommunicerar på andra sätt och behöver en trygg och lyhörd assistent som kan läsa av hennes behov och skapa en lugn och trygg vardag.

Hon är en glad och mysig tjej som tycker om när man pratar med henne och sjunger. Hon uppskattar närhet, trygghet och mysiga stunder.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är trygg, lugn, ansvarsfull och har ett genuint intresse av att arbeta med barn. Erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning är meriterande, men det viktigaste är personkemin och att du kan skapa en trygg relation med flickan.

Du behöver vara rökfri och gärna vara en aktiv person som tycker om att vistas utomhus. Flickans mamma tycker mycket om att vara ute och springa tillsammans med henne, så det är ett plus om även du uppskattar promenader, löpning och andra aktiviteter utomhus.

Flickan går i skola och fritids på dagarna, vilket innebär att assistansen främst kommer att vara förlagd till eftermiddagar, kvällar och helger.

Som ny assistent får du en trygg och personlig introduktion tillsammans med kundens mamma, där du får lära dig flickans rutiner, behov och hur de olika momenten i vardagen utförs.

Vi söker dig som vill bli en trygg och positiv person i flickans vardag och som kan bidra till att hon får en aktiv, trygg och innehållsrik fritid.

Känner du att detta skulle passa dig? Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Healthcare Assistant Shift Pattern 37 hour per week (Community HCA)
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The overall purpose of the role is to care for and maintain people in their own home. The Health Care Assistant provides assistance, support and direct personal care required to help with maintaining the independence and wellbeing of the service user. To attend to service user primarily in their own home. To carry out a range of care tasks as indicated on the service users Care Plan and as directed by your Line Manager. These tasks include Personal Care, light household duties and social care as follows: a) Personal Care Tasks include but are not limited to bathing, toileting, incontinence pad changing, washing, dressing and feeding. b) Practical light household care tasks include but are not limited to making meals, clean kitchen tops, hovering, tidying, fire lighting. c) Social Care tasks include but are not limited to conversation, companionship, support with home exercise programme and other activities identified on the care plan. To prompt / assist service users to take their medications. To be aware of the changing needs of a service user and to report these to your Line Manager. To provide relief for a carer/colleague as required. To maintain written records of service users visited as required by the Company, including the Service User Diary and the companies One Touch IT Health Recording System. To participate in formal and informal individual, team and group supervision, as required. To attend and participate in individual, team and company training and meetings, as required. To comply with all aspects of the Company’s Health and Safety Policies and procedures, to ensure that all safety equipment provided (e.g. hoists, slings, etc.) are used correctly and in a safe manner; and to report immediately any Health and Safety risks in the service users home to your Line manager. To provide a consistently high standard of professional care to service users of NHCS. To ensure that the rights of service users are protected in your dealings with them. To be caring and responsible in dealing with service users and their families. To carry out duties in accordance with the values, ethos and mission of the NHCS. To comply with company policies and procedures as are laid out in the Employee Handbook and in the Clinical Practice File on the One Touch IT System available on your company phone. Education requirements*:- Completion of / or a willingness to undertake and complete QQI Level 5 Care Skills and Care of the Older Person modules Completion of Patient Movement and Handling training (theory and practical) HSE online modules (various). 1+ years experience as a Health care Assistant / Home Care Worker essential Own transport is essential for this role Full driver’s licence Good command of the English language - aural, spoken and written Garda Vetting (NVB checks). Written Employment References required.

jobs.title: Product Cost Specialist - Operations, Lund
jobs.description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! We are growing and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist to join our team within Manufacturing Capacity and Cost.

Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.

Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.

This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.

What you'll do here as Product Cost Specialist

    Be responsible for negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
    Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
    Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
    Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
    Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
    Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
    Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.
    The position will mean some travels abroad.

You have:

    A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
    Minimum 5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience from international manufacturing companies.
    Proven record of at least 2 years of business negotiations.
    Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
    Excellent MS Office skills.
    Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It's good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Axis Career Hub
Life at Axis blog  
Engineering at Axis blog
Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Johan Ahlberg, Manager Manufacturing Capacity & Cost at +46 46 272 1800

jobs.title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
jobs.description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

jobs.title: Reiseglad og handy personlig assistent (BPA) søkes!
jobs.description:
Jeg er en blid og positiv mann på 61 år som søker etter en eller flere personlige assistenter.

Jeg benytter rullestol både ute og inne og trenger hjelp til stort sett alt mulig i hverdagen. Som min personlige assistent skal du gjøre de tingene jeg ikke klarer grunnet min funksjonsnedsettelse. Jeg er mye ute på farten, og jeg søker etter en person som kan være med meg på både korte og lengre reiser. Jeg bor sammen med min kone i enebolig med stor hage som trenger stell og vedlikehold.


Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil i hovedsak være:

  • Husvask, klesvask og alle oppgaver som følger med et hushold både ute og inne
  • Matlaging og handling
  • Vedlikeholdsarbeid ute og inne
  • Følge og assistere til trening/svømming
  • Følge til sykehus, lege og andre ærend
  • Følge til sosiale aktiviteter og turer
  • Bistand til personlig hygiene
  • Hjelp til forflytninger
  • Være med på reiser etter avtale

Kort fortalt trenger jeg hjelp til alt jeg fysisk ikke klarer selv. Det er viktig at du forstår at en hverdag ikke alltid kan planlegges, og at en arbeidsdag kan forandres på kort varsel.


Arbeidstid

Jeg søker 1 fast assistent 80 % stilling, turnus 29 timer/uke som kan jobbe vakter dag og kveld(man-fre) og hver andre lørdag og søndag. Det vil i perioder være mulig å jobbe mer. Det er ønskelig at du kan være med på reiser etter avtale.

Jeg søker også tilkallingsvikar(er) som kan jobbe ved behov på kort varsel, ferie og sykdom.

Oppgi i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker.


Hvem ser jeg etter:

Det er supert om du er handy av natur, og systematisk da din arbeidsplass er mitt hjem. Det er derfor avgjørende at du fungerer som en del av familien, jobber selvstendig og at vi respekterer hverandre, samtidig som du tar initiativ og ser hva som trenger å gjøres uten at jeg behøver å si ifra. Jobben hos meg kan være utrolig variert, og du må være fleksibel. Videre ser jeg etter deg som:

  • er allsidig, omsorgsfull og ærlig
  • har godt humør, er tålmodig, og engasjert
  • er en god samarbeidspartner
  • har god helse slik at du kan bistå med med personlig stell
  • har førerkort klasse B
  • behersker norsk og engelsk

Det er ingen formelle krav til kompetanse da full opplæring vil bli gitt. Personlig egnethet og kjemi mellom deg som assistent og meg som arbeidsleder samt min kone blir vektlagt ved en eventuell ansettelse. Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse.


Hva tilbyr vi

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø  
  • En meningsfull og motiverende jobb som fremmer likestilling 
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver  
  • Gode arbeids- og lønnsbetingelser gjennom tariffavtale 
  •  Egen kontaktperson ved avdeling Romerike
  • Kurs og opplæring som trygger deg i rollen som assistent

Føler du dette er jobben for deg så send en søknad.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Driftchef till vår kund i Nacka
jobs.description:
När du vill att jobbet ska vara mer än bara ett jobb erbjuder vi variation på olika sätt. Hos oss får du vara dig själv! För vi vet att en inkluderande arbetsplats ger framgång och det blir roligare att gå till jobbet. Hos oss får du intressanta och utmanande arbetsuppgifter.

Vi söker nu en positiv, engagerad och driven Driftchef till en av våra kunder i Nacka. Sodexo ansvarar för flera FM-tjänster på siten, bland annat reception, vaktmästeri, lokalvård, café och kaffeservice. Vi söker dig som trivs med att leda människor och som gillar kombinationen av operativt och administrativt arbete.

Du har en hög känsla för service och ett professionellt bemötande gentemot kund, medarbetare, gäster och besökare. Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och initiativrik och är inte rädd för att fatta beslut när det behövs.

Ansvarsområden

    Övergripande ansvar för den dagliga FM-driften
    Leda, fördela och följa upp det dagliga arbetet
    Personalansvar för medarbetare inom reception, vaktmästeri, lokalvård och café
    Upprätthålla en god relation med kunden och säkerställa att tjänsterna levereras enligt avtal
    Bemannings- och vakansplanering
    Följa upp och åtgärda avvikelser i serviceleveransen
    Arbeta med utveckling och förbättring av våra tjänster
    Arbetsmiljöarbete såsom riskanalyser och skyddsronder
    Administrativa uppgifter och ekonomisk uppföljning
    Regelbundna möten och uppföljningar med kunden

Kvalifikationer

    Utbildning och/eller erfarenhet från liknande arbete
    Ledarerfarenhet är ett krav
    Erfarenhet inom Facility Management eller service är meriterande
    Stark känsla för kund och verksamhet
    Vana av administrativt arbete och olika system
    Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och självständigt
    Driv och vilja att utveckla både medarbetare och verksamheten
    God samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga

Vi söker framför allt dig som vill vara närvarande i verksamheten, bygga ett starkt team och tillsammans med kunden fortsätta utveckla FM-leveransen.

Personen vi söker:

Som ledare på Sodexo förväntas du agera enligt vår Ledarskapskompass i vardagen. Det innebär att är en relationsskapande och kommunikativ person som leder med empati, samarbetar för helheten, använder feedback som ett naturligt utvecklingsverktyg. Genom din struktur och lösningsorienterade arbetssätt driver du lönsamhet genom smarta prioriteringar, bygger för framtiden genom att utveckla människor och arbetssätt samt skapar långsiktiga relationer med kunder och medarbetare.

Om tjänsten 

Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning på 6 månader.  Arbetstiderna är dagtid, veckodagar.

Frågor om tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen besvaras av Erik Gund på erik.gund@sodexo.com Observera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem. Din ansökan vill vi ha senast 25 oktober. För denna tjänst kommer vi att genomföra bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samarbete med en extern leverantör. Slutkandidaten kommer att informeras och efterfrågas om medgivande innan det att bakgrundskontrollen genomförs. Observera att alla medarbetare inom Sodexo ska ha genomgått en identitetsvalidering innan anställning.  

Mer om Sodexo och vilka vi är 

    https://se.sodexo.com/om-oss-1.html
    https://se.sodexo.com/jobba-hos-oss/Mitt-Sodexo/medarbetarsidorna-mitt-sodexo

Redo att vara en del av något större? Ansök idag! 

Sodexokoncernen

Sodexo grundades av Pierre Bellon i Marseille 1966 och är ledande inom mat- och servicetjänster för bättre vardagsupplevelser inom lärande, arbete, hälsa och nöje. Sodexokoncernen är unik genom sitt oberoende och grundarfamiljens delägande, samt sin hållbara affärsmodell. Med sitt utbud av tjänster möter Sodexo vardagens utmaningar med ett dubbelt mål: att förbättra livskvaliteten för våra medarbetare och alla som tar del av vår service, samt att bidra till ekonomiska, sociala och miljömässiga framsteg i de samhällen där vi är verksamma. För oss går tillväxt och socialt engagemang hand i hand. Vårt syfte är att skapa en bättre vardag, för ett bättre liv för alla. Sodexo är medlem i CAC Next 20, Bloomberg France 40, CAC SBT 1.5, FTSE 4 Good och DJSI Index.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the Southern Europe region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s business across France, Spain, Italy and the wider European region. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's leading enterprises and public institutions adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence, financial services, Telecommunications, Energy and the public sector.

SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:

  • Technical experts in the field

  • Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues

  • Product evangelists of Cohere technology

  • Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI

Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.

In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.

You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams.

A typical day at Cohere might include:

  • Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.

  • Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments.

  • Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.

  • Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption.

  • Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack

  • Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.

  • Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.

  • Working closely with our partners to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.

This might be for you if you have some of the following:

  • 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer or deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production.

  • A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't.

  • Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist.

  • Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools

  • Preferred: Fluency in French, Spanish or Italian

  • Must have: Professional fluency in English (business and technical)

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.title: Hälsorådgivare / Säljare
jobs.description:
Tjänstebeskrivning I rollen som säljare jobbar du med att hitta nya potentiella medlemmar och sitter i säljmöten. Du tar kontakt med potentiella kunder via telefon och bokar in möten. I mötet visar dem vårt center, du förklarar våra erbjudanden samt tecknar avtal. I rollen ingår både att möta kunder på centret genom bokade möten samt aktivt skapa nya möjligheter för fler nya medlemmar.

Rollen är omväxlande och omfattar primärt försäljning i form av hälsorådgivning där vi säljer medlemskap och tilläggstjänster till leads. Vad det gäller försäljningen så stöttar vi såklart varandra men du bär huvudansvaret för att nå dina och centrets mål.

Anställningen är en 65% tillsvidareanställning med inledande sex månaders provanställning. Fast och rörlig lön. Tillträde i oktober.

Då vi jobbar med en del fast lön, och en del rörlig lön i form av provision så påverkar du din egen lön genom försäljning av medlemskap och tjänster.

Fast ingångslön för heltid ligger mellan 15 000 kr och 16 000 kr, där vi tar hänsyn till bland annat utbildning, erfarenhet och kompetenser.

Den rörliga delen varierar efter prestation, när man når målen och de nyckeltal som vi har ligger den rörliga lönen mellan 16 000 - 20 000 för en heltid, men även över, som adderas till den fasta lönen.

Tjänsten innebär att arbetstiderna varierar och ibland omfattar tidiga morgnar, kvällar och helger. En hög grad av flexibilitet är därför viktigt.

Låter den som ett roligt och stimulerande uppdrag för dig? Intervjuer sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Arbetsuppgifter Här är följer några exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    

Skapande av leads, och kontakt av leads dagligen

    

Jobba mot dagliga säljmål för dig och centret

    

Aktiv försäljning av varor och tjänster (medlemskap och andra tjänster) på plats

    

Arbeta med företagsförsäljning, etablera kontakter samt försäljning av medlemskap och träning.

    

Medlemskommunikation för att skapa relation och jobba med kundnöjdhet.

Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har en relevant bakgrund och/eller utbildning inom försäljning. Meriterande är utbildning inom träning och hälsa. Väl på plats erbjuder vi interna utbildningar inom vårt koncept och försäljning.

Är du utbildad Personlig tränare finns möjlighet att jobba fler timmar med personlig träning utöver säljtjänsten.

Egenskaper Vi letar dig som älskar försäljning och har ett stort egendriv samt trivs med att kunna påverka din egen lön då du motiveras att en större del av lönen är provisionsbaserad. Du brinner för hälsa och välmående, och har god planeringsförmåga och kan självständigt lägga upp ditt arbete. Du är målinriktad och tycker att det är inspirerande att nå mål. Att arbeta systematiskt är något som du trivs med och förstår vikten av att jobba efter satta rutiner och riktlinjer i en kedja.

jobs.title: Printer
jobs.description:

Race Displays Ltd specialises in event advertising signage and branding, with a particular focus on horse racing, greyhound racing and sporting and promotional events. The company manufactures signage in-house using digital printing processes and provides sign production, event installation and storage services. Employer:Race Displays Ltd Job Title: Printer Annual Salary: €36,605 gross per annum Contract: Full-time, fixed-term contract for 2 years Hours: 39 hours per week Annual Leave: 20 days Location of Employment:Cloughrea, Drumconrath, Co. Meath, C15 KF24 Working Hours:Monday to Thursday: 8:00–16:45, including a 45-minute unpaid break; Friday: 8:00–15:45, including a 45-minute unpaid break Key Duties and Responsibilities •Set up and operate commercial digital printing machinery to produce racing, sporting and event display materials. •Prepare and configure printing equipment for production runs, including selecting suitable media, loading inks and setting appropriate machine parameters. •Produce test prints and inspect output for colour consistency, alignment, registration, image quality and other printing defects. •Adjust machine settings as required to maintain consistent print quality throughout production. •Monitor printing runs, including media feeding, ink application, machine performance and finished output. •Identify and correct printing defects and reprint materials where necessary to meet production specifications and quality standards. •Maintain accurate production records, including quantities produced and relevant machine information. •Carry out routine cleaning, maintenance and replacement of standard consumables on printing equipment in accordance with manufacturer instructions. •Monitor the condition of printing equipment and identify and report technical faults or operational problems. •Handle printing materials, inks and consumables safely and maintain the printing equipment and production area in a clean and safe condition. •Follow machinery operating procedures, manufacturer instructions and workplace health and safety requirements. •Complete production runs according to scheduled deadlines while maintaining the required quality standards. Required Skills and Experience •Previous experience operating commercial digital printing equipment. •Practical knowledge of digital printing processes and production procedures. •Ability to configure and adjust printing machinery to achieve required print quality. •Ability to identify and resolve common printing defects and operational issues. •Knowledge of colour consistency and print quality control. •Ability to work accurately to production specifications and deadlines. •Ability to perform routine cleaning and maintenance of printing equipment. •Good attention to detail and commitment to maintaining production quality. •Ability to work independently and as part of a production team. •Understanding of health and safety requirements

jobs.title: Säljande Rekryterare sökes till Viva Bemanning – Sverige!
jobs.description:
Om jobbet

Vill du vara på en arbetsplats där du kan hjälpa människor att hjälpa andra människor?

Är du dessutom en person som vill jobba med relationsbaserad försäljning och som trivs med att prata i telefon?

Då vill du inte missa den här tjänsten!

Vi består i dagsläget av ett hårt arbetande team med mycket engagemang och positiv energi där alla arbetar mot samma mål – vi vill tillsätta alla uppdrag i Sverige och Norge för att bidra till en bättre värld.

Den här tjänsten riktar in sig helt och hållet mot vår svenska marknad där vi bemannar med främst sjuksköterskor och läkare runt om i hela Sverige.

Vår resa började under 2019 när fyra barndomsvänner från Enköping startade Viva Bemanning i de lokaler vi sitter idag. Sedan dess har utvecklingen gått i en hög fart och vi har blivit prisbelönta som tex. Sveriges snabbast växande bemanningsföretag, Gasellpris, finalister i årets mångfaldsföretag m.m.

Vi har våra kontor i dagsläget belägna i Enköping, Sundbyberg samt Oslo. Du är tänkt att komma in i ett team i Stockholm bestående av erfarna konsultchefer som kommer lära dig allt du behöver veta för att bli en toppspelare i branschen.

Ansvarsområden och arbetsuppgifter:

Som rekryterare hos oss har du en viktig roll i att hitta och skapa kontakt med nya kandidater som kan vara aktuella för konsultuppdrag via oss.

Ditt huvudsakliga uppdrag är att ringa kallt, söka upp nya kandidater och aktivt bygga upp en egen kandidatbas. Rollen är därför mycket telefon- och aktivitetsdriven, där en stor del av arbetsdagen handlar om att identifiera rätt personer, ta den första kontakten och väcka intresse för att arbeta som konsult genom oss.

Du kommer framför allt att arbeta med:

·       Aktiv och löpande kallringning till nya kandidater

·       Search och prospektering för att hitta nya potentiella konsulter

·       Första kontakt via framför allt telefon, men även mejl och sociala medier

·       Presentera oss som bolag och skapa intresse för våra konsultuppdrag

·       Kartlägga kandidatens erfarenhet, önskemål, tillgänglighet och framtida planer

·       Kvalificera kandidater och identifiera vilka som är aktuella att gå vidare med

·       Boka in nästa steg och lämna över kvalificerade kandidater till en senior kollega, som därefter tar ansvar för den fortsatta processen

Du ansvarar alltså i första hand för toppen av rekryteringsprocessen – att hela tiden fylla på med nya, relevanta och intresserade kandidater. När du har etablerat kontakten och bedömt att kandidaten är aktuell lämnar du över personen till en senior konsultchef/säljare som driver processen vidare mot presentation, förhandling, avtal och bokning.

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du tycka om att arbeta i ett högt tempo med telefonen som ditt främsta arbetsverktyg. Du behöver vara uthållig, tävlingsinriktad och bekväm med att kontakta människor som du aldrig tidigare har pratat med. Samtidigt behöver du vara förtroendeingivande och duktig på att snabbt skapa en bra relation.

Rollen passar dig som motiveras av tydliga mål och hög aktivitet och som får energi av att jaga nya kontakter, öppna dörrar och skapa möjligheter.

För rätt person finns även goda möjligheter att utvecklas. När du har byggt upp erfarenhet och visat att du behärskar kandidatinflödet kan rollen successivt utvecklas mot ett större eget ansvar i bemanningsprocessen.

Om dig:

För att passa in hos oss och klara av rollen som rekryterare och i framtiden konsultchef krävs det att du är:

· Positiv, Lösningsfokuserad, Social, Målinriktad och kan arbeta i högt tempo.

· För långvariga relationer och professionalism är disciplin och hög arbetsmoral viktiga faktorer och vi ser även gärna att du är en lagspelare och tävlingsinriktad. Mycket handlar om bra kommunikation och du får gärna vara en person som är bra på att både ge och ta emot feedback. Sunt förnuft kan ta dig långt inom företaget!

Andra kvaliteter vi eftersöker är:

· En person som älskar utmaningar och som ständigt vill utvecklas.

· Det är viktigt att du kan både skriva och tala flytande svenska.

· Tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet inom sälj och/eller rekrytering är meriterande.

· Inställningen är A och O för oss och något vi värdesätter högt på Viva Bemanning.

Vi erbjuder dig:

Du blir en del av ett härligt team som arbetar tätt tillsammans och stöttar varandra i det dagliga arbetet och erbjuder dig:

· Möjligheten att påverka din lön varje dag.

· Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en tydlig karriärtrappa.

· Centralt beläget kontor med drivna och härliga kollegor

· Löpande Coachning

· Möjlighet att träna under arbetsdagen

Om anställningen:

Start: 2026-11-09 eller enligt överenskommelse

Placering: Sundbyberg

Omfattning: Deltid

Anställningsform: Timanställning

Lön: Grundlön + Provision.

Hur du söker tjänsten:

För att söka tjänsten skickar du ett mejl med CV och Personligt brev till:

bemanning@vivabemanning.se

Vi behandlar alla ansökningar vartefter de kommer in och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen.

Vänta inte med att söka!

Om Viva Bemanning

Vi är ett prisbelönat bemanningsföretag som arbetar med konsulter och kunder över hela Sverige och Norge. Vi vill ge förstklassig hjälp så att våra konsulter kan hjälpa så många det bara går. Vi är grundade och har vårt huvudkontor i Sveriges närmaste stad Enköping. Våra andra kontor ligger placerade i Sundbyberg och Oslo. Vi strävar mot att göra det lilla extra varje dag och jobbar löpande med att främja hälsa och välmående både internt och externt. Vi är certifierade mot ISO9001 och ISO14001.

jobs.title: Senior HIL Development Engineer – Automotive Embedded Systems
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced HIL Development Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) architecture, development, modelling, integration, and system-level debugging.

This role is focused on developing and maintaining advanced HIL environments used for vehicle system validation. We are looking for engineers who have experience building and improving HIL test systems – not only executing tests. The ideal candidate has a strong background in real-time simulation, ECU integration, automotive communication, and troubleshooting complex embedded systems.

You will work closely with development, verification, and integration teams to secure robust test environments and support the validation of future vehicle technologies.

Key Responsibilities

HIL Development & Integration (Mandatory)

    Design, develop, commission, and maintain HIL test rigs and environments.
    Integrate ECUs, I/O systems, communication interfaces, sensors, and actuators into HIL platforms.

jobs.title: Professor i industridesign
jobs.description:
Industridesign är ett brett och föränderligt område som tar sig an miljörelaterade, samhälleliga och tekniska utmaningar genom design, forskning och experimenterande. Vi söker en innovativ och nyfiken professor som vill inspirera och utbilda morgondagens designer, och som på ett holistiskt sätt kan bidra till ämnets fortsatta utveckling genom designpraktik, forskning och samarbeten.



Vi välkomnar ansökningar från kandidater i Sverige och internationellt. Alla handlingar i din ansökan ska vara på engelska.  



Vi rekryterar utifrån kompetens och i enlighet med skolans strävan efter ökad mångfald och frihet från diskriminering.



Konstfack är Sveriges största konstnärliga högskola inom konst, design och konsthantverk. Sedan 1844 har vi utbildat en mängd olika yrkesgrupper inom dessa fält, samt bild- och slöjdlärare. Vi bedriver både konstnärlig och vetenskaplig utbildning/forskning och har idag cirka 900 studenter och 200 anställda. Se mer på http://www.konstfack.se

Den aktuella tjänsten är förlagd vid inriktningen Design på institutionen för design, inredningsarkitektur och visuell kommunikation (DIV), där både utbildning och forskning bedrivs inom dessa områden. Institutionen bedriver utbildningar på kandidat-, master- och doktorandnivå. Vid institutionen förenas konstnärlig praktik med kritisk och samhällsinriktad kunskapsutveckling. DIV:s forskningsmiljö är under utveckling, och som professor förväntas du dela ansvaret för att leda utvecklingen inom inriktningen Design.



De två utbildningar som erbjuds inom inriktningen design följer en progressiv utbildningsstruktur med en stark grund i hållbarhetsfrågor. På kandidatprogrammet i Industridesign (180 hp) får studenten en bred grund inom industridesign genom konstnärligt gestaltande, formgivning och designmetodik, samtidigt som material, tekniker och digitala medier utforskas i relation till användare. Studenterna utvecklar fysiska, teoretiska, och digitala färdigheter och får en förståelse för sitt framtida yrke genom samarbeten med näringsliv och samhälle. Masterprogrammet Design Ecologies (120 hp) bygger vidare på denna grund, utvidgar den teoretiska och metodologiska kunskapen, och bibehåller en stark förankring i materiell och rumslig praktik. Under utbildningen utforskar studenterna relationerna mellan människor och andra livsformer utifrån olika perspektiv, vilket förbereder dem för både yrkes- och forskningsinriktade karriärer.



Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

I och med denna rekrytering kommer det att finnas två professorer som leder inriktningen Design. Professorerna delar det konstnärliga och pedagogiska ansvaret för ämnesområdena.  Ett viktigt ansvar för professorerna är att aktivt bidra till utvecklingen av forskningsmiljön inom ämnesområdet och vid Konstfack i allmänhet.



Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar:

    Delat ansvar för det konstnärliga och pedagogiska ledarskapet inom kollegiet, såväl som för utveckling av ämnesområdet
    Att aktivt delta i undervisning på grund-, avancerad- och forskarutbildningsnivå
    Att stärka nationell och internationell samverkan med akademi, profession och samhällsaktörer
    Att bedriva forskning inom ämnesområdet
    Att leda, utveckla och utöka forskningsmiljön
    Att initiera forskningsansökningar och söka extern finansiering nationellt och internationellt
    Att delta i Konstfacks gemensamma arbete, samt ingå i Konstfacksövergripande och institutionsspecifika arbetsgrupper



Anställningen

Anställningen omfattar 60–100 procent av heltid i högst fem år med möjlighet till förnyad anställning i ytterligare högst fem år. Önskat tillträde är i april-juni 2027. Arbetstiden är förlagd på Konstfack med flera tillfällen varje arbetsvecka. Distansarbete från utlandet är inte möjligt. I Sverige finns ett försörjningskrav för den som söker arbetstillstånd. För att ta reda på hur detta påverkar dig som internationell sökande, vänligen läs om https://www.migrationsverket.se/Privatpersoner/Arbeta-i-Sverige/Anstalld/Krav-for-arbetstillstand/Forsorjningskrav-for-arbetstillstand.html på Migrationsverkets hemsida eller kontakta mailto:HR@konstfack.se.



Behörighetskrav och bedömningsgrunder

Behörighetskrav och bedömningsgrunder vid anställning av lärare finns angivna i högskole­förordningen samt i Konstfacks anställningsordning. Med bedömningsgrunder avses de faktorer som bedöms utöver behörighetskraven, om behörighetskraven är uppfyllda.



Behörighetskraven för den här anställningen är:

Kontakt

Kontakta prefekt Jonas Ahnmé, 070 970 35 14 eller mailto:jonas.ahnme@konstfack.se , om du vill veta mer om anställningen.
