jobs.title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

jobs.title: Driftchef inom konferens, reception & lokalvård
jobs.description:
Vill du leda engagerade team, utveckla affären och driva en unik konferensverksamhet i hjärtat av Göteborg? Sodexo söker nu en säljande och resultatinriktad Driftchef som vill vara med i en spännande fas för en av våra mest centrala anläggningar. Som Driftchef ansvarar du för helheten inom konferens, reception och lokalvård på vår konferensanläggning i centrala Göteborg samt ytterligare två enheter i regionen. Du blir en nyckelperson i att säkerställa hög service, motiverade team och en affär som växer och utvecklas.

Detta är en roll för dig som trivs i korsningen mellan ledarskap, affärsutveckling och daglig drift. Du får en bred och varierad vardag där du både arbetar nära kunder och gäster, driver försäljning av konferensutrymmen – och samtidigt leder med omtanke och tydlighet i Sodexos anda.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    Driva affärer mot både offentliga och kommersiella kunder.
    Hantera offert- och anbudsprocesser, inklusive upphandlingar via offentliga system.
    Skapa och utveckla starka relationer med externa partners.
    Säkerställa hög service och effektiv drift inom konferens, reception och städ.
    Arbeta nära verksamheten och driften samt planera resurser och rätt bemanning över enheterna.
    Följa upp resultat, ekonomi och kvalitet i verksamheten.
    Leda och utveckla medarbetare på tre enheter.
    Agera coachande och närvarande chef med fokus på trivsel, utveckling och delaktighet.

Vem söker vi?

Du som lyckas i rollen har ett genuint intresse för både ledarskap och affärsutveckling. Du är trygg i att driva sälj, bygga relationer och skapa lönsamhet – samtidigt som du är lyhörd, omtänksam och prestigelös i ledarskapet.

Du behöver ha:

    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av konferens-, event- eller servicebranschen.
    Erfarenhet av försäljning och att driva affärer.
    Ledarerfarenhet med ansvar för personal.
    God systemvana, gärna inom bokning, anbud och schemaläggning.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet inom städ och/eller Facility Management.

Personliga egenskaper som passar i rollen:

    Omtänksam och empatisk – du bygger förtroende och relationer.
    Beslutsam och självgående – du vågar ta ansvar och driva framåt.
    Snabblärd och nyfiken – du sätter dig snabbt in i både verksamhet och affärer.
    Resultatfokuserad – du trivs med att jobba mot mål och ser till att leverera.

Vad vi erbjuder:

Utöver en spännande tjänst och härliga kollegor erbjuder vi dig bland annat: 

    Flexibel och dynamisk arbetsmiljö 
    Tillgång till löpande utbildning och utvecklingsprogram 
    Möjligheter att växa inom företaget
    Stort fokus på hälsa och säkerhet  
    Volontärarbete på betald arbetstid 

Om tjänsten:

Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning på 6 månader. Arbetstiderna är dagtid, veckodagar.

Frågor om tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen besvaras av Erik Gund på erik.gund@sodexo.com. Observera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem. Din ansökan vill vi ha senast 11 oktober 2026.

För denna tjänst kommer vi att genomföra bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samarbete med en extern leverantör. Slutkandidaten kommer att informeras och efterfrågas om medgivande innan det att bakgrundskontrollen genomförs. Observera även att alla medarbetare inom Sodexo ska ha genomgått en identitetsvalidering innan anställning.  

Mer om Sodexo och vilka vi är:

    https://se.sodexo.com/om-oss-1.html
    https://se.sodexo.com/jobba-hos-oss/Mitt-Sodexo/medarbetarsidorna-mitt-sodexo

Redo att vara en del av något större? Ansök idag! 

Sodexokoncernen

Sodexo grundades av Pierre Bellon i Marseille 1966 och är ledande inom mat- och servicetjänster för bättre vardagsupplevelser inom lärande, arbete, hälsa och nöje. Sodexokoncernen är unik genom sitt oberoende och grundarfamiljens delägande, samt sin hållbara affärsmodell. Med sitt utbud av tjänster möter Sodexo vardagens utmaningar med ett dubbelt mål: att förbättra livskvaliteten för våra medarbetare och alla som tar del av vår service, samt att bidra till ekonomiska, sociala och miljömässiga framsteg i de samhällen där vi är verksamma. För oss går tillväxt och socialt engagemang hand i hand. Vårt syfte är att skapa en bättre vardag, för ett bättre liv för alla. Sodexo är medlem i CAC Next 20, Bloomberg France 40, CAC SBT 1.5, FTSE 4 Good och DJSI Index.

Om stillingen

Vi søker en engasjert og operativ Soussjef til vårt kjøkkenteam. Dette er en fulltidsstilling hvor du vil være kjøkkensjefens nærmeste samarbeidspartner og ha hovedansvar for den daglige driften av kjøkkenet.

Som soussjef er du en synlig leder i den daglige driften og sørger for at kvalitet, rutiner og medarbeideroppfølging gjennomføres på en profesjonell måte. Rollen innebærer arbeid både på dag- og kveldstid, og passer for deg som trives i et hektisk miljø hvor du kan kombinere matfaglig kompetanse med personalledelse.

Ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver

Som soussjef vil du ha hovedansvar for:

  • Daglig kjøkkendrift

  • Planlegging, koordinering og produksjon av lunsj, middag og selskapsservering

  • Personaloppfølging i det daglige

  • Oppfølging av timelister og bemanning i samarbeid med kjøkkensjef

jobs.title: Pædagogisk vikar søges til 0. klasse i Kirke Såby – mulighed for fastansættelse
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder søger FIRMAVIKAR en rolig, omsorgsfuld og nærværende pædagogisk medarbejder til et vikariat på en skole i Kirke Såby.

Du bliver en vigtig del af hverdagen omkring børnene i 0. klasse, hvor din primære opgave bliver at skabe tryghed, struktur og nærvær samt støtte børnene gennem skoledagen.

Om jobbet

Du kommer til at indgå naturligt i skolens hverdag og arbejde tæt sammen med lærere og øvrigt pædagogisk personale.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • At støtte børnene i undervisningen og i dagligdagens aktiviteter

  • At skabe tryghed, ro og struktur omkring børnene

  • At være nærværende og opmærksom på det enkelte barns behov

  • At støtte børnene i deres sociale og personlige udvikling

  • At hjælpe med at skabe gode relationer og fællesskaber i klassen

  • At være til stede og støtte børnene i pauser og øvrige aktiviteter

  • At samarbejde tæt med skolens lærere og øvrige medarbejdere

Vi søger dig, som

  • Er rolig, omsorgsfuld og stabil

  • Er god til at skabe relationer til børn

  • Har forståelse for, at børn kan have forskellige behov

  • Kan skabe struktur og bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og møder til tiden

  • Trives med tæt samarbejde med kolleger

  • Gerne har erfaring fra skole, SFO, daginstitution eller andet pædagogisk arbejde

En pædagogisk uddannelse er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette tilgang til børnene og kan være en stabil og tryg voksen i deres hverdag.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Kirke Såby
Arbejdstid: Mandag til fredag kl. 08.00–14.30
Periode: Ca. 1–2 måneder
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt / efter aftale
Ansættelse: Vikariat gennem FIRMAVIKAR

For den rette person er der mulighed for fastansættelse hos skolen, hvis samarbejdet fungerer godt, og der er et godt match mellem dig og arbejdspladsen.

Interesseret?

Send gerne dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af dig selv hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Civil/HVAC QA/QC Engineer for CAM Plant Project, Kotka
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Civil/ HVAC QA/QC Engineer to join our clients China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. team for the Kotka CAM Plant project.

China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. (CHEC) is a world-renowned international contractor and a leading provider of comprehensive services across the entire industrychain for both public and private sectors. CHEC has been engaged as the main contractor for the CAM Plant project in Kotka, responsible for the implementation and construction of the plant. The position is project-based, with an expected duration of approximately one year, and the work is located in Keltakallio, Kotka.

Your responsibilities include:

- Developing and implementing QA/QC procedures for structural and architectural works, including facades and fit-outs.
- Conducting site inspections to monitor the quality of materials, workmanship, and compliance with design specifications.
- Coordinating with construction teams, design consultants, and subcontractors to resolve quality-related issues.
- Preparing and maintain quality documentation, including ITPs, checklists, inspection records, and final handover documents.
- Ensuring all works meet Finnish regulatory standards and EU construction regulations.
- Assisting with permit compliance and project closeout procedures in accordance with Finnish authorities.
- Providing training and technical guidance to site personnel on QA/QC protocols and standards.
What we expect from you:

- Bachelors or masters degree in Civil Engineering, HVAC, or related discipline.
- Several years of experience in QA/QC roles for structural and architectural construction.
- Strong familiarity with Finnish building regulations, construction permit processes, and handover requirements.
- Good communication skills and strong coordination ability with design teams, contractors, and other stakeholders.
- Full professional proficiency in English.

The CAM Plant Project offers you a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in the green transition, and you will have the chance to develop professionally in a diverse and challengingenvironment.

The desired start date for the job is as soon as possible according to the agreement.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process or the role, please contact Barona Engineering Senior Consultant Katri Hyppänen at +358 50 439 9785. Available on Mon-Tue and Thu 10am-2pm. We will be interviewing applicants during the application period, so please apply for the position through the provided link. Kindly attach your English-language CV to your application. For privacy reasons, we do not accept applications via email or WhatsApp.

jobs.title: Bollinis in Hedehusene is looking for 2 full-time chefs!
jobs.description:
Do you have a flair for good food, and do you thrive in a kitchen with lots of life? We are extremely busy at Bollinis and are therefore looking for a skilled full-time chef to strengthen our team.

We are a cozy, restaurant located super centrally on the main street in Hedehusene - within walking distance of both the station and the bus.

 

About the job:

As a chef with us, you get an exciting and varied everyday life. We run a delicious but simple a la carte card for our regular guests. In addition, we often provide the framework for larger parties, where we put together a special, tailor-made menu. You will therefore have ample opportunity to work with different types of cooking and serving within different kitchens.

 

Working hours:

Your normal working hours will be within the hours of 10.00 and 22.00. We are open every day of the week with the exception of Monday, when we are always closed.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Have experience as a chef (preferably educated, but experience can also do it).

  • Can maintain an overview and deliver quality – even when there are many orders on the screen.

  • Is stable, responsible and a good colleague.

·         Cares about sending out food that you are proud of.

We offer:

  • A full-time position in a restaurant in good development.

  • A workplace with high ceilings and an informal tone.

·         Good, dedicated colleagues who pull together.

Is it you we are looking for?

Then we would love to hear from you by email!

We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and hire when we have found the right person.

We look forward to hearing from you!

There are 2 vacancies

jobs.title: Account Assistant
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an organised Account Assistant to support both our client account team and our day-to-day finance administration. You’ll help coordinate travel programmes while keeping booking and financial records accurate.

The role

  • Prepare proposals, itineraries, quotations, and client documents.

  • Liaise with clients, hotels, transport providers, and other suppliers.

  • Track booking details, supplier rates, payments, and deadlines.

  • Prepare and record client invoices and supplier bills.

  • Assist with accounts payable and receivable, including following up on outstanding payments.

  • Reconcile invoices, receipts, and booking records; flag any discrepancies.

  • Record expenses and organise financial documents for the finance team.

About you

  • You have a degree in Economics.

  • You communicate confidently in Thai and English, both spoken and written.

  • You have strong attention to detail and are comfortable working with numbers.

  • You can manage several tasks and deadlines while keeping accurate records.

  • You are confident using Microsoft Excel and willing to learn our booking and accounting systems.

Experience in bookkeeping, finance administration, tourism, or hospitality would be an advantage.

What we offer

  • A key role in a rapidly expanding international travel company

  • A multicultural, friednly work environment in central Copenhagen

  • Training and opportunities to grow within the DMC industry

  • A collaborative team and varied work across travel operations and finance

jobs.description:
As a Fullstack Engineer at Embark, you will be a Gamemaker in a technical team that builds and maintains internal tools that empower our game teams and improve the studio’s efficiency. Your role will directly support game development by creating solutions that automates and streamlines workflows, and provides valuable analytics. You will also be contributing to commercial projects like tools for monetization and customer support.

The team’s goal is to deliver scalable, user-friendly, and cost-efficient solutions that help our teams create dynamic and engaging player experiences. You’ll collaborate closely with game teams, data teams, and the commercial team, reporting to the Tech Lead in Commercial Tech.

As an integral part of a creative and autonomous team, you’ll contribute to high-quality tools and systems for both developers and players. For the frontend we use technologies like React, TypeScript and NextJS. For the backend we use Go, protobuf, Python, and OpenAPI.

Example of responsibilities


    Develop and improve internal tools for game teams and studio-wide use.
    Automate workflows to reduce manual effort and enhance efficiency.
    Build personalized store recommendation systems and tools.
    Continuously refine engineering practices to ensure services are easy to deploy, scale, and maintain.
    Collaborate with multiple teams to deliver tools and solutions that improve both developer and player experiences.

We would love if you have


    A creative and curious mind
    Solid experience with React, TypeScript, NextJS, Go, Python and the GCP stack.
    Proven ability to build internal data-driven tools and services.
    Experience deploying and maintaining services on cloud infrastructure.
    Strong background in analytics and data-driven tooling.
    Analytical mindset, self-driven and capable of taking projects from idea to implementation.
    Experience in the gaming industry or other consumer-facing products.
    Passion for games, interactive experiences and new technologies.
    Professional English communication skills.

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.

Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

jobs.title: Rakenna oma liiketoiminta Raumalla
jobs.description:
**Rakenna oma hoiva-alan liiketoiminta ja vaikuta paikallisesti - kannattavasti.**

Kotona Asuen Seniorihoiva on muuttamassa ikääntymisen kasvot Suomessa. Jo vuodesta 2008 olemme mahdollistaneet ikäihmisille turvallisen ja mielekkään arjen omassa kodissaan asuen ja rakentaneet samalla mahdollisuuksia kannattavaan liiketoimintaan paikallisille franchiseyrittäjille.

Etsimme nyt Raumalle liiketoiminta- ja yrittäjähenkistä franchiseyrittäjää, joka haluaa:

- Rakentaa, johtaa ja kehittää paikallista yritystä osana arvostettua ja pitkään toiminutta ketjua.

- Tehdä ihmisläheistä työtä, jolla on konkreettinen ja myönteinen vaikutus omalla alueella.


Hoiva-ala on tulevaisuuden ala, sillä senioreiden määrä Suomessa kasvaa nopeasti ja väestön ikärakenne on muuttumassa voimakkaasti. Yli 85-vuotiaiden määrä vähintään kaksinkertaistuu seuraavien parinkymmenen vuoden aikana, mikä lisää merkittävästi kotiin vietävien hoivapalvelujen tarvetta.

**Mitä hoiva-alan franchiseyrittäjyys käytännössä on?**

Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä vastaat oman alueesi liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta ja kannattavuudesta. Et tee hoivatyötä itse, vaan johdat ja rakennat tiimiäsi.

Vastuualueeseesi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- Liiketoiminnan johtaminen ja kehittäminen.

- Hoivanantajien rekrytointi ja perehdyttäminen.

- Paikallinen myynti ja markkinointi.

- Asiakassopimusten tekeminen ja asiakassuhteiden hoito.


Saat tueksesi valmiiksi testatun konseptin, ketjun täyden osaamisen, tunnetun brändin ja jatkuvan tuen arjen johtamiseen.

**Kenelle tämä sopii erityisesti?**

Tämä yrittäjyys sopii sinulle, jos:

- Sinulla on kokemusta myynnistä, markkinoinnista, johtamisesta, asiakkuuksista tai liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, tai vähintään vahva halu ja kyky kehittyä näillä alueilla.

- Sinua motivoi vastuu, vaikuttaminen ja oman työn tulokset.

- Haluat rakentaa yritystoimintaa ja taloudellista pääomaa pitkäjänteisesti.

- Arvostat merkityksellistä työtä, mutta ajattelet sitä myös liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta.

- Elämäntilanteesi ja taloudellinen tilanteesi mahdollistaa yritystoiminnan käynnistämiseen


Franchiseyrittäjämme tulevat hyvin erilaisista taustoista, ja ovat aiemmin toimineet esimerkiksi yrittäjinä, myynti-, asiantuntija- tai esihenkilötehtävissä.

**Paikallinen vaikuttaminen on osa liiketoimintaa**

Yrityksesi ei ole vain tuloslaskelma. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjänä:

- Luot omalla alueellasi työpaikkoja.

- Mahdollistat ikäihmisille arvokkaan arjen.

- Rakennat luottamukseen perustuvaa palvelua.

- Kasvatat liiketoimintaa, jolla on aidosti yhteiskunnallinen ja paikallinen merkitys.


**Mitä tarjoamme franchiseyrittäjälle?**

- Toimivan ja testatun konseptin.

- Tunnetun ja arvostetun brändin.

- Perusteellisen alkukoulutuksen ja jatkuvan tuen.

- Valmiit markkinoinnin ja myynnin työkalut.

- Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja ketjun parhaat käytännöt.


Olet vastuussa omasta menestyksestäsi, mutta et ole yksin. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan franchiseyrittäjyys on pitkäjänteinen tapa rakentaa menestyvää liiketoimintaa ja tulevaisuutta.

**Kiinnostuitko? Selvitetään yhdessä, sopiiko franchiseyrittäjyys sinulle. Ota yhteyttä ja sovitaan alkukeskustelu.**

Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen askel kohti omaa liiketoimintaa, jolla on sekä merkitystä että kasvupotentiaalia.

jobs.title: Responsable d'un petit site d'hébergement (type auberge) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Missions Générale :
- Assurer la gestion globale de l'hébergement
- Assurer l'organisation des activités sur la structure
- Assurer la promotion du site et sa lisibilité sur le territoire

Missions particulières :
Gestion ponctuelle de personnel
- Définir l'ensemble des besoins et des actions en fonction des périodes d'activité
- Participer au recrutement du personnel nécessaire à l'entretien des locaux
- Suivre les procédures de recrutement et transmission des données sociales mis en place par le siège

Gestion comptable :
- Engagement et suivi de dépenses courantes
- Suivre les budgets alloués

Restauration
- Etre capable d'assurer une restauration simple en veillant au respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité, qui peut aller d'un petit déjeuner à une pension complète pour le public accueilli
- Elaborer des menus adaptés au public accueilli
- Effectuer les commandes de denrées ou leur achat à proximité
- Assurer les relations avec les organismes de contrôle

Hébergement
- Élaborer le planning mensuel de l'entretien des locaux
- Veiller à l'hygiène et à la propreté des locaux et du matériel
- Assurer la blanchisserie du linge (actuellement en externe)
- Assurer le suivi du matériel (réparations, remise en état, achats courants, .)
- Assurer le suivi de l'entretien régulier du centre et de ses abords
- Assurer la réalisation ds travaux de remise en état
- Procéder aux inventaires réguliers du matériel
- Assurer la réalisation continue des aménagements liés à l'embellissement ou à une meilleure fonctionnalité des lieux
- Procéder aux approvisionnements nécessaires à l'exploitation des équipements (granules et gaz)
- Assurer l'accueil et les départs des groupes ou des individuels
- Organiser et mettre en œuvre l'ensemble des prestations vendues
- Assurer le respect de réglementation dans le cadre de l'accueil de public sur site (présence permanente sur place pour la sécurité)

Relations extérieures
- Créer et maintenir des partenariats sur le territoire
- Représenter et augmenter la notoriété de la structure

Maintien en conformité et sécurité des biens et bâtiments
- Organiser les contrôles de maintenance annuel

Commercialisation indirecte des équipements en lien avec le siège
- Assurer la promotion du site et des actions notamment la gestion des sites de réservations en ligne
- Formaliser les devis et les conventions en fonction des demandes
- Etablir la prospection nécessaire auprès des clients potentiels

Reporting et suivi
- Rendre compte régulièrement de son action et de celle des dispositifs auprès de son responsable
- Assurer la qualité et la performance des actions

Expériences :
- dans la restauration (cuisinier)
- dans la maintenance des locaux
- dans le management du personnel technique
- dans la gestion d'équipements type ERP
- dans la connaissance du milieu montagnard
- dans le domaine de l'animation

Compétences :
-savoir cuisiner
-sens de l'organisation
- gestionnaire
- rigueur
- relationnel
- sens des responsabilités
- capacité d'adaptation
- connaissance du secteur d'activité et de la gestion d'ERP
- acceptation de la vie en collectivité et du caractère saisonnier de l'activité

Les caractéristiques du poste :
Adaptation aux jours travaillés en amplitude et en nombre, nécessitant suivant les besoins de la structure de récupérer des journées ultérieurement, d'assurer l'ensemble des vacances scolaires estivales et hivernales d'où la prise des congés payés en dehors des périodes du 15 juin au 15 septembre et du 15 décembre au 15 mars.
Présence sur le lieu d'hébergement
Mutuelle d'entreprise
Avantages en nature : repas durant l'activité, hébergement sur place (appartement de fonction)

Prise de poste : entre octobre et novembre 2026

jobs.title: Sjukepleiar 100 % stilling ved Ørskog heimeteneste
jobs.description:
I distriktet Ørskog, har vi ledig  100 % fast stilling som sjukepleiarar i heimetenesten. Arbeid er på dag/kveld og med arbeid kvar 3.helg.
Verksemda har midlertidig økonomisk rekrutteringstiltak for sjukepleiarar.

Heimetenesten består av heimebuande i distriktet Ørskog, samt omsorgsbustader. Kontorbasen vår er lokalisert ved Steinholt Busenter. I same bygg har ein både Dagsenter for heimebuande frå Skodje og Ørskog, samt omsorgsleiligheter.
Heimetenesten har fleire brukarar som bur i omsorgsleiligheter, både ved Steinholt Busenter, men også Steinaplassen omsorgsbustader, som er lokalisert i same bygg som Ørskog omsorgssenter.  Vi har eit tett samarbeid med Ørskog omsorgssenter.

Vi yter tenester til heimebuande. Både til relativt friske brukarar, men også til alvorleg sjuke brukarar som krever høg fagleg kompetanse. Heimetenesten er opptatt av å yte gode og verdige tenester i brukarane sitt eige og trygge miljø. Vi nyttar ein del velferdsteknologisk utstyr. Dette som støtte og hjelp for å kunne gi brukarane meir friheit til å bu trygt heime.
I tenesten blir det nytta kommunale bilar som står under carport
ved kontorbasen.

Ørskog er eit distrikt med nærleik til både natur og det urbane strøk. I nærområdet kan ein både finne flotte turmoglegheiter, både lette og meir utfordrande. Ein har butikk og shopping i nærleiken, både på Digernes, Moa og Ålesund sentrum.

Lokalmiljøet i distriktet Ørskog har elles mykje å by på. Barne og ungdomsskule, barnehage, dagligvarebutikkar, mange tilbod innan idrett og kultur, osv.
Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Sikre at pasientar får nødvendig helsehjelp og tenester av god kvalitet i tråd med gjeldande lover, avtalar og retningslinjer
  • Observasjon, kartlegging, iverksetting av tiltak og dokumentasjon i pasientjournal (Helseplattformen)
  • Legemiddelhåndtering, medisinsk behandling og oppfølging
  • Rettleiing av pasientar, pårørande, kollegaer og studentar
  • Bidra til kvardagsmeistring og auka livskvalitet hos pasientar
  • Fremje godt tverrfagleg samarbeid med koordinerings- og tildelingskontor, lege, fysio- og ergoterapeut og anna helsepersonell
  • Samarbeide tett med pårørande og interne/eksterne aktøra
  • Bidra til utvikling, engasjement og fagleg oppdatering på arbeidsplassen
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Autorisasjon som sjukepleiar
  • 3.års sjukepleiestudentar kan søke, men med forbehold om godkjent autorisasjon
  • Relevant erfaring er ein fordel
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne. Krav om norsk språkferdigheit tilsvarande B2 munnleg og skriftleg (Europarådet sin nivåskala - CEFR)
  • Beherske IKT-verktøy
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Ved tilsetjing krevst politiattest, MRSA- og TBC-eigenerklæringar
  • Aktuelle kandidater må ha norsk personnummer eller gyldig D-nummer og formidle dette til arbeidsgiver i god tid før oppstart i jobben.
  • Det forutsettes at den som skal ansettes kan bekrefte sikker identitet i form av gyldig pass (internasjonalt) eller nasjonalt ID-kort (EU/EØS).
  • Det kreves også at personlig bankid eller idporten kan benyttes som alternativ innlogging mot ulike digitale løsninger ved behov (Helseplattformen, OTTO-app mm)
    Personlege eigenskapar
    • Trygg, tydeleg og engasjert, med fokus på pasienten
    • Løysingsorientert, fleksibel og glad i nye utfordringar
    • Sjølvstendig og samarbeidsorientert
    • Bidrar til eit godt arbeidsmiljø
    • Nytenkande og endringsvillig
    • Personlege eigenskaper blir vektlagt
    Vi tilbyr
    • Ein interessant arbeidskvardag med varierte og utfordrande oppgåver i eit godt arbeidsmiljø
    • Et støttende og engasjert kollegialt miljø
    • Fagleg påfyll og moglegheit for vidareutdanning etter verksemda sitt behov
    • Løn og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldande tariff
    • Pensjonsordning i henhold til tariff
    • Bedriftshelsetjeneste
    • IA bedrift
    KontaktinformasjonMaren Langlo Kongsnes, Avdelingsleiar, 950 65 938, maren.langlo.kongsnes@alesund.kommune.no
    Linn Evy Abelseth Søvik, Verksemdsleiar, 906 84 106, linn.evy.abelseth.sovik@alesund.kommune.no
    ArbeidsstadSteinholtvegen 6
    6240 Ørskog
    Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Ålesund kommune

    Referansenr.: 5172534604
    Stillingsprosent: 100%
    Fast
    Søknadsfrist: 11.10.2026

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim med ca. 60 000 innbyggere 

    Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikkje minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygd» på fiske og fangst. Framleis er Ålesundregionen er verdsleiande på det marine og maritime området. Fleire av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskap held til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Noregs største cruisehamn, største fiskerihamn og nest største containerhamn. Vi er og Noregs største eksporthamn på fiskeriprodukter. 

    Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tal frå 2016 viser at det årleg er rundt to millionar passasjerer som går av eller på ein buss eller båt i Ålesund.  
    Ålesund by er viden kjend for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykkingar møter deg som går gatelangs der.
    Byen ligg som ein døropnar til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekk seg heilt nord til Ona utanfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjonar i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjordar og natur rett utanfor stovedøra. 
    Vi er ein universitetskommune og har eit nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finn du òg Ålesund framtidslab - U4SSC ip.  

    Kommunen er ein stor arbeidsgjevar med sine over 4.400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidarar som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglege arbeidet vektlegg vi verdiane våre: open, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».
    Ønsker du ein meiningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrande oppgåver, er Ålesund kommune eit spennande alternativ.

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

  • Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

  • Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

  • Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

  • Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

  • Experience working with Yocto

  • Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

  • Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: Workshop Assistant, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish technology company and a global leader in cryogenic measurement systems used in quantum computing research. Their Helsinki workshop is where precision materials meet cutting-edge science - and they need someone like you to keep it running.

As a Workshop Assistant, you'll handle real materials - copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel - and cut them to exact measurements using modern ERP systems. Full training is provided, so you don't need prior experience to get started.

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (4 months) with day shifts and a 40-hour work week. It's a great entry point into industrial work at a company that genuinely stands out.

YOUR TASKS

You'll be working as a Workshop Assistant at Bluefors Oy's Helsinki facility, employed through Barona Teollisuus Oy. Your day-to-day work keeps the workshop stocked, organised, and running smoothly.

- Receiving, inspecting, and storing incoming raw materials
- Cutting materials - copper, stainless steel (AISI 316), brass, aluminium, and POM plastic - to specified dimensions using workshop tools
- Reading and following cutting instructions from the ERP system
- Maintaining accurate inventory records and stock levels
- Keeping the workshop tidy and organised
- Handling parts ranging from 12 mm to 360 mm in diameter

REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to follow precise technical instructions carefully and accurately
- Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for your tasks
- Good practical hands-on skills
- Willingness to learn - full training is provided

NICE TO HAVE

- Previous experience in a warehouse or industrial environment
- Forklift licence (trukkikortti)
- Familiarity with ERP systems or similar tools

You will be employed with Barona Teollisuus Oy for 4 month fixed-term employment contract. The work starts as agreed, no later than in the beginning of November. This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week in a day shift.

Apply via application form. We are handling the applications already before the application deadline closes and the role will be fulfilled as soon as the right candidate is found. Please note, that applications sent via email are not taken into account.

jobs.title: Customs Specialist (Europe)
jobs.description:
Location: Fully remote in Europe

Working Hours: Mon - Fri, 9AM - 6PM

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our Mission 🎯

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

About the Role 🤔

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform

  • Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product

  • Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework

  • Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found

  • Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately

  • Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission

  • Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane

  • Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping

  • Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)

  • Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Extensive US import-export experience is required.

  • Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume

  • Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy

  • Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook

  • Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally

jobs.title: Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope

  3. Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution

  4. Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS).

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members.

  6. Reference checks

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

Vi skaper et contemporary kjøkken hvor autentiske afrikanske smaker står i sentrum, og hvor kvalitet, håndverk og gode gjesteopplevelser er avgjørende.

Nå søker vi en erfaren og faglig sterk Soussjef som ønsker å være med fra starten.

Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring fra profesjonelle kjøkken, høy faglig kompetanse og et sterkt ønske om å dele kunnskapen din med andre. Du skal ikke bare være en dyktig kokk – du skal være en person teamet kan lære av, stole på og utvikle seg sammen med.

Det er en stor fordel om du har tidligere erfaring med eller god kjennskap til afrikansk mat og matkultur. Du må også trives i et kjøkken med høyt tempo, kunne holde hodet kaldt under travle serviceperioder og samtidig opprettholde høy kvalitet, struktur og presisjon.

Som Soussjef blir du kjøkkensjefens høyre hånd og en viktig del av den daglige driften. Du vil få en sentral rolle i å bygge opp kjøkkenet, etablere gode rutiner og bidra til å utvikle både maten og menneskene rundt deg.

Ansvarsområder / arbeidsoppgaver

  • Være kjøkkensjefens høyre hånd og en faglig sterk ressurs i den daglige driften.

  • Ha en aktiv og tydelig rolle under service og sikre god flyt, struktur og kvalitet.

  • Lede og følge opp kjøkkenteamet på en profesjonell og motiverende måte.

  • Sikre at alle retter holder høy standard når det gjelder smak, teknikk, presentasjon og kvalitet.

  • Bidra til utvikling av menyer, retter, oppskrifter og kjøkkenets faglige uttrykk.

  • Dele din kunnskap og erfaring aktivt med resten av teamet.

  • Trene, veilede og utvikle kokker på ulike nivåer.

  • Bidra til å etablere gode arbeidsmetoder, rutiner og standarder fra oppstart.

  • Ha kontroll på råvarekvalitet, bestillinger, vareflyt og lager.

  • Bidra til god kostnadskontroll og redusert matsvinn.

  • Sikre at rutiner for hygiene, IK-mat og HACCP følges.

  • Ta ansvar for kjøkkenet i kjøkkensjefens fravær.

  • Bidra til å skape et profesjonelt, respektfullt og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Har du erfaringen og kompetansen vi ser etter?

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har flere års erfaring fra profesjonelle kjøkken, gjerne som Soussjef, kjøkkensjef eller i en annen ledende kjøkkenrolle.

  • har tidligere erfaring med eller god kjennskap til afrikansk mat og matkultur.

  • Har solid faglig kompetanse og svært gode matfaglige ferdigheter.

  • Har god forståelse for råvarer, teknikker, smak, kvalitet og presentasjon.

  • Er trygg i lederrollen og har erfaring med å lede et kjøkkenteam.

  • Har kunnskap du ønsker å dele, og trives med å lære opp og utvikle andre.

  • Er en naturlig faglig rollemodell og leder gjennom både kunnskap og eksempel.

  • Har høye krav til kvalitet og detaljer.

  • Er strukturert, selvstendig og løsningsorientert.

  • Beholder roen og oversikten i et hektisk kjøkkenmiljø.

  • Har god forståelse for økonomi, kostnadskontroll og matsvinn.

  • Er nysgjerrig og åpen for nye råvarer, teknikker og mattradisjoner.

  • Har et sterkt ønske om å være med på å bygge noe fra grunnen av.

Det viktigste for oss er ikke bare hva du kan - men også hva du kan lære bort.

Vi tilbyr

  • En sentral rolle i oppstarten av et helt nytt restaurantkonsept.

  • Muligheten til å være med på å forme kjøkkenet fra første dag.

  • Stor påvirkningskraft på kjøkkenets kultur, rutiner og faglige utvikling.

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med et spennende konsept som kombinerer afrikanske smaker med nordiske og franske teknikker.

  • Et profesjonelt og ambisiøst arbeidsmiljø.

  • Mulighet til å utvikle både deg selv og andre.

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser.

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter.

  • Ansattfordeler i Thon Gruppen.

Er du en erfaren kokk med sterk faglig kompetanse, gode lederegenskaper og et ønske om å dele kunnskapen din med andre?

Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Velkommen til FiftyFour - velkommen til å bygge noe nytt sammen med oss.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

jobs.title: Kiinteistöhuoltomies/talomestari
jobs.description:
Työhösi kuuluu kiinteistön kunnossapito- ja korjaustyöt sekä muut erilaiset kiinteistönhoitoon liittyvät tehtävät. Työssäsi tarvitset nopeaa reagointikykyä vaihtelevien tehtävien parissa, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä palvelualttiutta asiakkaiden kanssa. Tulet toimeen hyvin ihmisten kanssa mutta osaat työskennellä itsenäisesti. Toimintaamme ohjaa energiatehokkuuden tavoittelu, uusiutuvan energian käyttö, hiilijalanjäljen pienentäminen, ympäristöystävällisyys sekä päällimmäisenä asiakastyytyväisyys. Tukenasi on ammattitaitoinen tiimi ja perehdytämme sinut tuleviin työtehtäviin.

Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työn, kilpailukykyisen palkan, hyvät henkilöstöedut, kouluttautumisen mahdollisuudet sekä kattavat työterveyspalvelut.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

Join Global Finance Operations and help secure reliable accounting and reporting for Scania's production and logistics operations. Our Production and Logistics Accounting and Reporting team is responsible for record-to-report activities for 18 units and is supporting the transition from Oracle to SAP S/4HANA.

As Senior Accountant, you will own the accounting and reporting for one Swedish legal entity within Production and Logistics. You will combine hands-on accounting with stakeholder coordination and continuous improvement. You are not expected to know every Scania process from day one, but we expect you to take ownership, build the necessary business knowledge and resolve deviations in a structured way.

Job responsibiities

•        Own the monthly, quarterly and annual accounting close and reporting for the designated Swedish legal entity, ensuring complete, accurate and timely reporting.

•        Ensure compliance with IFRS, Group requirements and applicable Swedish statutory accounting requirements, coordinating with Tax specialists on relevant tax matters.

•        Ensure that balance sheet reconciliations, key financial controls and supporting documentation are completed, reviewed and followed up, with differences and control exceptions resolved on time.

•        Secure accounting quality across general accounting and reporting, fixed assets, overhead and cost-center accounting, and project accounting, in cooperation with the responsible process teams.

•        Act as the primary accounting contact for the legal entity, working with auditors, Group Reporting, Tax specialists and relevant finance and business control teams.

•        Coordinate accounting interfaces, including payroll and personnel-related postings, and ensure that exceptional transactions follow established approval and control procedures.

•        Analyze accounting deviations, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions and process improvements with the responsible process owners.

•        Represent accounting and legal-entity requirements in the Oracle-to-SAP S/4HANA transformation, including testing, data validation, cutover and process implementation.

•        Share accounting knowledge and provide technical guidance to colleagues and process teams when required.



Who You Are

You demonstrate strong accounting knowledge, ownership and sound judgment. You have substantial experience with end-to-end accounting and reporting for a Swedish legal entity, including closing, balance sheet control, statutory reporting and coordination with tax and audit specialists. You understand the business impact of accounting issues, communicate them clearly and proactively raise risks and deviations. You share knowledge and challenge unclear ways of working respectfully.

You Need to Bring

•        A university degree in accounting or finance, or an equivalent professional qualification.

•        At least seven years of relevant experience in accounting and financial reporting, including responsibility for a Swedish legal entity.

•        Strong knowledge of Swedish GAAP and statutory requirements, together with practical experience of IFRS and group reporting.

•        Proven experience of independently coordinating monthly, quarterly and annual closing, including balance sheet reconciliations, statutory reporting and audit support.

•        Hands-on experience with a major ERP system, such as Oracle or SAP.

•        Clear and confident communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

We Also Value That You

•        Communicate accounting matters clearly and build effective working relationships across functions.

•        Work calmly and methodically under time pressure, prioritizing issues according to risk, materiality and deadlines.

•        Take a constructive and service-minded approach while safeguarding accounting quality and compliance.

•        Identify root causes, solve problems and turn practical improvements into more efficient and standardized ways of working.

•        Is curiosity about how AI and digital tools can support accounting, reporting and analysis.

It Is an Advantage If You Have

•        Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation, testing or transformation.

•        Experience using data, automation or AI tools to improve accounting and reporting.



This Is Us

You will join a team of 10 skilled and experienced colleagues who value collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

At Scania, we believe embracing AI is essential for our continued growth and innovation. We are committed to providing our employees with the latest AI tools and fostering an environment where AI skills are encouraged. You don't need prior experience with AI - but we expect curiosity, openness and a positive attitude toward learning and applying AI in your role.

We work closely with local finance departments, finance managers, business control teams, Global Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts and other specialists across Global Finance Operations.

Together, we support each other, challenge existing ways of working and contribute to Scania's finance transformation.





Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.



Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-08. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Hiring Manager: claes.back.ahlstrom@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Erityisryhmien liikunnanohjaaja (määräaikainen sijaisuus)
jobs.description:
Lapuan kaupungin kasvatuksen, koulutuksen ja vapaa-ajan toimialan liikuntatoimi hakee erityisryhmien liikunnanohjaajaa määräaikaiseen työsopimussuhteeseen työvapaan sijaisuudeksi ajalle 19.10.2026-30.6.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Erityisryhmien liikunnanohjaajan keskeisiin tehtäviin kuuluu soveltavan liikunnan ohjaustoiminta ja elintapaneuvonta sekä suunnittelu, organisointi ja kehittäminen eri-ikäisille liikkujille sekä alan tiedotus- ja neuvontatehtävät. Tehtävä sisältää matalan kynnyksen yksilöllistä liikuntaneuvontaa ja ryhmänohjausta sekä palveluketjujen koordinointia ja yhdyspintayhteistyötä sivistys- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden, hyvinvointialueen terveys- ja sosiaalipalveluiden sekä paikallisten järjestöjen kanssa. Tehtäväkokonaisuuteen sisältyy lisäksi soveltavan liikunnan tapahtumien järjestämistä, asiakasviestintää eri kanavissa sekä mahdollisia asiakaspalvelu- ja opiskelijan ohjauksen tehtäviä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään käytännön kokemusta soveltavan liikunnan ja toimintarajoitteisten liikkujien ryhmien ohjaamisesta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä itsenäistä ja kehittävää työotetta. Kokemus elintapaohjauksesta/ liikuntaneuvonnasta, sovelletun vesiliikunnan, erityisuimakoulujen ja vauvauintien ohjaamisesta katsotaan hakijalle eduksi. Työn liikkuvan luonteen vuoksi tehtävässä edellytetään oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.
Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on soveltuva liikunta- tai terveysalan korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi soveltuva ammatillinen perustutkinto.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen yleisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (KVTES) mukaisesti ja viikkotyöaika on yleistyöajan mukainen 38,25 tuntia. Työaikaan sisältyy tarvittaessa ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä tilaisuuksien ja ryhmäaikataulujen mukaan.

Tehtäväkohtainen tasopalkka on Lapuan kaupungin vapaa-aikapalveluiden tasopalkkajärjestelmän ryhmän 2VAP50A1 mukaisesti 2 559,91 euroa kuukaudessa ja lisäksi maksetaan mahdollinen KVTES:n mukainen työkokemuslisä.

Tehtävässä noudatetaan työsopimuslain 1 luvun 7 §:n mukaista koeaikaa, joka on enintään puolet määräaikaisen sopimuksen kestosta eli korkeintaan neljä kuukautta. Valitun henkilön on ennen toimen vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan sekä lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Hakemukset ja ansioluettelot toimitetaan sähköisesti Kuntarekry-järjestelmän kautta osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi viimeistään maanantaina 12.10.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä.

jobs.title: French-speaking babysitter (Part-Time) – Stockholm
jobs.description:
Looking for a fun and meaningful job? Do you love working with children and speaking French?

We are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and creative French-speaking babysitters to join our team in Stockholm.

At Upgrades, we offer a unique concept where pedagogy and development of the French language are at the heart of the babysitting.

We currently have assignments available throughout Stockholm, including Central Stockholm, Lidingö, Täby, and several other areas.

Our assignments

Upgrades offers French language focused childcare in several different forms, ranging from occasional help to spending many hours with the family and becoming like an additional family member.

Based on your preference regarding age and number of children, we match you with a suitable family.

Please note that this is a part-time position and you are therefore expected to have another primary occupation.

If employed as a babysitter at Upgrades, you will be required to provide a criminal record extract.

What You'll Do

The work includes picking up the child or children from preschool or school, basic food preparation, play and activities while maintaining a focus on French language development.

Each session is a minimum of 2.5 hours and you can combine several assignments to increase your total working hours per week.

Some of our assignments require a clean driving licence, so please state this in your application.

Your profile

As a babysitter at Upgrades, you are warm, responsible, and genuinely enjoy working with children. You are playful, dedicated, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative. You also bring creative ideas for incorporating French into play and everyday interactions, supporting children’s language development in a natural way.

Requirements

    Native-level or full professional proficiency in French
    Excellent sense of responsibility and child safety
    Strong social and interpersonal skills
    Genuinely interested in childcare and pedagogy
    Positive, dedicated, flexible, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative
    Swedish and/or English are not required, but are considered an advantage.

About Upgrades

Upgrades offers tailored language lessons, language camps and language-focused childcare. We combine standard babysitting with a strong focus on language development. Visit our website to learn more: www.upgrades.se

We recruit on a regular basis. Note: The position may therefore be filled before the application deadline.

Submit your resume and cover letter to work@upgrades.se

jobs.title: A la Carte Chef – Rovaniemi
jobs.description:
À la Carte Chef – Rovaniemi

The winter season in Lapland means a lively atmosphere, international guests and busy restaurant service. We are now looking for an **À la Carte Chef to join a restaurant team in Rovaniemi for the full winter season.**

You don't need to speak Finnish – **English is the working language in the kitchen.** What you do need is previous experience in an à la carte kitchen and the confidence to work efficiently during busy service.

What is the job like?

This is not just a short seasonal position. Work is available **from November until March**, with approximately **90 working hours per 3 weeks**.

You will be working in an à la carte kitchen as part of an international team. The winter season can get busy, so previous experience in a professional restaurant kitchen is important.

What are we looking for?

**À la carte experience, good English skills and a positive attitude towards work.**

You will also need a valid Hygiene Passport and the flexibility to work different shifts.

Salary is based on the **Finnish hospitality industry collective agreement and your previous experience**. Assistance with **accommodation** can also be provided if needed.

**Would you like to spend the winter working in Rovaniemi?**

Send us your application and tell us briefly about your previous kitchen experience.

**Applications: rekrytointi@duunaamo.fi**

jobs.title: Work part-time: English-speaking babysitter, Stockholm
jobs.description:
Looking for a fun and meaningful job? Do you love working with children and speaking English?

We are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and creative English-speaking babysitters to join our team in Stockholm. We offer a unique concept where pedagogy and development of the English language are at the heart of the babysitting.

Our assignments

Upgrades offers English language focussed babysitting in several different forms, ranging from occasional help to spending many hours with the family and becoming like an additional family member. Based on your preference regarding age and number of children, we match you with a suitable family.

The work includes picking up the child or children from preschool or school, basic food preparation, play and activities while maintaining a focus on English language development. Each session is a minimum of 2.5 hours and you can combine several assignments to increase your total working hours per week.

Some of our assignments require a clean driving licence, so please state this in your application.

Please note that this is a part-time position, and you are therefore expected to have another primary occupation. If employed as a babysitter at Upgrades, you will be required to provide a criminal record extract.

Your profile

As a babysitter at Upgrades, you are warm, responsible, and genuinely enjoy working with children. You are playful, dedicated, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative. You also bring creative ideas for incorporating English into play and everyday interactions, supporting children’s language development in a natural way.

Requirements

    Native-level or full professional proficiency in English
    Excellent sense of responsibility and child safety
    Strong social and interpersonal skills
    Genuinely interested in childcare and pedagogy
    Positive, dedicated, flexible, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative
    Swedish and/or other languages are not required, but are considered an advantage.

About Upgrades

Upgrades offers tailored language lessons, language camps and language-focused childcare. We combine standard babysitting with a strong focus on language development. Visit our website to learn more: www.upgrades.se

We recruit on a regular basis. Note: The position may therefore be filled before the application deadline.

Submit your resume and cover letter to work@upgrades.se

jobs.title: LÄHIHOITAJIA yli 18v. omaishoidon vapaan sijaistukseen
jobs.description:
Etsimme nyt Lahden tiimiimme (Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueelle) lähihoitajia yli 18-vuotiaiden sekä yli 65-vuotiaiden omaishoidon vapaiden tuurauksiin. Omaishoitajan työtä tehdään suurella sydämellä, mutta työ on usein vaativaa ja omaishoitajakin tarvitsee hengähdystaukoja työstään. Työlläsi autat omaishoitajia jaksamaan ja huolehdit hoidettavasta omaishoitajan lakisääteisten vapaiden ajan. Työ on keikkaluontoista ja asiakkaat voivat vaihdella nuoresta aikuisesta iäkkäisiin. Asiakkainasi ovat oman osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan myös kehitysvammaiset ja muut erityistä tukea tarvitsevat. Emme kuitenkaan lähetä sinua kenen tahansa luokse, vaan saat itse valita asiakkaasi oman osaamisesi perusteella.

Meillä työskentelet asiakasperheissä, joiden asiakkuus kestää yksittäisistä vuoroista useisiin kuukausiin. Pääsääntöisesti yksi työvuoro kestää kerrallaan 2-4 tuntia 1-2 kertaa viikossa. Työtä on tarjolla arkisin klo 7-21 välillä, sekä lauantaisin klo 8-18 välillä. Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti asiakasperheidemme omissa kodeissa, sekä kotien ympäristössä esimerkiksi ulkoillen tai kaupassa asioiden.

Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä osaamista perheiden aitoon kohtaamiseen. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy ammatillista kokemusta joko iäkkäistä, vammaisista tai muuten erityistarpeisista asiakkaista. Meiltä saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen työhösi. Mikäli työ lapsiperheiden parissa kiinnostaa myös, kerrothan meille. Tarjoamme keikkaluontoista työtä myös alle 18-vuotiaiden omaishoidon vapaiden sijaistuksen ja lapsiperheiden kotipalvelun parissa!
