jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.

Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.title: Infrastructure & Security Lead
jobs.description:
About Luo

 

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

 

After becoming a leading player in a few markets in record time, we are looking to grow our engineering team and keep expanding the financial infrastructure for FX and cross-border payments in Africa.

 

Role overview

 

As Infrastructure & Security Lead, you will join a small team of experienced engineers and be responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure and its security controls. You will work directly with our CTO to build the foundations that keep LuoPay secure, reliable, and compliant as we scale. The scope covers our GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tooling, as well as the security and compliance program that regulators, partners, and customers depend on.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Analyze our infrastructure and map security risks.

  • Write clear, concise design documents to share infrastructure targets with the rest of the engineering team.

  • Use Terraform to evolve our GCP infrastructure.

  • Use GCP-native security tooling to protect our network, services and databases within GCP.

  • Automate security testing within our delivery pipelines.

  • Research and onboard new tools to improve our reliability and security posture.

  • Work alongside our CTO to implement our security and compliance framework.

 

What we are looking for

  • 10+ years of tech engineering experience

  • Strong experience building cloud infrastructure, managing cloud security and writing Terraform code.

  • Experience within GCP is highly appreciated, though we value fundamental engineering skills over any knowledge of a specific tech stack.

  • Strong appetite for security focused technical work.

  • Wide technical curiosity and willingness to contribute to many different parts of our stack: IAM, networking, governance, CI/CD, observability, APIs and web security.

  • Previous experience working in small, fast-paced teams.

  • Previous experience building cloud infrastructure within a regulated industry is appreciated.

  • Previous experience participating in the implementation of ISO27001 or SOC2 compliance is appreciated.

 

Why join us

  • Play a key role in building the fintech infrastructure that unlocks international payments for businesses in Africa.

projecten binnen de gestelde randvoorwaarden.



Wij zijn een multidisciplinair ingenieurs- en adviesbureau, gespecialiseerd in elektrotechniek en werktuigbouwkunde, gevestigd te Maastricht Airport. We verzorgen de complete engineering en het projectmanagement voor complexe technische vraagstukken in de industrie en de (semi-)overheid.

jobs.title: Onderhoudsmedewerker / Klusser Universiteit Tilburg (vacature voor doelgroep Banenafspraak)
jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met praktisch onderhoudswerk en vind je het leuk om ervoor te zorgen dat gebouwen en ruimtes netjes en goed blijven functioneren? Dan sluit jouw ervaring goed aan bij deze functie.

Je hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als huismeester, conciërge, klusser, facilitair medewerker, technisch medewerker of in een vergelijkbare functie waarin je praktische werkzaamheden uitvoerde. Je bent gewend om kleine reparaties te doen, problemen op te lossen en ervoor te zorgen dat spullen, ruimtes en gebouwen goed onderhouden blijven.

Je hebt ervaring met werkzaamheden zoals het oplossen van kleine storingen, repareren van meubels en inventaris, ophangen van materialen, vervangen van onderdelen en het uitvoeren van verschillende klussen in en rondom gebouwen. Je vindt het leuk om afwisselend werk te doen en pakt verschillende werkzaamheden zelfstandig op.

Je kunt goed luisteren naar opdrachten en werkt netjes en zorgvuldig. Je ziet wat er moet gebeuren en vindt het belangrijk dat de studenten, medewerkers en bezoekers zich prettig en veilig voelen in de gebouwen van Tilburg University.

Ervaring met facilitaire werkzaamheden, gebouwbeheer, onderhoud van scholen, kantoren of andere gebouwen is een voordeel. Een technische opleiding is niet het belangrijkste; jouw praktische ervaring, motivatie en bereidheid om nieuwe dingen te leren zijn belangrijk.

Een rijbewijs B is vereist, omdat je met een servicewagentje over het campusterrein rijdt.

Werk jij graag met je handen en vind je het leuk om ervoor te zorgen dat gebouwen goed blijven functioneren? Dan is deze functie bij Tilburg University misschien iets voor jou.

Als onderhoudsmedewerker help je mee om de campus netjes, veilig en prettig te houden voor de duizenden studenten, medewerkers en bezoekers. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat kleine (technische) problemen worden opgelost en dat ruimtes en voorzieningen goed blijven werken.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag loop je controlerondes door de gebouwen en voer je kleine reparaties uit. De andere dag los je een storing op, help je bij onderhoudswerkzaamheden of ondersteun je bij een evenement. Je werkt vaak zelfstandig, maar kunt altijd overleggen met je collega's.

Je ziet direct het resultaat van je werk: een gebouw dat goed functioneert en een omgeving waarin mensen prettig kunnen werken en studeren. Heb jij technische aanleg, ben je handig en vind je het leuk om verschillende praktische werkzaamheden uit te voeren? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.

Deze vacature is bedoeld voor kandidaten uit de doelgroep Banenafspraak of kandidaten die via de praktijkroute een DGR-indicatie kunnen verkrijgen.

jobs.description:

Wat ga je doen?
Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je zorgt ervoor dat bouwplaatsen netjes, veilig en schoon blijven, zodat vakmensen hun werk goed kunnen uitvoeren en projecten strak worden opgeleverd. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
Opruimen en schoonhouden van bouwplaatsen;
Uitvoeren van bouw- en opleveringsschoonmaak;
Verwijderen van bouwafval en stof;
Schoonmaken van ruimtes voordat deze worden opgeleverd;
Bijdragen aan een veilige en overzichtelijke werkomgeving.


Onze ambitie is samen met u telkens weer de juiste match te vinden. Een goede verstandhouding tussen ons en u als werkgever of werkzoekende is daarbij van groot belang en essentieel voor het duidelijk in beeld krijgen van elkaars wensen en verwachtingen. Daarnaast zullen wij ons uiterste best doen u waar mogelijk te ondersteunen, begeleiden en van de juiste informatie te voorzien. Door intensief contact te onderhouden met beide partijen zijn wij in staat ons te onderscheiden. Een perfecte match begint tenslotte bij het verkrijgen en verstrekken van de juiste informatie zodat wij vervolgens onze deskundigheid hier op toe kunnen passen. Wij zijn op zoek naar partners die dezelfde denkwijze hebben en net als wij gaan voor kwaliteit, openheid en persoonlijke betrokkenheid.

jobs.title: Coördinator Dagbesteding Geelbroekerweg Hooghalen
jobs.description:
Als coördinator dagbesteding begeleid en ondersteun je bewoners met een intensieve begeleidingsvraag in hun dagelijks leven. Je coördineert de dagbesteding, vertaalt de doelen uit het persoonlijk plan naar passende activiteiten en stemt deze af met de persoonlijk begeleider, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de gedragsdeskundige. Binnen de Cirkel combineer je het werken op de dagbesteding met het werken op de woonlocatie. Zo zorg je samen met je collega's voor continuïteit, verbinding tussen wonen en dagbesteding en een eenduidige begeleidingsstijl.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, behandelaren, verwanten en andere betrokkenen. Je stimuleert bewoners in hun ontwikkeling, zelfredzaamheid en maatschappelijke participatie, rapporteert over de voortgang en denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van nieuwe activiteiten. Je werkt onregelmatige diensten en draagt iedere dag bij aan een veilige, gestructureerde en betekenisvolle leef- en werkomgeving.

Samen met je collega's maak je iedere dag het verschil voor bewoners die behoefte hebben aan duidelijkheid, structuur en een omgeving waarin zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan een betekenisvolle dag voor mensen met een intensieve ondersteuningsvraag? Een van onze collega's zet een mooie volgende stap binnen Vanboeijen. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe coördinator dagbesteding die samen met ons het verschil wil maken voor onze bewoners.

Op de locatie Geelbroekerweg in Hooghalen bied je samen met je collega's een veilige, prikkelarme omgeving aan jongvolwassenen en volwassenen met complexe zorgvragen en moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Wonen en dagbesteding zijn hier onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden. In een warme en huiselijke omgeving lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan een waardevolle, voorspelbare en betekenisvolle dag voor de bewoners.

jobs.title: Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting Assen
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting ben je verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van diverse complexe facilitaire projecten binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteitseisen. Het gaat om strategische, Vanboeijen-brede facilitaire projecten met een afdeling overstijgend karakter. Dit kan variëren van een huisvestingsproject tot een project voor het optimaliseren van het FMIS-systeem.

Je komt met verbetervoorstellen en bent betrokken bij het optimaliseren van facilitaire werkprocessen. Je schrijft beleidsnotities en treedt op als projectleider bij complexe projecten. Daarnaast neem je deel aan diverse werkgroepen en projectteams, denk je mee over verschillende vraagstukken en oplossingen en geef je huisvestingsadvies.

Als Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de totstandkoming en uitvoering van de projectenkalender voor verbouw- en nieuwbouwprojecten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de bouwkundige projectleiders. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met de facilitaire adviseurs, die goed weten wat er op de zorglocaties nodig is om de bewoners een prettige en veilige omgeving te bieden om te wonen en/of te werken.

Na afronding van een project zorg je voor een goede overdracht aan de beheerorganisatie. Je bent proactief en ondernemend en weet onverwachte ontwikkelingen te vertalen naar concrete projecten. Daarbij zoek je actief de verbinding binnen en buiten de facilitaire afdeling.

Je standaard werkplek is Assen. In overleg is thuiswerken ook goed mogelijk.

Wil jij jouw ervaring met facilitaire dienstverlening en projectmanagement inzetten voor projecten die echt impact hebben? Als Projectleider Facilitair en Huisvesting werk je aan uiteenlopende, complexe projecten binnen Vanboeijen. Van huisvestingsprojecten tot het optimaliseren van het FMIS systeem jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteitseisen worden gerealiseerd. Daarbij verbind je verschillende disciplines en zorg je ervoor dat de facilitaire dienstverlening steeds beter aansluit bij wat nodig is voor de bewoners en medewerkers.

Vanboeijen ondersteunt ruim 700 kinderen, jongeren, volwassenen en ouderen met een verstandelijke beperking in Drenthe en omgeving. Met ongeveer 1600 medewerkers wordt dagelijks gewerkt vanuit de missie Goed leven, Mooi werk, Met elkaar.

jobs.title: Omscholing tot instructeur
jobs.description:
Ben jij een doorgewinterde chauffeur met een passie voor je vak en beschik je over een geldig Rijbewijs C of CE? Wil je jouw kennis en ervaring inzetten om collega s naar een hoger niveau te tillen, terwijl je zelf actief blijft in de wereld van transport? Dan is deze unieke kans iets voor jou!

Ben jij gemotiveerd, zelfstandig en heb je passie voor de Vietnamese keuken? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Ben jij de accountmanager die nieuwe kansen om zet naar langdurige relaties? Lees dan snel verder.

G-Nius zoekt een enthousiaste accountmanager:

Als Account Manager ben je commercieel gedreven, ondernemend, energiek, verkoop- en resultaatgericht. Daarbij beschik je over een flinke dosis doorzettingsvermogen. Je bent een verbinder, je genereert ideeën en zoekt naar creatieve mogelijkheden om nieuwe opdrachtgevers aan G-Nius te binden. Daarnaast ben je continu op zoek naar het maken van de perfecte match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers. Je maakt hiervoor gebruik van jouw eigen netwerk als het zakelijk netwerk van G-Nius.

Bij G-Nius ben je als Sales Consultant actief in een 360 graden rol. Je draagt de zorg en verantwoordelijkheid voor het beheer van jouw relatiebestand. Dit bestand bestaat voornamelijk uit opdrachtgevers binnen de ICT-, Logistiek- en Managementomgeving.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden bestaan uit:

Verkoopbeheer, accountbeheer en relatiebeheer.
Resourcemanagement.
Acquisitie new business.
Analyseren van personele behoefte, processen en wensen van de klant en deze vertalen in praktische oplossingen.
Commerciële activiteiten, zoals het voeren van verkoopgesprekken, het uitbrengen van offertes, het onderhandelen over en afsluiten van contracten.
Werving van professionals.
Voeren van sollicitatiegesprekken.
Interim- en Recruitment.
Contactpunt voor klant en professional.


Werken als Account Manager IT Detachering bij G-Nius

G-Nius is een onderneming waar een informele maar professionele sfeer heerst. We vinden openheid en betrokkenheid belangrijk.

We bieden je een zelfstandig functie binnen een jong en enthousiast team waar eigen initiatieven vanzelfsprekend zijn. Wanneer je er even niet uitkomt staan je collega's voor je klaar om ondersteuning te bieden.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat ons team een hecht team is. Daarom lunchen wij altijd samen. Na de lunch lopen we een rondje door de binnenstad van s-Hertogenbosch om de middag weer vol goede energie te beginnen. Daarnaast organiseren wij leuke evenementen om elkaar, ook buiten kantoor, beter te leren kennen. Wil je meer weten over werken bij G-Nius? Kijk dan op www.werkenbijg-nius.nl.

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

Important location requirement: To be considered for this position, you must already live and be officially registered in the Netherlands within approximately 35 km of Utrecht. Relocation during or after the recruitment process is not possible for this vacancy. Are you currently working as a Maintenance Engineer, Field Service Engineer, Electrical Maintenance Engineer, Electromechanical Engineer, Service Engineer or Senior Service Technician? Your current job title matters less than your technical level and what you can do. As a Maintenance Engineer, you will join an international maintenance team at one fixed, highly automated logistics site in Utrecht. Together, you keep approximately 14 kilometres of automated systems running 24/7. Your work combines electrical, mechanical and control-related maintenance. One moment you are tracing an electrical fault or replacing a damaged sensor; the next you may be working on a motor, bearing, shaft or conveyor system. You perform preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshoot complex faults and investigate root causes to prevent failures from happening again. Experience with Siemens S7/TIA Portal, Profinet, CAN-bus or comparable industrial control systems is a strong advantage. You do not need to know every system from day one, but you should bring a solid electrical and controls background and feel comfortable diagnosing faults in automated equipment. Further system knowledge can be developed through internal training and on-the-job learning. You will be part of an international maintenance organisation of around 38 professionals. During each shift, you work in a team of 6–7 colleagues and normally carry out technical work together with one or two team members. The working language is English; Dutch is not required. Are you passionate about quantum technologies, integrated photonics and eager to further develop a Rydberg atom quantum computing platform as a 24/7 user facility for hybrid quantum comping? Join us! We are looking for a candidate that drives the qubit hardware development and the implementation of integrated photonics.
Job Description
At TU/e, the ultracold atom laboratory of CQT, part of the Center for Quantum Materials and Technology (QT/e), is developing neutral‑atom quantum computing platforms based on Rydberg interactions. This project is part of the KAT‑1 QDNL program on hybrid quantum computing, a demonstrator built on Quantum Inspire, the European quantum computer that offers 24/7 online access.
The qubit hardware that we operate in our laboratories are two neutral‑atom quantum computing platforms (rubidium and strontium). Optical tweezer arrays provide programmable and precise control and site‑resolved single‑atom readout. Rydberg excitation enables strong nearest‑neighbor coupling for multi‑qubit entanglement. The architecture is highly scalable to large qubit counts via array reconfiguration, atom shuttling, and parallel control-offering a promising route to fault‑tolerant quantum computing. The platforms are built for stable, continuous operation with 24/7 online access for community use. More information: www.tue.nl/rydbergQC .
We are also part of the European Photonics for Quantum (P4Q) Pilot Line , a €50 million initiative funded through the Chips Joint Undertaking (Chips JU) and national programmes to accelerate the transition of quantum photonic technologies from laboratory research to scalable manufacturing. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher - Molecular Drivers
jobs.description:
Function description
We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher to join a newly funded Gray Foundation Team Science project tackling one of the most important unsolved problems in cancer prevention: what drives the very first steps of breast cancer initiation in BRCA1 mutation carriers. Working at the interface of human tissue biology, single-cell genomics, spatial imaging, and functional mouse modeling, you will help map the genetic and phenotypic landscape of BRCA1-deficient precancerous cells in prophylactic mastectomy specimens and translate those discoveries into functionally validated driver candidates - a unique opportunity to do science that directly connects to clinical cancer interception.
The Jonkers laboratory at the Netherlands Cancer Institute has built a world-leading platform for functional breast cancer modeling, combining germline genetics, intraductal somatic engineering, and quantitative in vivo imaging. We are now applying that platform to study the biology of BRCA1-associated precancer and are looking for an exceptional postdoctoral researcher to lead this work.
You will work with a novel mouse model that combines germline heterozygous Brca1 deficiency with a dual-color fluorescent reporter that marks cells undergoing Cre-mediated loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in real time. Our preliminary data show that Brca1 LOH cells are actively cleared from the ductal epithelium in vivo, and this clearance is rescued by Trp53 loss. This provides a quantitative and mechanistic benchmark for ranking candidate perturbations.
Candidate driver genes will be introduced somatically at low frequency in mice - closely resembling the occurrence of early mutations in BRCA1 mutation carriers - through intraductal delivery of high-titer lentiviruses encoding Cre with cDNAs for overexpression or CRISPR guides for loss-of-function. Candidates will be prioritized from human precancer genomic data and from in vitro functional genetic sc...

Een liftopsluiting in een ziekenhuis. Een beveiligingsdeur die uitvalt bij een winkelketen. Een kapotte cv-ketel midden in januari. Mensen zitten vast, bedrijven liggen stil, en jij bent degene die de boel weer in beweging krijgt. Niet zelf de moersleutel vasthouden, maar wel de juiste persoon op het juiste moment inschakelen. Overdag werk je samen met collega's in een druk maar gezellig team. Je neemt storingen aan, vraagt goed door en zorgt dat de melding bij de juiste monteur of planner terechtkomt. jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)

Our mission is ambitious: enable anyone to launch, operate and scale a short-term rental business on AI autopilot.

We’re looking for a highly ambitious UX/UI Product Designer who wants to turn complex operations into simple, beautiful experiences. You’ll work directly with the founders and engineers to design products that solve real problems for property managers, operational teams and guests.

If you’re excited by thoughtful UX, exceptional interfaces, AI agents and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You’ll Design

As a UX/UI Product Designer, you’ll help shape every touchpoint of Base360—from the first website visit to the workflows operators rely on every day.

  • Core product experiences: Design dashboards and workflows for reservations, properties, guest communications, cleaning, maintenance and finance.

  • Onboarding and setup: Help operators connect their channels, add properties and get value from the platform quickly.

  • Booking and guest journeys: Create smooth experiences for direct bookings, check-in, extensions and upsells.

  • Our design system: Build reusable components and consistent interaction patterns that keep the platform coherent as it grows.

  • Website and marketing assets: Design landing pages, feature visuals and launch assets that make the product’s value clear.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and excellent visual design.

  • Experience designing SaaS products, dashboards or applications with complex workflows.

  • Experience working directly with engineers and seeing designs through to production.

  • Clear communication and the ability to explain your decisions and respond constructively to feedback.

  • High ownership, attention to detail and the ability to move forward when requirements are still evolving.

Experience with short-term rentals, hospitality, AI products, conversion optimisation or front-end development is a plus.

Why Join Us

  • Make a visible impact. Design experiences that directly influence how short-term rental businesses operate.

  • You don't aim to become one of the best at what you do.

jobs.title: Sr. Counsel - Regulatory
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our Regulatory Legal team is the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken’s product offerings across the EU and UK and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. We’re a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice – partnering directly with Compliance, Product, and senior leadership to keep our licensed entities running smoothly and our regulators well served.

The Senior Counsel role is a remote role based in the UK or the EU, and will report into the EU/UK Regulatory Legal team. The role exists to own the significant volume of ongoing, business-as-usual regulatory work that currently falls to a small group of very senior lawyers – freeing them to focus on strategic licensing initiatives, complex transactions, and team leadership.

You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on:

  • Product advice covering Payward’s growing offerings in the EU and UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things)

  • Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under MiCA/EU or in the UK) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and

  • Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise.

We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector).

This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK or EU.

 

The opportunity

  • Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions

  • Support the team’s active licensing applications and other in-flight EU/UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel

  • Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting EU/UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations)

  • Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities

  • Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., MiCA and the UK Cryptoasset Regime, CBI and FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, DORA, outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business

  • Foster a culture of clarity, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk tradeoffs, and decision-ready recommendations

 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor/Barrister, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State)

  • 10+ years’ post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution (e.g., a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, or crypto services provider) or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams

  • Direct experience supporting regulator engagement (e.g., with the CBI, FCA, or an equivalent EU competent authority), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence

  • Substantive experience advising on MiCA or the UK Cryptoasset Regime (i.e., FCA authorisation for regulated cryptoasset activities under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026) — experience with one regime is sufficient; both is not required

  • Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the EU or UK (experience in one jurisdiction is sufficient; both is not required), including account-access and open banking obligations

  • Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations

  • Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., Digital Operational Resilience Act in the EU, or the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime in the UK)

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with MiFID II and its application to investment services, including derivatives, equities, and emerging tokenised financial instruments

  • Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward’s and competitors’ products

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

  • Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

  • Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

  • Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

Your profile

  • Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

  • Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters.

  • Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases.

  • AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

  • Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

As Senior Associate / Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK, you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the UK.   • Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes

  • Support and / or manage on-site exams, inspections and audits (in collaboration with our RCD colleagues)

  • Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new and evolving UK laws and FCA rules

  • Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the 1st line business

  • Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. governance forums and board reporting)

  • Advise the business in relation to conduct risk, Consumer Duty, complaints governance (including Financial Ombudsman Service escalations), and ethics matters relating to our financial services licences

  • Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program through assisting with targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity

  • Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required

  • Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly

  • Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making

  • Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges

  • Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments and e-money activity

  • Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory reporting, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions

  • Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls

On site

Full time

Your future team

Join our Artificial Intelligence & Data (AI&D) team and work with colleagues from diverse backgrounds to help clients turn data into actionable insights. We partner with organizations across industries to design and implement data platforms, analytics solutions and AI use cases that support better decisions and innovation. You will collaborate closely with experts in technology, business and risk to deliver end-to-end data solutions.

The advantages of joining us

1. Career growth, your way: access to structured training, certifications and a clear progression path.
2. Global impact, local connections: work on international projects while supporting clients in Luxembourg and the Greater Region.
3. Innovative work that matters: contribute to modern data architectures, AI solutions and advanced analytics use cases.
4. Inclusive, flexible culture: join a collaborative team where diverse perspectives are valued and flexible working arrangements are supported
5. Build your network: connect with professionals across Deloitte's global network and participate in industry events.

1. Translate business needs into technical designs: Work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and turn them into architectures, data models and solution designs for Data & AI platforms.
2. Engineer data & AI solutions: Design and implement data platforms, data pipelines, integrations, analytics solutions and AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, scalability, performance and security.
3. Industrialise analytics & AI: Move solutions from proof of concept to production, set up monitoring, testing and deployment practices, and embed data quality and governance in the delivery.
4. Guide technical delivery: Provide technical leadership to project teams, review designs and code, and coach junior engineers on best practices in data engineering and AI
5. Learn, innovate & share: Explore emerging technologies such as GenAI, LLMs, data mesh and the modern data stack, contribute to reusable assets, and share knowledge to grow the team's capabilities.

Your skills

Must-have

•    Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, Economics, Information Systems or a related field.
•    4-6 years of experience in data-related roles (data engineering, analytics, BI, data science, data governance, AI project delivery, or data strategy consulting).
•    Fluency in French and English (spoken and written).
•    Strong collaboration skills and structured communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
•    Problem-solving mindset with a genuine interest in how data and AI can create business value.
•    Ability to create compelling presentations and tell stories with data for senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

•    Hands-on experience with SQL and at least one language used in data (Python, Scala, R…).
•    Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, integrations or data models.
•    Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data stack tools.
•    Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) or data orchestration/transformation tools (dbt, Airflow…).
•    Experience designing, developing or deploying AI/ML solutions in a production or pilot environment.
•    Familiarity with the AI lifecycle, and the ability to collaborate with data scientists and engineers on AI use cases.
•    Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, or advanced analytics projects.
•    Relevant certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP, DAMA, TOGAF…).

• Supporting international mobility activities, including assignments, secondments, work permits, social security registrations and foreign office administration;
• Providing operational HR expertise and guidance to HR Business Partners and managers while ensuring compliance with legal and internal requirements;
• Contributing to the continuous improvement, simplification and digitalisation of HR processes, systems and employee self-service solutions;
• Producing meaningful HR metrics and insights to support decision-making and operational excellence.

Your profile:

• You have a minimum of 4 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Services or HR Administration;
• Good knowledge of Luxembourg labour law and social security procedures;
• Experience with employee lifecycle administration, leave management and HR data quality;

    contribuer directement à la sécurisation contractuelle de nos activités et à la réussite de nos projets.

    Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en droit et avez réussi les Cours complémentaires en droit luxembourgeois (CCDL)

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Technical Account Manager

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 140 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. We provide state-of-the-art on on-boarding, digital identities, strong authentication and security services, and qualiﬁed electronic signatures, all bundled into integrated digital documents & identity management solutions.
As a Trusted Partner, we prioritize building long-lasting relationships with our international clients and stakeholders, based on trust and integrity. We strive to be a Committed Partner, dedicating ourselves to delivering exceptional performance and showing steadfast commitment to make a positive impact. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Technical Account Manager (m/f/x) under a permanent contract.

Summary
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) acts as the trust advisor for the customers he is in charge. The TAM ensures that customers have the adequate quality of services and pays attention to a successful technology adoption. He also makes sure that customers are perfectly informed by our products, services and solutions roadmaps, enabling the anticipation of the customers' needs.

Missions of the role

Build, maintain, and be accountable for strong and long-lasting relationship with existing clients

•  Pilot the day-to-day relationships with customers.
•  Ensure the coherence between the services delivered.
•  Support the customers in their requests and provide a close and optimal follow-up.
•  Serve as the lead point of contact for all customer account management matters and act as client's first level escalation level (after Customer Care involvement)
•  Ensure a high customer satisfaction and contribute to the customer satisfaction index through annual surveys, in collaboration with Marketing.
•  Organize quarterly meetings with each customer and ensure a close and optimal follow-up of the action points.
•  Monitor the quality of services and our SLAs related to incidents and requests and be force of proposition to suggest and follow improvement plans.
• Take care of contract renewal and ensure that LuxTrust meets its contractual obligations, including towards RAs and Application Providers.
• Negotiate customer conflict resolution, when necessary.
• Provide customers with reporting on activities.

Act as a technical and trust advisor

• Understand the customers' technical and functional stakes and anticipate customers' needs.
• Make sure clients are aware of roadmap evolutions in order to ensure client retention and stimulate upsells.
• Make sure the clients implement our products, services and solutions accordingly with our validated models and best practices.
• Provide customers with advises on our product and solutions, act as the referent for the LuxTrust portfolio.
• Have a deep knowledge of our technical and functional flows.

Contribute to upsell and cross-sell

• Be able to identify upsells and cross-sells opportunities.
• Contribute to the transformation of the customers' needs into concrete offers, in collaboration with the sales department and the associated Business Development Manager.

Organize and animate Customer User Groups and workshops

• Organize Customer User Groups and workshops per thematic twice a year as the minimum.
• Ensure the follow-up of projects that concern several customers.
• Share update and animate discussions with several customers during these User Groups and workshops.
• Collect customers' feedbacks and ensure a close and optimal follow-up of the action points.

Required skills

• Qualifications / diploma(s): Bachelor's degree or related experience.

• Years of experience in the area: minimum 5 years of experience.

• Technical Competencies:

o Deep understanding and knowledge of our portfolio of products, services and solutions.
o Deep understanding of the technical and functional flows flows.
o Good understanding of protocols such as SAML, Open ID Connect.

jobs.title: Senior Project Controller, Scope & Schedule Management (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Project Controller, Scope & Schedule Management

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

PROGRAMME DESCRIPTION

meoSphere is SES's next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones.



To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES's software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Project Controller is responsible for establishing and maintaining the integrated programme control framework for the meoSphere programme, with particular focus on scope, schedule, planning and performance management. Reporting to the VP Programme Management, the role works closely with Agile Technical Program Managers (ATPMs), Technical Leads and Programme Leadership to translate agile plans, roadmaps and delivery progress into conventional programme controls and reporting. The Project Controller acts as the programme expert for Microsoft Project, a centralized program control tool (such as Primavera Cloud) and enterprise project controls, enabling effective planning, monitoring, forecasting and decision making across a complex multi-segment satellite communications programme.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

    Own and maintain the integrated programme schedule, planning baseline and milestone framework.
    Develop and manage programme structures, including WBS, PBS, milestones, deliverables and planning hierarchies.
    Administer, maintain and continuously improve Primavera Cloud and associated programme control tools.
    Manage programme dependencies, schedule integration and critical path activities across delivery segments.
    Support resource planning, forecasting and capacity management across the programme.
    Monitor programme performance and provide schedule, scope and delivery analysis, forecasting and insights.
    Support risk analysis activities, including schedule risk assessments and Monte Carlo simulations.
    Produce programme dashboards, reporting packs and executive performance metrics.
    Work with ATPMs to translate Agile progress, PI objectives and roadmaps into programme-level reporting and controls, and vice versa.
    Support integration of schedule, cost and forecasting information with wider programme controls and reporting activities.
    Drive governance, baseline management, change control and schedule integrity across the programme.

KEY COMPETENCIES

    Project Controls & Governance. Establishes and maintains effective programme control frameworks, governance processes and baseline integrity.
    Integrated Planning & Scheduling. Develops and manages integrated schedules, milestones, dependencies and delivery plans across complex programmes.
    Schedule Risk Analysis & Forecasting. Applies schedule analysis, forecasting and risk assessment techniques to support programme decision-making.
    Reporting & Performance Analytics. Produces meaningful programme reporting, dashboards and performance insights for stakeholders and leadership.
    Stakeholder Management & Communication. Builds effective relationships across programme teams and communicates complex information clearly and effectively.
    Systems Thinking. Understands programme-wide interdependencies and the impact of decisions across multiple workstreams and delivery segments.



Qualifications Background and Experience

    Typically 8+ years of experience in project controls, programme planning, scheduling, or programme management within large and complex engineering programmes.
    Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Project and strong experience using Primavera Cloud, Primavera P6, or equivalent enterprise programme control platforms.
    Experience developing and managing integrated schedules, work breakdown structures (WBS), resource plans, dependencies, milestones, forecasting, and programme reporting.
    Strong understanding of programme controls disciplines, including scope, schedule, cost, risk, resource, and change management.
    Experience supporting aerospace, satellite, telecommunications, defence, or similarly complex engineering programmes.
    Ability to operate effectively within Agile delivery environments while maintaining robust programme controls and governance.
    Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Experience & Qualifications

    Experience supporting LEO, MEO, or GEO satellite communications programmes.
    Understanding of end-to-end satellite system architectures, including space, ground, mission software, and user terminal domains.
    Experience performing schedule risk analysis, Monte Carlo simulations, and probabilistic forecasting.
    Experience developing programme performance dashboards and executive reporting.
    Professional certification in project controls, scheduling, or programme management (e.g., PMI-SP, PMP, AACE, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
    Experience supporting Agile-at-scale delivery environments, such as SAFe.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS

    The candidate must be eligible for a “SECRET” security clearance, in accordance with the national regulations as well as EU/ESA/NATO equivalents
    Willing to work 60% onsite from office
    Travel as required for project realization purposes

Diese Position ist im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit Option auf Übernahme zu besetzen.

jobs.title: Solarteure / Monteur für PV-Anlagen (m/w/d) (Solarmonteur/in)
jobs.description:
Nach vier Jahren Bauzeit sind wir im Januar 2025 in unser modernes Firmengebäude in Mechernich-Obergartzem gezogen. Als etabliertes Unternehmen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien und führender Anbieter von Photovoltaikanlagen bieten wir Ihnen ein modernes, offenes und angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte

Solarteure / Monteur für PV-Anlagen (m/w/d)

in Vollzeit.

Ihre Aufgaben als Solarteure / Monteur für PV-Anlagen (m/w/d)

- Montage der Dachunterkonstruktionen
- Fachgerechte Installation von Photovoltaik-Modulen auf den Unterkonstruktionen
- Elektrische Verkabelung der Photovoltaik-Module
- Sorgfältige Beachtung sämtlicher einschlägiger Normen und Sicherheitsbestimmungen

Das bringen Sie als Solarteure / Monteur für PV-Anlagen (m/w/d) mit

- Abgeschlossene handwerkliche Berufsausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation wünschenswert
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung im handwerklichen Bereich, idealerweise in der Solartechnik
- Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und handwerkliches Geschick
- Hohe Zuverlässigkeit, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Engagement
- Schwindelfreiheit sowie ein sicherer Tritt
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Führerschein der Klasse B

Was wir Ihnen bieten

- Keine Schichtarbeit – keine Rohbauarbeit
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Professionelle Werkzeuge werden gestellt
- Arbeitskleidung von Engelbert Strauss
- kostenlose Getränke
- Tankgutschein in Höhe von 50 € pro Monat
- Firmenhandy Samsung oder iPhone
- Frische Brötchen und mehr – direkt in unserer Betriebskantine
- Exklusiver Mitarbeiter-Fitnessbereich
- Anfahrt: an der Autobahn A1 / kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten
- Verschiedene Firmenevents
- offenes und herzliches Arbeitsklima
- verantwortungsvoller, abwechslungsreicher und moderner Arbeitsplatz

Etwas über uns

Energie mit Zukunft – Karriere mit Sinn

Die ProSolarTec GmbH sucht im Auftrag ihres Schwesterunternehmens LOKISA Energie GmbH engagierte Verstärkung.

Als zuverlässiger Meisterbetrieb und erfahrener Partner für Erneuerbare Energien steht ProSolarTec GmbH für moderne und zukunftssichere Lösungen rund um Photovoltaik und Wärmepumpen.

Im Januar 2025 bezog das Unternehmen nach vierjähriger Bauzeit sein neues, hochmodernes Firmengebäude in Mechernich-Obergartzem. Gemeinsam mit der LOKISA Energie GmbH gestaltet ProSolarTec GmbH die Energiewende in der Region aktiv mit und bietet sichere Arbeitsplätze mit Zukunftsperspektive.

Was uns als Arbeitgeber auszeichnet

Bei uns erwarten Sie spannende Aufgaben in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld. Wir fördern Ihre fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch umfassende Einarbeitung, gezielte Schulungen und Weiterbildungen. Unsere offene Unternehmenskultur, klare Aufstiegschancen und ein starkes Teamgefühl machen uns zu einem Arbeitgeber, auf den Sie sich verlassen können.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Im Januar 2025 haben wir unser neues Firmengebäude bezogen. Es bietet nicht nur optimale Arbeitsbedingungen, sondern auch eine eigene Betriebskantine sowie einen Fitnessbereich – für mehr Wohlbefinden und ein starkes Miteinander im Arbeitsalltag.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

So geht es weiter

- Bewerben Sie sich bitte direkt online, indem Sie auf den "Jetzt auf diese Stelle bewerben" Button klicken.
- Ihre Bewerbung wird von uns gesichtet und wir werden uns schnellstmöglich bei Ihnen melden - versprochen.
- Danach vereinbaren wir einen Termin für ein persönliches Kennenlernen und besprechen alle Einzelheiten.
- Bei Fragen vorab können Sie gerne Kontakt zu uns aufnehmen.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

jobs.description:
INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbH

Wir suchen:
Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in (m/w/d)

Zu uns:
Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen
- Verwaltungstätigkeiten wie Dokumentation und Aktenführung
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen, Teamsupervision und Weiterbildungen.

Das bringen Sie mit - Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung/ein Studium zum/zur Sozialpädagoge/in oder Sozialarbeiter/in, Diplom/BA Pädagoge/in oder Erzieher/in oder sind Werksstudent/in und haben Freude an der Begleitung junger Menschen.
- Erfahrung in der pädagogischen Arbeit.
- Fähigkeit zur professionellen Beziehungsarbeit und die Bereitschaft zur kultursensiblen Arbeit.
- Kreativität, Flexibilität und Kooperationsfähigkeit.
- Freude an eigenständiger Arbeitsweise.

Unser Angebot - Ihre Vorteile

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich an der Berufsausbildung und der beruflichen Vorerfahrung orientiert.
- Attraktives Gleitzeitangebot.
- Fortlaufende Fachberatung und Supervision sowie Weiterbildungen.
- Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen.
- Ein engagiertes Team.
- Familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld.

Die Neue Wege Neue Chancen gGmbH unterhält in Südniedersachen an verschiedenen Standorten Hilfsangebote für Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können.

Nahrung, Kleidung, Bildung, Ausübung einer Tätigkeit, Mobilität, Freizeitgestaltung, Wohnung, u.a.).

Ziel ist es, unseren Kundinnen und Kunden durch unsere Unterstützung zu ermöglichen, ihren Alltag besser bewältigen und ein weitgehend selbst bestimmtes Leben zu führen. Krankenpfleger/in, oder eine vergleichbare erlangte Qualifikation.

Sie sollten zuverlässig und belastbar sein und über eine positive Grundhaltung, welche Akzeptanz und Empathie auch gegenüber depressiven, antriebsschwachen oder suchtkranken Menschen beinhaltet, verfügen.

Ein sicheres Deutsch, ist ebenso wichtig, wie ein geschulter Umgang mit Word (Textverarbeitungsprogramm) und Kenntnisse im Umgang mit PCs und dem Versand von E-Mails.

Da der Großteil der Beratung über Kommunikation verläuft, ist es erforderlich, dass Sie die Kundinnen und Kunden beraten und Gespräche führen und leiten können.

- Eine ausfüllende Tätigkeit, bei der Sie sich für Ihre Mitmenschen einsetzen können.
- Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit.
- Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Absprache an Ihrer Lebenssituation orientieren. Maximal eine 5-Tage-Woche, nach Absprache auch weniger.
- Verzicht auf Schichtarbeit.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Entlohnung.
- Prämien, Boni und geldwerte Leistungen (Notebook, Handy) in Absprache.
- Die Möglichkeit eines Dienstrads, E-Bikes oder Dienstwagens, in Absprache auch zur privaten Nutzung.
- Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
- Fortbildungsangebote.
- Freiheiten, sich einzubringen und eigene Ideen umzusetzen.
- Innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen.
- Ein kollegiales Miteinander und ein nettes Team.

Der zeitliche Umfang Ihrer Stelle erfolgt nach Vereinbarung. Ihre Zeiteinteilung ist, nach Absprache mit den Kundinnen und Kunden und zu vereinbarenden Präsenzzeiten flexibel.

Ihre Bewerbung werden wir vertraulich behandeln.

Mit der Bewerbung nennen Sie uns bitte Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung (brutto), den gewünschten zeitlichen Umfang Ihrer Tätigkeit und den bevorzugten Standort für den Sie sich bewerben (ggf. in der Reihenfolge Ihrem Präferenz).

Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte ausschließlich per E-Mail an: bewerbung@nwnc.de.

Vielen Dank.

jobs.description:
