jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26 i 22/26), članka 41. Statuta Dječjih vrtića Petar Pan Vodnjan – Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano vrtića, članka 5. Pravilnika o postupku i načinu zapošljavanja u Dječjim vrtićima Petar Pan – Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 22. rujna 2026. godine Upravno vijeće raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za prijem radnika na radno mjesto
  1. ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE – 1 izvršitelj (m/ž) na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme (20 h/tjedno) za rad u Dječjim vrtićima Petar Pan Vodnjan-Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano- za provođenje obveznog programa predškole
Kandidati moraju udovoljavati slijedećim uvjetima: sukladno članku 24. st. 3. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26 i 22/26) i članku 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/2024, 62/2025), članku 20. točka 2.3 Pravilnika o unutarnjem ustrojstvu i načinu rada Dječjih vrtića Petar Pan Vodnjan-Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano (KLASA: 007-02/25-02/2 URBROJ: 2163-10-1-25-01-1 od 5. ožujka 2025. godine):
  1. za obavljanje poslova odgojitelja kandidati moraju imati odgovarajuću vrstu i razinu obrazovanja:
  • završen sveučilišni diplomski studij ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja i stečen akademski naziv sveučilišni/a magistar/magistra ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja
  • završen sveučilišni prijediplomski studij ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja i stečen akademski naziv sveučilišni/a prvostupnik/ca ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja
  • završen stručni prijediplomski studij ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja i stečen akademski naziv prvostupnik/ca ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja.
  1. utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta iz ovog natječaja
  2. pored gore navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati uvjete iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26 i 22/26).
U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. Riječi i pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje koji se koriste u natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu uporabljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe. U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, e-mail adresa na koju će se dostaviti obavijest o datumu i vremenu procjene odnosno testiranja kandidata). Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika osobne iskaznice, putovnice, domovnice ili elektronički zapisnik iz knjige državljana)
  • presliku dokaza o stručnoj spremi (ispunjavanje uvjeta odgovarajuće vrste i razine obrazovanja određene ovim natječajem-diploma),
  • elektronički zapis o radnopravnom statusu (e-radna knjižica) ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za kazneno djelo navedeno u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za prekršaj naveden u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,
  • potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene mjere iz članka 25. Zakona, ne starija od dana objave natječaja.
Izabrani kandidat dužan je dostaviti Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta po obavijesti o izboru, a prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa. Isprave se prilažu u izvorniku ili preslici koja ne treba biti ovjerena, a izabrani kandidat dužan je prije izbora predočiti izvornik ili ovjerene preslike navedenih dokumenta. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa, te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavaka 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju te koja je vlastoručno potpisana. Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja dužni su pristupiti vrednovanju prema odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Dječjim vrtićima Petar Pan Vodnjan-Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano. Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj je objavljen dana 24.9.2026. godine i vrijedi do 2.10.2026. godine. Prijave s traženom dokumentacijom u zatvorenoj omotnici potrebno je dostaviti poštom ili osobno u tajništvo vrtića na adresu: DJEČJI VRTIĆI PETAR PAN VODNJAN - SCUOLE DELL'INFANZIA PETAR PAN DIGNANO, S. ROCCO 17, 52215 VODNJAN- DIGNANO s naznakom “ ZA NATJEČAJ-ODGOJITELJ/ICA NA ODREĐENO- OBVEZNI PROGRAM PREDŠKOLE“. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem web stranice Dječjih vrtića Petar Pan Vodnjan – Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano https://www.dvpetarpanvodnjan.hr/ u roku od petnaest (15) dana od dana donošenja Odluke o izboru kandidata. Dječji vrtići Petar Pan Vodnjan – Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja. Prijavom na ovaj natječaj kandidat potvrđuje da je upoznat s pravnim temeljem prikupljanja osobnih podataka i njegove svrhe, kao i o zaštiti njihova čuvanja, te njihovim pravima, a sve u skladu s Uredbom (EU) broja 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od dana 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje suglasnost DV Petar Pan Vodnjan-Dignano na prikupljanje i obradu svojih osobnih podataka u svrhe natječajnog postupka kao i suglasnost za objavu istih na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči vrtića kao rezultat natječaja. Informacije o zaštiti podataka, te s tim u svezi navedene kontakte možete saznati na web stranici vrtića https://www.dvpetarpanvodnjan.hr/ Upravno vijeće Dječjih vrtića Petar Pan Vodnjan – Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano U Vodnjanu-Dignano, 24. rujna 2026. godine KLASA: 112-02/26-01/13 URBROJ: 2163-10-1-26-01-1 ___________________________________________________________________________ Ai sensi dell'articolo 26. della Legge sull'educazione ed istruzione prescolare (GU 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26,22/26), dell'articolo 41. dello Statuto delle Scuole dell'infanzia, dell’articolo 5. del Regolamento sulle modalità di assunzione e della Delibera del Consiglio di Amministrazione del 22 settembre 2026, il Consiglio di Amministrazione di Dječji vrtići Petar Pan Vodnjan-Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano bandisce il CONCORSO per la copertura del seguente posto di lavoro
  1. EDUCATORE/ICE PRESCOLARE - 1 dipendente (m/f) a tempo determinato, orario ridotto (20 ore settimanali) per il lavoro presso Dječji vrtići Petar Pan Vodnjan-Scuole dell’infanzia Petar Pan Dignano- per lo svolgimento del programma prescolare obbligatorio
I candidati devono soddisfare i seguenti requisiti: ai sensi dell’art. 24 paragrafo 3 della Legge sull'educazione ed istruzione prescolare (GU 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26,22/26), dell'art. 2 del Regolamento sul titolo di studio e sul livello d' istruzione per i dipendenti educativi e dei altri dipendenti nelle scuole d'infanzia, nelle istituzioni e altre persone giuridiche e fisiche che svolgono programmi di educazione e d'istruzione prescolare (GU 145/2024, 62/2025), dell'art. 20 punto 2.3 del Regolamento sull’organizzazione interna e sulle modalità di lavoro di Dječji vrtići Petar Pan Vodnjan-Scuole dell’infanzia Petar Pam Dignano (SIGLA.AMM: 007-02/25-02/2 NUM.PROT.: 2163-10-1-25-01-1 del 5 marzo 2025):
  1. per svolgere le mansioni del posto di lavoro di educatore i candidati devono possedere il titolo e livello di studio/qualifica professionale:
  • possedere una laurea universitaria magistrale in educazione ed istruzione della prima infanzia e prescolare e una qualifica accademica di dottore magistrale in educazione ed istruzione della prima infanzia e prescolare
  • possedere una laurea universitaria triennale in educazione ed istruzione della prima infanzia e prescolare e una qualifica accademica di baccalaureata in educazione ed istruzione della prima infanzia e prescolare
  • possedere una laurea professionale in educazione ed istruzione della prima infanzia e prescolare e una qualifica accademica di baccalaureata professionale in educazione ed istruzione della prima infanzia e prescolare.
  1. comprovata idoneità psico-fisica al lavoro ovvero idoneità alle mansioni del posto di lavoro
  2. inoltre, i candidati devono soddisfare i requisiti in conformità all'articolo 25 della Legge sull'educazione e istruzione prescolari (GU 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26,22/26).
Possono inoltrare domanda di assunzione persone di entrambi i sessi che soddisfano i requisiti richiesti. Le parole e i termini riferiti al genere, che nel presente concorso vengono usati al maschile, hanno significato neutro, ovvero si riferiscono sia a persone di genere maschile che femminile. La domanda deve riportare i dati personali del richiedente (nome e cognome, indirizzo di residenza, numero di telefono o di cellulare, e l’indirizzo di posta elettronica (al quale verra’ mandata l’informazione sull’ora e sulla data della valutazione dei candidati). La domanda deve essere autografata. La domanda autografata deve essere corredata da:
  1. Curriculum Vitae
  2. Attestato di cittadinanza (fotocopia della carta d'identità, del passaporto, del certificato di cittadinanza oppure estratto elettronico dal registro dei cittadini)
  3. Diploma di qualifica professionale
  4. Attestato sull’esperienza lavorativa (estratto elettronico dell’INPS – elektronički zapis HZMO)
  5. Prova di inesistenza di impedimenti alla costituzione del rapporto di lavoro ai sensi dell'articolo 25 della Legge sull'educazione e istruzione prescolari (GU 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/26,22/26):
- certificato del tribunale preposto attestante che contro il candidato non è in atto alcuna procedura penale per reati di cui al paragrafo 1, articolo 25 della Legge sull'educazione e istruzione prescolari (GU 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22 i 101/23), non anteriore alla data di pubblicazione del concorso, - certificato del tribunale preposto attestante che contro il candidato non è in atto alcuna procedura d'infrazione per contravvenzioni di cui al paragrafo 3, articolo 25 della Legge sull'educazione e istruzione prescolari (GU 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22 i 101/23), non anteriore alla data di pubblicazione del concorso, - certificato dell’Istituto croato per l’assistenza sociale comprovante che contro il candidato non sono state adottate misure cautelari di cui all'articolo 25 della Legge sull'educazione ed istruzione prescolari, non anteriore alla data di pubblicazione del concorso. Il certificato di idoneità al lavoro per le mansioni del posto di lavoro in oggetto va consegnato dal candidato all'atto della notifica della scelta, prima della costituzione del rapporto di lavoro. Le suddette prove vanno allegate in originale o in copia che non deve essere autenticata, fermo restando l’obbligo del candidato scelto ad esibirle nella loro copia originale o autenticata prima della conferma della scelta. Il candidato che gode del diritto di precedenza ai sensi della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patria e sui membri del loro nucleo familiare (Gazzetta ufficiale, numeri 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra (Gazzetta ufficiale, numeri 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patriottica (Gazzetta ufficiale, numero 84/21) e della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e sull'assunzione di persone disabili (Gazzetta ufficiale, numeri 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), ha l'obbligo di richiamarsi a tale diritto nella sua domanda e ha la precedenza rispetto ai restanti candidati, ma solo a condizioni identiche. Per potersi avvalere del diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi della Legge sui difensori croati della Guerra patriottica e sui membri del loro nucleo familiare (Gazzetta ufficiale, numeri 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), il candidato che all'atto dell'inoltramento della domanda risponde ai requisiti utili all'acquisizione di tale diritto, ha l'obbligo di allegare alla domanda di assunzione tutte le prove utili a comprovare il soddisfacimento dei requisiti prescritti dal concorso e, a seconda della categoria di appartenenza per l'acquisizione del diritto di precedenza di assunzione, ha l'obbligo di allegare tutte le prove prescritte sul sito del Ministero dei difensori croati, al link: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Il candidato che usufruisce del diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi militari e civili di guerra (Gazzetta ufficiale, numeri 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), ha l'obbligo di allegare alla domanda di assunzione, oltre che le prove richieste nel concorso, anche il decreto, rispettivamente il certificato comprovante tale diritto e la prova sulle modalità di conclusione del rapporto di lavoro. Per potersi avvalere del diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi della Legge sulle vittime civili della Guerra patriottica (Gazzetta ufficiale, numero 84/21), il candidato che all'atto dell'inoltramento della domanda risponde ai requisiti utili all'acquisizione di tale diritto ha l'obbligo di allegare alla domanda di assunzione tutte le prove utili a comprovare il soddisfacimento dei requisiti prescritti dal concorso e, a seconda della categoria di appartenenza per l'acquisizione del diritto di precedenza di assunzione, ha l'obbligo di allegare tutte le prove prescritte sul sito del Ministero dei difensori croati, al link: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Il candidato che usufruisce del diritto di precedenza di assunzione ai sensi della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e sull'assunzione di persone disabili (Gazzetta ufficiale, numeri 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), ha l'obbligo di allegare alla domanda di assunzione oltre che le prove richieste nel concorso, anche la prova sullo status di persona disabile. La persona che non consegna tempestivamente domanda regolare, o che non soddisfa i requisiti formali del concorso pubblico, non sarà considerata quale candidato nel presente concorso pubblico. I candidati che hanno presentato tempestivamente una domanda completa con tutti gli allegati e i documenti richiesti e che soddisfano i requisiti del bando sono tenuti a partecipare alla valutazione secondo le disposizioni del Regolamento sulle modalità e le procedure di assunzione presso Dječji vrtići Petar Pan Vodnjan–Scuole dell'infanzia Petar Pan Dignano. jobs.title: STRUČNI SURADNIK PEDAGOG
jobs.description:
Temeljem čl. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (N.N. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19,57/22, 101/23 , 145/23,145/24,146/25 i 22/2026) i čl. 42. Statuta, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Baltazar, Gračac raspisuje:

NATJEČAJ

za popunu radnog mjesta

1.PEDAGOG – STRUČNI SURADNIK– 1 izvršitelj/ica na određeno vrijeme na pola radnog vremena (20 sati tjedno),do povratka djelatnice na rad, uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca.

UVJETI:

  • prema Zakonu o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju
  • Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (Narodne novine, broj 145/2024, ispravak 62/25).

Poslove stručnog suradnika pedagoga može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij odgovarajuće vrste za rad na radnom mjestu stručnog suradnika pedagoga, a koji može biti :

  1. Sveučilišni diplomski studij
  2. Stručni diplomski studij
  3. Odgovarajući studijski program prema ranijim propisima

Kandidati su dužni priložiti:

- životopis

- zamolbu vlastoručno potpisanu

- domovnicu

- dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (diploma).

- potvrda o položenom stručnom ispitu ukoliko je kandidat položio isti.

- dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl.25.st 1. Zakona o

predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja)

a)potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (čl.25.st.2.) Zakona o

predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja)

b) potvrda nadležnog Prekršajnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak čl.25.st.4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja)

- potvrda Centra za socijalnu skrb (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. st.10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja)

-Potvrdu prethodnog poslodavca ukoliko kandidat dolazi iz drugoga vrtića o razlogu prestanka ugovora o radu.

-dokaz o radnom stažu (elektronički zapis ili potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o podatcima evidentiranim u bazi podataka HZMO), (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja)

-Liječničko uvjerenje o utvrđenoj zdravstvenoj sposobnosti (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja)

Kandidat koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruje pravo prednosti, mora se u prijavi na

natječaj pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema

posebnom zakonu.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti:

– sukladno čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih

obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21,156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je

priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na

poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju

nalaze se na poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

– sukladno čl. 47. – 50. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine

br. 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta

i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju

nalaze se na poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ost

varivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-

%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

– sukladno čl. 48. f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine br. 33/92,

57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19),

– sukladno čl. 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom

(Narodne novine br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je osim dokaza

o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te

dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca.

Sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“, broj 82/08, 69/17) na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod.

U skladu s Uredbom EU 20167679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. 4. 2016. te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (NN 42/18) prijavom na natječaj osoba daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve u svrhu provedbe natječaja za zapošljavanje.

Urednom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge tražene u javnom natječaju.

Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i urednu prijavu iz javnog natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj i njegova prijava neće biti razmatrana.

O rezultatima javnog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku trideset (30) dana od dana

isteka roka za podnošenje prijava, dostavom odluke o prijemu izabranog kandidata ili dostavom

odluke o poništenju javnog natječaja.

Upravno vijeće zadržava mogućnost poništenja natječaja bez obrazloženja.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti kandidati oba spola.

Natječaj vrijedi od 25.09.2026.godine. do 02.10.2026.godine.

Zamolbe s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostaviti osobno ili poštom u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na adresu

DJEČJI VRTIĆ BALTAZAR ŠKOLSKA 14, 23440 Gračac s naznakom „za natječaj“

jobs.title: SPREMAČ/ICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26), te na temelju odluke Upravnog vijeća Dječjeg vrtića Kustošija, raspisuje se NATJEČAJ ZA RADNO MJESTO SPREMAČICA jedan (1) izvršitelj, na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme UVJETI: prema člancima 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24). Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete, a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. Uz pisanu i vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu (zasebni dokument) na natječaj, koja mora sadržavati osobne podatke podnositelja (ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona te adresu elektroničke pošte), naznaku radnog mjesta i vrstu radnog odnosa za koji se prijavljuje, potrebno je priložiti i: dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis, odnosno potvrda o podacima evidentiranima u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, ne starije od dana objave natječaja, uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u čl. 25. st. 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od dana objave natječaja uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u čl. 25. st. 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od dana objave natječaja, te životopis. Isprave/prilozi se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici jer se iste ne vraćaju, a kandidat koji bude izabran dužan je predočiti izvornik ili ovjerenu presliku. Ako kandidat uz prijavu na natječaj priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni podacima u prijavi na natječaj, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (preslika vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja pod jednakim uvjetima prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti kod zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno čl. 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je u prijavi na natječaj priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o invaliditetu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, izjavu da do sada nije koristio pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi, osim u slučajevima zasnivanja radnog odnosa na određeno vrijeme te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidatom, prijavljenim na natječaj, smatra se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete natječaja. Prijave za natječaj s popratnom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se isključivo na adresu elektroničke pošte: zaposljavanje.vrtic.kustosija@gmail.com Kandidati koji podnesu pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja mogu biti pozvani na postupak procjene/testiranja i vrednovanje kandidata. Obavijest o načinu, vremenu i mjestu održavanja procjene/testiranja i vrednovanja kandidata bit će objavljena na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Kustošija www.vrtic-kustosija.zagreb.hr, najmanje 2 dana prije dana održavanja iste, s napomenom da se kandidati neće posebno pozivati. Ako kandidat ispunjava sve uvjete natječaja, ali ne pristupi postupku procjene/testiranja i vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je kandidat odustao od prijave na natječaj. Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj iznosi osam (8) dana od dana objavljivanja ovog natječaja. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanjem, te na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Kustošija dana 25. rujna 2026. Rok za prijavu na natječaj je dana 3. listopada 2026. Plaća, dodaci na plaću i naknade određuju su važećim Zakonom o radu i Kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba. Osnovica za obračun plaće, koeficijenti složenosti radnih mjesta te umanjenja ili uvećanja koeficijenta složenosti radnih mjesta uređeni su važećim Kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem mrežne stranice Dječjeg vrtića Kustošija – www.vrtic-kustosija.zagreb.hr – u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata, a najkasnije u roku od 60 dana od dana objave natječaja. Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Prijave koje nisu u skladu s ovim natječajem odnosno nepravodobne, nepotpune, nepotpisane i prijave dostavljene suprotno tekstu natječaja, neće se razmatrati.

jobs.title: KONGRESNI TEHNIČAR/KONGRESNA TEHNIČARKA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLOVA:

  • priprema dvorana i opreme potrebne za odvijanje događanja a sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • samostalno postavljanje opreme i ostvarivanje video programa te manjih ozvučenja, snimanja i reprodukcija u suradnji s vanjskim organizatorom i zaposlenicima Društva na terminima postave, pokusa i programa
  • samostalno postavljanje scenske i ambijentalne rasvjete sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • obavljanje svih tonskih snimanja za potrebe Društva i korisnika
  • prikupljanje i reproduciranje audio, video i svjetlosnog sadržaja sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • osnovno održavanje, popravak i čišćenje postojeće i nove tonske i video opreme
  • rad na remontu postojeće cjelokupne instalacije slabe struje, kao i redovna briga o održavanju tonske, video i ostale elektroničke opreme u vlasništvu Društva
  • za vrijeme održavanja programa, rad u propisanoj odjeći
  • izvršavanje aktivnosti i radnji potrebnih za obavljanje prethodno opisanih poslova radnog mjesta
  • odgovoran je za povjerena sredstva i predmete rada te za uredno, pravodobno i točno izvršavanje radnih zadataka prema pravilima struke
  • obavlja druge poslove i izvanredne radne zadatke po nalogu Voditelja IT odjela i Uprave u okviru svoje stručne spreme i stečenog znanja
  • Obvezno provodi mjere zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara, zaštite okoliša i sigurnosti objekata,
  • Dosljedno provodi sve procedure i propise,
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog

Tražimo osobu koja je pedantna i odgovorna u svom radu, koja ima izraženu sklonost samostalnom obavljanju zadataka, ali dobro funkcionira i u timskoj organizaciji poslova.

Istovremeno nudimo rad u dinamičnom i lijepom okruženju, te razne mogućnosti usavršavanja i stalnog educiranja.

Također, ističemo da društvo Olympia Vodice u svojstvu poslodavca aktivno se zalaže za jednake mogućnosti i jednako postupanje prema svim svojim zaposlenicima, bez obzira na rasu, boju kože, spol, jezik, dob, nacionalnost, seksualnu orijentaciju i identitet, invaliditet, vjeru, političko ili drugo uvjerenje, imovinu, rođenje ili bilo koji drugi status. Svjesni smo naše uloge velike organizacije te odgovornosti utjecaja na živote svih naših zaposlenika, korisnika naših usluga i društva u cjelini. Svim budućim zaposlenicima poručujemo da svoju društvenu odgovornost shvaćamo ozbiljno, uz poduzimanje mjera za borbu protiv bilo kojeg oblika diskriminacije, zlostavljanja i seksualnog uznemiravanja.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.description: Willkommen bei Hartlauer! Bei uns zählen Qualität, Weiterbildung und Löwengeist. Das macht uns seit 1971 zu Österreichs führendem Fachberater für Optik, Hörakustik, Foto und Handy. In unserer Zentrale und den 160 Geschäften warten 1.900 Kolleg:innen auf dich. Bist du Qualitätsdenker:in, Vollblutlöw:in und Möglichmacher:in? Dann passt du perfekt ins Rudel. Deine Aufgaben Mit deinem scharfen Blick analysierst du Marketing- und Kundendaten im Salesforce CRM Analytics Tool und machst aus Zahlen wertvolle Erkenntnisse für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Mit aussagekräftigen Analysen, Reports und Auswertungen sorgst du für Transparenz in der Savanne unserer Kundendatenqualität. Aus den gewonnenen Erkenntnissen leitest du wertvolle Impulse ab - insbesondere für unsere Geschäftsbereiche Optik und Hörakustik. Du agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen, erkennst bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge und bringst deine Ideen sowie Verbesserungsvorschläge proaktiv ein. Teilprojekte rund um unsere Salesforce-CRM-Prozesse führst du eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg. Mit datenbasierten Erkenntnissen entwickelst du bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass wir auch morgen den richtigen Pfad einschlagen. Dein Beitrag Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Statistik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen - oder bereits einschlägige Berufserfahrung gesammelt. Marketing- und CRM-Prozesse sind für dich kein unbekanntes Revier. Erste einschlägige Berufserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber auch motivierte Einstiegslöw:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Zahlen sind deine Stärke. Du analysierst Daten mit Neugier und Weitblick und verwandelst komplexe Zusammenhänge in wertvolle Erkenntnisse. Neben deiner Expertise in Excel und PowerPoint kannst du bereits gut mit CRM-Tools und Salesforce Apps umgehen. Kenntnisse in SQL oder einer anderen Programmiersprache sind von Vorteil. Auch große Datenmengen analysierst und strukturierst du mit Ausdauer, System und einem klaren Blick für Lösungen. So sorgst du dafür, dass aus Daten echte Entscheidungen werden. Unsere Brüller Als Vollblutlöw:in bist du von Anfang an Teil des Rudels und spürst unseren Löwengeist. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht 9 to 5 sondern ganz flexibel innerhalb eines Gleitzeitrahmens von 06:30 bis 20:00 Uhr. Wir sind Möglichmacher:innen - dich erwarten bei uns viele fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Du hast nach der Einarbeitung die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeit im Büro mit Homeoffice Tagen zu kombinieren. Unsere löwenstarken Benefits wie ein eigener Fitnessraum, ein eScooter auch zur privaten Nutzung und tägliche Vitamin- und Gebäcklieferung, genießt du ab dem Start bei uns. Deine Beute Für Einstiegslöw:innen winkt für diese Position ein Jahresgehalt ab EUR 42.000 brutto auf Vollzeit-Basis. Im persönlichen Gespräch legen wir dein Gehalt je nach konkreter Qualifikation gemeinsam fest. Spürst du den Löwengeist in dir? Dann bewirb dich!

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Servicetechniker Elektroinstallateur
jobs.description:
Ab sofort suchen wir für unsere Kunden einen/eine

**Servicetechniker Elektroinstallation (m/w/d)**

**Ihre Aufgaben:**
- Kompetente Kundenberatung vor Ort
- Behebung von Störungen an anspruchsvollen Elektroanlagen in Industrie-, Gewerbe-, Verwaltungs- und Wohnbauten
- Ausführen von Klein- und Serviceinstallationen im gesamten Anwendungsbereich der modernen Elektrotechnik
- Selbständige Planung und Durchführung Ihrer Serviceeinsätze
- Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen und kundenorientierten Arbeitsausführung

- Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Elektroinstallateur:in EFZ oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung
- Vorzugsweise einige Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion
- Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Freude an qualitativ hochwertiger Arbeit
- Selbständige, flexible und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude am direkten Kontakt mit der Kundschaft sowie am Wechsel zwischen diversen Aufgabenbereichen

**Wir bieten Ihnen:**
- Offenes, wertschätzendes und familiäres Arbeitsumfeld
- Langfristige und sichere berufliche Perspektive bei einem erfolgreichen Arbeitgeber
- 5 Wochen Ferien sowie Erfolgsbeteiligung/Boni
- 4,5-Tage-Woche (Freitagnachmittag frei)
- Spannende Projekte dank kompetenter Führung und eingespielter Arbeitsabläufe
- Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten mit aktiver Unterstützung durch den Arbeitgeber
- Attraktives Anstellungsverhältnis mit modernen Anstellungsbedingungen

jobs.title: Elektroinstallateur / Servicemonteur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sie haben genug von Grossbaustellen und suchen mehr Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag? Unser Kunde, ein etabliertes Schweizer Elektro-Installationsunternehmen, sucht eine selbstständige und freundliche Persönlichkeit als Elektroinstallateur/in und Servicemonteur/in. Sie sind bei Privat-, Gewerbe- und Industriekunden im Einsatz und arbeiten an spannenden Kleinprojekten. Auch Lehrabgängerinnen und Lehrabgänger sind herzlich willkommen und werden sorgfältig eingearbeitet.

**Elektroinstallateur / Servicemonteur (m/w/d)**

**Ihre Aufgaben:**
- Service und Unterhalt: Sie führen selbstständig Servicearbeiten bei Privat-, Gewerbe- und Industriekunden aus.
- Kleinprojekte: Sie realisieren Erweiterungen und Neuinstallationen im Wohn- und Gewerbebau.
- Fehlerbehebung: Sie stellen rasch Diagnosen und beheben Störungen zuverlässig.
- Zukunftstechnik: Sie schliessen Geräte, E-Ladestationen und Smart-Home-Komponenten fachgerecht an.
- Kundenkontakt: Sie sind das Gesicht des Betriebs vor Ort und beraten Kundinnen und Kunden kompetent und freundlich.

**Ihre Qualifikationen:**
- Abgeschlossene Lehre als Elektroinstallateur/in EFZ oder Montage-Elektriker/in EFZ (Berufseinsteiger/innen frisch ab Lehre sind willkommen)
- Exakte, zuverlässige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
- Gepflegte Umgangsformen und ein sicheres Auftreten beim Kunden
- Führerausweis Kat. B (zwingend für das Servicefahrzeug)
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

**Wir bieten Ihnen:**
- Flexibles Pensum: 60–100% frei wählbar, passend zu Ihrer Lebenssituation
- Top-Ausrüstung: Modernes Servicefahrzeug, hochwertiges Werkzeug und digitale Tools (Tablet/Smartphone)
- Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen: Überzeugender Lohn, mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien und freie Ferienwahl (keine Betriebsferien)
- Weiterbildung: Volle Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, z. B. in den Bereichen E-Mobilität und Smart Home
- Starke Teamkultur: Motiviertes Team, flache Hierarchien und regelmässige Teamevents
- Sorgfältige Einarbeitung: Gezielte Begleitung beim Start, besonders für Lehrabgängerinnen und Lehrabgänger

jobs.title: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders)
jobs.description:
1 Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders) Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships

* You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem - universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners.
* You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives.
* You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility.
* You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities.

Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication

* You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally.
* You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats.
* You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends.
* You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value.

Your background:
* A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role - and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside.
* A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline - helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree.
* A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Manager & Methodology Support  Sundsvall
jobs.description:
Senior Requirements Manager & Methodology Support – Sundsvall

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Requirements Manager & Methodology Support Consultant for a complex IT environment within the public sector.

The role combines senior requirements management, agile methodology support, coaching and collaboration across multiple development teams. You will work at both strategic and operational levels and help ensure that development teams have clear, structured and traceable requirements for continuous delivery.

Responsibilities

    Lead requirements management across larger assignments involving multiple development teams and functions.
    Manage the overall requirements picture and break business needs into iterative requirements, features and delivery flows.
    Establish, structure and maintain overall backlogs and agile requirements artifacts.
    Ensure development teams have sufficient and high-quality requirements for continuous development.
    Support and, when required, lead operational requirements work within individual teams.
    Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, users and other functions.
    Lead workshops, story mapping sessions and requirements activities.
    Provide coaching, mentoring and methodological support in agile system development.
    Support development and improvement of processes, methods and ways of working.
    Act as a bridge between IT and business operations.
    Support and manage development-related tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket and Mattermost.
    Contribute to knowledge development, process improvement and collaboration models.
    Take on Scrum Master responsibilities when required.

Mandatory Requirements

    Fluent Swedish, written and spoken.
    At least 10 years of relevant experience in the Swedish public sector during the last 15 years.
    Extensive experience in legally and regulatory-controlled environments.
    At least 10 years of experience during the last 15 years developing customer and case/processing systems within public support or equivalent operations.
    At least 5 years of experience during the last 10 years developing financial/economic systems, such as loans, grants, benefits, banking or finance.
    At least 8 years of experience during the last 10 years working with multiple parallel development teams, dependencies and joint deliveries.
    At least 8 years of experience during the last 10 years providing mentoring and methodological support for agile system development.
    Experience with system development involving Java code migrated from CA Gen.
    Very strong technical understanding of application development and IT systems.
    At least 15 years of relevant professional experience during the last 20 years.

Technical Experience

Experience with:

    Scrum and Kanban
    SAFe / scaled agile development
    Scrum Master responsibilities
    Requirements engineering and agile requirements decomposition
    Jira and Jira Service Management
    Confluence
    Bitbucket and Mattermost
    Angular
    Java and Spring Boot
    OpenShift
    Camunda and Camunda-based processes
    RabbitMQ
    DB2
    IBM BAW
    MS SQL
    WAS 9 / WebSphere
    Java EE
    Draw.io
    Systems involving regular data thinning/data retention

Education & Certification

    IREB, SQEB or equivalent requirements engineering training.
    SAFe certification.

Personal Profile

We are looking for someone who is analytical, structured, driven and collaborative, with excellent communication and coaching skills. You should be comfortable working across organizational levels, leading workshops, supporting development teams and translating complex business needs into clear and actionable requirements.

Assignment Details

Location: Sundsvall, Sweden

Working method: Hybrid / Partial Remote – minimum 3 days per week on-site

Scope: 100%

Start: 1 January 2027

End: 31 December 2028

Possible extension: Until 31 December 2029

Type: Consultant / Sub-consultant

Application deadline: 30 September 2026

Please submit your CV in Swedish.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
Developer
jobs.description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About this opportunity:



As a Software Developer in our organization, you will be part of a global team developing the software platforms and capabilities that power Ericsson's Purpose-built and Cloud RAN solutions. You will work with experienced engineers in a collaborative environment where learning, innovation, and teamwork are at the core of everything we do.



This is an opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge technology while building a strong foundation for your future career. You will gain hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, automation, AI-assisted development, and large-scale distributed systems.



About our organization



Product Engineering Group 3 (PEG 3) is part of Product Engineering Unit RAN Performance (PEU RP), which develops Ericsson's Baseband software for the Purpose-built and Cloud RAN portfolio. We create software solutions that enable high-performance, scalable, secure, and energy-efficient mobile networks used by communication service providers around the world.



As the industry continues its transformation toward cloud-native architectures, our teams are driving the evolution of Cloud RAN solutions and preparing the foundations for future networks. In addition to advancing today's 5G capabilities, we are actively developing technologies that will contribute to 6G, the next generation of mobile communications.



What you will do:



Develop and maintain software for Ericsson's Baseband and Cloud RAN solutions.



Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot software components.



Contribute to software architectural improvement.



Work with automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices.



Leverage AI and automation to increase productivity and reduce lead time.



Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Ericsson's global R&D organization.



Learn and apply modern software engineering methodologies and AI-enabled development tools.



Contribute to innovations supporting the evolution from 5G Advanced toward future 6G networks.



The skills you bring:



We recruit for potential and believe that curiosity, learning ability, and collaboration are key ingredients for success. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of professional experience and possess:



MSc or BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Telecommunications, or another relevant field.



Programming experience in one or more languages such as C++, Python, Java, or similar.



Interest in software development, AI, machine learning, and telecommunications



Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and coding assistants (for example Coding Buddy, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools) is an advantage.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



A growth mindset and willingness to continuously learn.



Ability to collaborate effectively in diverse and international teams.



Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

jobs.title: Inglise keele huviringi juhendaja/õpetaja
jobs.description:
Inglise keele õpetaja huviringi lastele

Tööülesanded: Õpetaja ülesanne on 4-9 aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning seeläbi inglise keele õpetamine. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Ühe huviringi tunni pikkuseks on 40 minutit ning tunnid toimuvad lasteaedades (ja koolides) nii Paides kui ka selle ümbruses. Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-8 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine Google'i tabelisse ning tunni kokkuvõtte saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Kui materjalidest või mõtetest jääb väheks, aitavad tunni ettevalmistusel kaasõpetajad ja huvikooli õppejuht. Pakume osalist ning paindlikku tööaega (1-8 tundi nädalas). Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning hakkavad tavaliselt alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Nii jääb aega kooli või muude tegevuste jaoks. Meie õpetajad teenivad konkureerivat töötasu. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Director, Legal - Employment
HR Business Analyst to automotive company
jobs.description:
Do you excel at bridging the gap between business needs, solution design, and technical implementation? Are you an analytical thinker who thrives in complex transformation projects involving both global and local stakeholders? If so, this might be your next exciting opportunity!

About the position

Perido is looking for an HR Business Analyst to our client, an automotive company. The position is placed in Södertälje with hybrid working applied, three days on site.

Your daily tasks

In this assignment, you will contribute to the design, alignment, and implementation of project-driven changes within a transformation project. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders throughout the transformation journey:

    Gather, document, maintain, and update business requirements for the new HR solution
    Translate requirements into clear process designs, future-state processes, and workflows
    Support requirements mapping, process analysis, impact assessments, and testing activities
    Ensure requirements and process documentation is accurate, accessible, structured, and kept up to date
    Collaborate with project and change teams to support implementation readiness, rollout, and stabilization
    Support the development and update of user and administrator guides
    Support alignment of business requirements across stakeholder groups and help embed new ways of working for sustainable adoption

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and people-oriented professional who builds trust and creates alignment across different teams. You have a structured and proactive approach, allowing you to manage complexity while maintaining progress through clear coordination.

You are analytical and questioning in your approach—able to distinguish between legal requirements, genuine business needs, and historical ways of working. You actively identify gaps, contradictions, and duplicate requirements to keep the project moving forward. Furthermore, you are adaptable and resilient when priorities shift in a fast-moving project environment. Please apply today!

Qualifications:

Education & Technical Skills

    Relevant academic education or equivalent professional experience
    Experience working with business requirements and/or process development
    Understanding of HR / People & Culture processes from a business perspective
    Experience working with HR systems
    Strong documentation skills and ability to structure complex information clearly
    Fluent Swedish and English

Experience & Skills

    Experience in process development, process mapping, and workflow design
    Strong practical knowledge of Payroll and HR administration
    Understanding of People & Culture processes, particularly Payroll and time processes
    Experience working with HR and Payroll systems such as SD Worx Payroll, SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and Time, SAP SuccessFactors Payroll, SAP Payroll, or similar solutions
    Experience working in projects and/or transformation initiatives
    Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into processes and workflows
    Strong documentation skills and experience maintaining structured process documentation
    Understanding of change journeys and how process design can support adoption of new systems and ways of working
    Ability to collaborate effectively across project, business, HR, and change stakeholders

Strongly meritorious (as many as possible)

    Experience in requirements mapping, process development, process mapping, and workflow design
    HR Business Partner (HRBP) experience and/or knowledge of HR administration
    Understanding of People & Culture processes from a business perspective
    Experience working with HR systems
    Experience with HR master data, integrations, and downstream data consumption
    Experience working in complex transformation programmes involving both global and local stakeholders
    Ability to distinguish business requirements from solution design and technical implementation
    Strong documentation skills and experience working with process frameworks
    Understanding of change journeys and how process design can support adoption of new systems and ways of working

Contract type and hours

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-12-31. Start 2026-10-19.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations.

Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36018 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity where you can shape future-state HR processes and drive meaningful organizational change? Do you thrive in cross-functional projects and enjoy turning complex requirements into structured workflows? If so, this might be the perfect role for you!

About the position

Perido is looking for an HR Business Analyst with focus on Payroll Processes/HR-Systems for our client, an automotive company. The position is placed in Södertälje with hybrid working applied, three days on site.

Your daily tasks

As a HR Business Analyst, you will contribute expertise to the design, alignment, and implementation of project-driven changes. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders throughout the transformation lifecycle:

    Document, maintain, and update requirements for the new Payroll solution
    Translate Payroll requirements into clear process designs, workflows, and future-state solutions
    Support requirements gathering, impact analysis, and testing related to process and system changes
    Ensure process and requirements documentation is accurate, accessible, and up to date
    Develop and update user and administrator guides for the new solution
    Collaborate with project, business, HR, and change teams to support implementation readiness, rollout, and stabilization
    Support the implementation of new ways of working and ensure alignment between processes, system requirements, and change activities

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and people-oriented professional who builds trust and creates alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. You have a structured and proactive approach, allowing you to manage complexity and maintain progress through clear follow-up and coordination. You are adaptable and resilient when priorities shift in an evolving project environment. Furthermore, you have a strong change perspective and understand how well-designed processes, clear documentation, and structured ways of working contribute to successful transformation and long-term adoption.

Does this sound like an exciting challenge you would love to take on? We look forward to receiving your application, warmly welcome to apply today!

Education & Technical Skills

    Relevant academic education or equivalent professional experience
    Strong knowledge of Payroll and HR administration
    Good understanding of People & Culture processes, particularly Payroll and time-related processes
    Experience with process development, process mapping, and workflow design

    Experience with HR and Payroll systems
    Fluent Swedish and English

Experience & Skills

    Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into processes and workflows

    Understanding of change journeys and how process design can support adoption of new systems and ways of working
    Ability to collaborate effectively across project, business, HR, and change stakeholders

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-12-31. Start 2026-10-19.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Join Trattoria Giorgio's!

About Trattoria Giorgio's

Inspired by Italy’s neighbourhood trattorias, Giorgio’s is all about genuine hospitality, comforting food and a strong sense of community. It’s a warm, characterful place where people work closely, bring their personality to every service and make guests feel like regulars from day one.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Head Chef, You will be responsible for keeping the kitchen running smoothly through busy services, supporting and developing your team, and making sure our food standards are delivered with pride and discipline. This is a role for someone who enjoys structure, ownership and the pace of a high-volume restaurant.

What you'll be doing

    

Leading the kitchen team through prep, service and daily operations.

    

Delivering consistent food quality, presentation and kitchen standards.

    

Coaching, training and developing chefs across all sections.

    

Managing stock, ordering, waste and food cost with strong attention to detail.

    

Ensuring hygiene, food safety and compliance standards are followed at all times.

    

Working closely with the General Manager to support strong restaurant performance.

    

Building a positive, hard-working kitchen culture based on teamwork and accountability.

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

Has strong experience as a Head Chef, Sous Chef or senior kitchen leader.

    

Is confident leading a busy, high-volume kitchen.

    

Understands food cost, stock control, ordering and kitchen profitability.

    

Can train, coach and motivate a team with clear standards.

    

Leads by example and stays calm under pressure.

    

Takes pride in consistency, cleanliness and operational discipline.

    

Believes great kitchens are built through teamwork, ownership and respect.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for Italian food to our Local Trattoria.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.
