jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Additional languages

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

jobs.title: AI Lead, Marine

We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions

- A curious, pragmatic, and business-oriented mindset

What we promise you

jobs.description:

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach.
Our shared principles - Results driven, Client Centric, Empowering and Accountable - guide us in how we work, grow and succeed together. Join us and unlock transitions towards a sustainable and resilient society.

Job Description

AFRY is establishing a new ASIC Verification team delivery at Ericsson, and we are looking for a Senior ASIC Verification Engineer to play a key role in this journey.
Initially, the role is strongly hands-on, where you will contribute directly to advanced ASIC verification work within Ericsson’s hardware development organization. As the assignment progresses, you will also take part in interviewing and growing the team, acting as a technical ambassador for AFRY and helping shape a high-performing verification organization.
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical work with team-building and leadership influence, while working at the forefront of telecom ASIC development.

Qualifications

In this role, you will:
Hands-on ASIC Verification
Develop verification test-benches from scratch for ASIC and SoC designs
Develop tests from scratch using SystemVerilog and UVM
Update and maintain existing tests for evolving designs
Develop test-bench components from scratch (drivers, monitors, scoreboards, sequences)
Update and extend existing test-bench components
Develop Verification IPs (VIPs) from scratch
Maintain and enhance existing VIPs
Integrate third-party VIPs into the verification environment
Implement SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)
Implement functional and code coverage
Analyze coverage results, identify gaps, and create tests to achieve coverage closure

Team & Delivery Responsibilities
Act as an AFRY representative at Ericsson, building strong collaboration with stakeholders
Participate in technical interviews and candidate evaluations
Support team growth and onboarding as the delivery expands
Contribute to defining best practices, verification flows, and ways of working
Support AFRY’s long-term partnership and delivery excellence at Ericsson

Required Skills & Qualifications
Senior-level experience in ASIC/SoC verification
Strong expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM
Proven experience with:

Test and test-bench development from scratch
VIP development and integration
Assertions and coverage-driven verification

Solid understanding of digital design and verification methodologies
Experience working in Linux-based development environments
Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-company teams

Meriting Experience
Verification of telecom, networking, or high-speed interface ASICs
Experience with coverage analysis and verification metrics
Familiarity with regression flows and CI environments
Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to team ramp-up
Background working in large R&D organizations such as Ericsson

Additional Information

What AFRY Offers

A key role in building a new ASIC Verification team delivery at Ericsson
Combination of deep technical work and team influence
Long-term assignment with growth opportunities
Competitive compensation and benefits
Opportunity to shape the future of telecom and silicon verification.

jobs.title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

  • Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

  • Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

  • Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

  • Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

  • Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

  • Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

  • A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

  • Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

  • Bring good vibes to the work floor

  • Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

  • Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

  • Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

  • Have worked in an international workplace.

  • Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.


A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You speak fluent Danish and English.

  • You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

  • You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

  • You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

  • You love to work as we'll need you full time.

MSc or PhD degree in Molecular biology, Biotechnology or related scientific field.

    

Scientifically proficient in Molecular techniques such as; RCA, PCR and Flow cytometry.

    

Previous experience from technical support and/or application science roles in an industry setting is essential.

    

Strong communication and presentation skills. Commercial mindset with a willingness to support sales activities.

    

Proactive, structured, and comfortable working independently as well as in cross-functional teams.

    

Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Why Join Us?

At Rarity Bioscience, we believe in fostering a vibrant and collaborative work environment. We have co-located all functions in a modern office in Uppsala Science Park and we regularly organize team get-togethers and off-site events to strengthen our bonds and celebrate our successes.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel @ Enity Bank Group
jobs.description:
Are you a curious and solution-oriented lawyer looking to further develop your expertise in the banking sector? Are you interested in working for a Nasdaq Stockholm-listed Nordic banking group with an innovative and friendly culture?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Enity Bank Group's Finnish branch** as a new **Legal Counsel**! This is a broad in-house role where you will be the key legal point of contact for Enity Bank Group's Finnish operations, while working closely with the wider legal team across the Nordic organisation. You will be the sole lawyer in Finland, while having the support of your legal colleagues across the Nordics whenever needed.

_Enity believes in people's potential and is challenging the Nordic mortgage market by making banking more inclusive, sustainable and human. As a listed company, Enity operates through the brands Bluestep Bank, Bank2 and 60plusbanken, offering mortgages to customers often excluded by traditional banks – for example, due to self-employment, type of employment, age or credit history – as well as savings products. The Group operates across Sweden, Norway and Finland and is entering its next phase of growth, with an ambition to develop through new products, partnerships, distribution models and M&A. In Finland, Enity operates through a local branch of Enity Bank Group AB (publ)._

**In this role**, you will support the Finnish business on a wide range of legal and regulatory matters, with a particular focus on mortgage lending, consumer credit and the day-to-day legal needs of the branch. The role offers significant independence and close interaction with both the local business and colleagues across the Group. In more concrete terms, you will:

- provide legal advice to the Finnish branch on a broad range of matters

- support the mortgage business on matters relating to lending, security, property law, consumer protection, debt collection and insolvency

- review marketing materials and customer communications from a legal and regulatory perspective

- review and negotiate commercial agreements

- support the business in relation to customer matters, complaints and disputes

- monitor relevant Finnish legislation and regulatory developments and support their implementation within the branch

- advise on regulatory requirements applicable to the Finnish operations and support interactions with relevant authorities when needed

- prepare internal legal guidance and training

- support the Group in connection with potential acquisitions and other strategic transactions, including legal due diligence, transaction documentation and integration-related matters


The position is based in Helsinki and reports to the Bank's CLO, who is based in Stockholm. You will be part of the Nordic Legal team and collaborate closely with legal colleagues across the Group. In Finland, you will act as the main legal point of contact for the local organisation and work closely with the Branch Manager for Finland, contributing to the continued development and growth of Enity Bank Group's business in Finland.

**This role would be ideal for a legal professional who:**

- has a Finnish master's degree in law and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience (however this is just the minimum requirement, and the role has plenty to offer a more senior lawyer as well) preferably from a bank, financial institution, law firm or other regulated business;

- has experience from one or more of the following areas: banking and finance, mortgage lending or other consumer credit, consumer protection, insolvency, debt collection or disputes or financial regulation;

- is comfortable taking ownership of matters and working independently, while also collaborating closely with colleagues across different functions and jurisdictions;

- can translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, practical advice and is interested in understanding the commercial context in which you work; and

- has excellent communication skills in Finnish and English. Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.


**Enity Bank Group offers you:**

- a versatile position with excellent opportunities for professional growth;

- a front row seat in a growing company, where you have the opportunity to influence and gain responsibility;

- a supportive and close-knit culture with shared moments, such as after-works, company get-togethers and events; and

- the possibility to travel occasionally and to work as a part of a Nordic team with colleagues in Stockholm and Oslo.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **5 October 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi). We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period, so don't wait to apply!

jobs.title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö
jobs.description:
Lillan Hotel & Kök kasvaa ja kehittyy – nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus tulla mukaan rakentamaan sen menestystä seuraavassa tarinan luvussa!

Olemme viiden pienosakkaan omistama, Tampereen ainoa boutique-hotelli sekä monipuolinen ja laadukas ravintola, jossa yhdistyvät kodinomaisuus, lämmin ylellisyys ja henkilökohtainen, läsnäoleva palvelu. Yritys tunnetaan vahvasta kasvusta sekä modernista ja kannattavasta toimintamallista, joka nojaa strategiseen johtamiseen, jatkuvaan kehittämiseen ja korkeaan asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Etsimme apulaisravintolapäällikköä toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vastaamaan ravintolamme operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstön johtamisesta sekä kehittämään asiakaskokemusta yhdessä sitoutuneen tiimin ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.

Apulaisravintolapäällikkönä vastaat ravintolan päivittäisestä operatiivisesta toiminnasta, henkilöstön johtamisesta, perehdyttämisestä ja työvuorosuunnittelusta, asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun varmistamisesta, ravintolapalveluiden, tapahtumien ja tilaisuuksien johtamisesta, niiden ja tuotteidemme kehittämisestä yhteistyössä johtotiimin kanssa sekä taloudellisesta työskentelystä, myynnin ja kannattavuuden kehityksestä. Myös toimintaympäristön ja tilojen kunnossapito sekä työsuojeluvelvoitteiden ja viranomaisvaatimusten noudattaminen ovat osa päivittäistä työskentelyäsi.

Etsimme sinua, joka omaat vahvaa kokemusta ravintola-alan esihenkilö- tai johtotehtävistä Johdat henkilöstöä vahvalla organisointikyvyllä, vastuullisuudella ja vahvistaen koko tiimiä. Vastuullista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta, sekä vahvaa asiakaspalvelu- ja palveluliiketoiminnan ymmärrystä. Ymmärrät taloudellisen johtamisen ja yhdistät sen laadukkaisiin palveluihin ja asiakaskokemuksiin. Puhut sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kieltä.

Eduksi katsotaan aiempaa kokemusta hotelli- ja/tai ravintolaympäristössä työskentelystä sekä intohimoa pienten elämysten luomiseen kaikissa palveluissamme, ruoka- ja juomatuotteita ja tapahtumia kohtaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle näköalapaikan ja vahvan roolin kasvavassa, modernia palvelualan toimintaa ja kannattavaa liiketoimintaa tuottavassa yrityksessämme. Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, kehittää ja jättää jälkesi ainutlaatuiseen konseptiin, inspiroivan työympäristön poikkeuksellisessa ja historiallisessa miljöössä sekä ammattitaitoisen ja motivoituneen työyhteisön, yrityksemme resurssit ja kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksen mukaan.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si osoitteeseen operatiiviselle johtajallemme lasse@lillan.fi tai toimitusjohtajallemme mirella@lillan.fi viimeistään 23.10.

Hakemuksia käsitellään hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan hakijan löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Barcelona Elsäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av fasta elavtal till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

Composée d'une équipe de près de 3.500 collaborateurs, dans près de 28 pays, cette division réalise un chiffre d'affaires de près de 5,7 milliards d'euros.
A l'ère de l'intelligence artificielle, sa mission est de concevoir, exploiter, sécuriser les infrastructures mondiales du numérique, en connectant le monde avec résilience, performance et innovation, pour offrir des services accessibles partout, en permanence.
Vous êtes à la recherche d'une opportunité de stage dans le domaine de la RSE
au sein d'une entreprise dynamique et en pleine transformation ? Rejoignez Orange Wholesale !

Orange Wholesale France (OWF) fournit des solutions de réseaux aux opérateurs présents en France.
Avec plus de 1000 collaborateurs spécialisés dans chaque domaine du Wholesale, OWF contribue à plus de 4 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires.
Au sein de OWF, la direction RSE et Transformation a pour mission principale de :
- Renforcer le pilotage global sur la RSE qui devient un enjeu stratégique à long terme, avec des engagements forts du Groupe, des attentes grandissantes de nos clients, une réglementation évolutive ainsi que des opportunités de différenciation et de création de valeurs durables pour Orange, pour nos clients et pour la planète

        Une mission variée
"Une belle mission enrichissante vous attend pour ce stage" (Denis, tuteur)
Dans le cadre des objectifs d'Orange sur la Responsabilité Sociétale et Environnementale et sous la responsabilité de votre maitre de
stage :
- Vous aurez à travailler sur l'éco-conception, l'économie circulaire et la modélisation carbone au sein de la Direction OWF.
- Votre objectif de stage sera principalement d'accompagner le déploiement les méthodologies proposées par Orange aux offres Wholesale du portefeuille des directions marketing OWF, de proposer et mettre en oeuvre des plans d'actions pour améliorer leur impact social et/ou environnemental, afin de développer une démarche RSE globale durable et responsable.
- Vous serez également amené à travailler sur l'Analyse du Cycle de Vie et l'amélioration de la circularité des offres développées par OWF, ainsi que sur la communication de bilans carbone en interne et vers les clients opérateurs.

L'équipe
"Vous intégrez la Direction RSE et Transformation d'OWF, composée de 4 personnes avec une forte cohésion et un esprit d'entraide. "
(Denis, tuteur)
  
"Votre rôle sera transverse à toute la direction OWF." (Denis, tuteur)
- Vous cherchez un stage de 6 mois à compter de janvier 2027.
- Une première expérience dans la RSE serait un plus.
- Vous avez une bonne capacité de synthèse et d'analyse, ainsi qu'une forte autonomie afin de prendre des initiatives et être force de proposition.
- Vous êtes actuellement en première ou deuxième année de master en école de commerce/marketing/communication avec une forte appétence / spécialité pour les impacts environnementaux.
- Vous avez des qualités relationnelles, en effet ce stage vous donnera l'opportunité d'échanger avec de nombreux interlocuteurs et faire des présentations à l'oral.
- Vous savez être rapidement autonome et faites preuve d'adaptabilité.
- Vous faites preuve de pédagogie pour accompagner vos collègues sur le sujet de la RSE

Le stage pourra débuter entre janvier et février 2027.

Asumisen avustajana vastaat yksikön arjen tukitoiminnoista. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- ruoan valmistamista ja muita ruokahuollon tehtäviä


- tekstiilihuoltoa, esim. pyykinpesua


- yksikön puhtaanapitoa

Toivomme, että olet oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen ja kohtaat ihmiset arvostavasti.

Tehtävässä tarvitset:

- soveltuvan koulutuksen (esim. hoiva-avustajan tutkinto) tai aikaisemman kokemuksen kautta hankitun osaamisen tehtävään (esim. kokemus vastaavista tukitehtävistä ja/tai kehitysvamma-alalta)


- hygieniapassin ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvityksen


- hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja suomen kielen taidon


- kiinnostusta työskennellä kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden kanssa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- määräaikaisen työsuhteen vähintään 29.11.2026 asti sekä säännölliset arkipäiviin sijoittuvat työvuorot

- merkityksellisen työn osana asumispalveluiden arkea

- mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omia vahvuuksiasi ja osaamistasi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 11.10.2026 osoitteeseen rekrytointi@hl-s.fi tai käyttäen verkkosivujemme hakulomaketta (https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/). Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään pikaisesti, heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Business Controller, Vianor
jobs.description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for business audiences.
- High level of integrity, ownership and attention to detail, combined with the ability to operate independently and drive improvement across processes, tools and ways of working.
- Good command of modern finance systems, reporting tools and data analytics solutions; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.
- Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English. Other relevant languages are considered an advantage.

The successful candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial curiosity and a hands-on understanding of business operations. They are expected to be proactive, structured and collaborative, with the confidence to challenge the business constructively while building trust-based relationships across functions and countries.

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please send the application, including your CV and salary request by 11th October 2026.

For further information, please contact: Timo Koponen,e-mail timo.koponen@nokiantyres.com.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen. 

I over 200 år har OsloMet – storbyuniversitetet bidratt til å bygge kunnskap og kompetanse for det norske velferdssamfunnet. I dag er OsloMet et moderne og urbant universitet som er kjent for sine store og solide fagmiljøer innenfor lærerutdanning, helse- og sosialfag, samfunnsforskning, design og teknologifag.

jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Associate Professor Emma Nordbäck (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. - vahvoja organisointitaitoja, kykyä optimoida koneen käyttö ja tehostaa työprosesseja

- huolellisuutta ja tarkkaa silmää yksityiskohdille

- kykyä ohjelmoida ja käyttää CNC-ohjattuja kuitulasereita, mukaan lukien säätö ja tarvittavat muutokset.

- taito käyttää erilaisia mittausvälineitä laadun varmistamiseksi

- valmiutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

- Sujuvaa suomen tai englannin kielen taitoa.

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen (ma-pe) ja vakituinen vuokratyösuhde Talent Centerin kanssa. Työ on kaksivuorotyötä, jossa palkkaus ja työehdot määräytyvät teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

To succeed in this role, you will be able to interpret technical drawings and use them to program several small series during your shift. You are a motivated and versatile professional who thrives in challenging work environments. The work is in two shifts.

Key responsibilities:

What were looking for:

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to optimize machine usage and streamline work processes.

- High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all tasks.

- Proficiency in setting up, programming, and operating CNC laser machines, including adjusting parameters and making necessary modifications.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

- Familiarity with instruments and measuring methods for quality control.

- Willingness to work in two shifts.

- CAD training or experience is a plus.

- Proficiency in Finnish or English.

What do we offer?

The position is full-time (Mon-Fri) and a permanent contract with Talent Center. The work is two-shift work, with pay and working conditions determined by the collective agreement for the technology industry.

Jos siis pidät ihmisistä, tarinoista ja bisneksestä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Miksi Talent ValtaGroup?

Talent ValtaGroup on rekrytointi- ja henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka tekee rekrytoinnista oman näköistään. Meille rekrytointi ei ole kiireessä tehty prosessi tai kasvoton palvelu – vaan ihmisten aitoja kohtaamisia, oivalluksia ja oikean tuntuisia ratkaisuja. Kohtaamme asiakkaitamme, kutsumme heitä toimistollemme ja kerromme avoimesti avoimista työmahdollisuuksista hakijoille. Toimimme ketterästi, reagoimme nopeasti ja rakennamme jokaiselle asiakkaalle juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivan kokonaisuuden – tinkimättä laadusta. Taustallamme on vahva kokemus eri toimialojen rekrytoinneista ja laajat verkostot, joiden avulla löydämme oikeat osaajat oikeisiin rooleihin, valtakunnallisesti. Nyt haluamme laajentaa osaamistamme ja tähän tehtävään etsimme Sinua!

Miltä HR-asiantuntijan työ meillä näyttää?

Se on asiakastyötä, jossa rakennat ja vahvistat asiakassuhteita. Keskustelet, kuuntelet, haastat ja ratkot. Osaat ehdottaa asiakkaalle juuri sopivaa ratkaisua. Hoidat olemassa olevia asiakassuhteita ja teet myös uusasiakashankintaa. Ja kyllä - sinun tehtäväsi on nimenomaan löytää itse uudet omat asiakkaasi, tämä tärkeää sinun sisäistää, ennekuin haet tehtävään. Olet ennen kaikkea myyjä.

Arki on myös rekrytointia. Siihen kuuluu sekä työntekijätason ja henkilöstövuokrauksen rooleja, jotka pitää hoitaa ripeästi äkillisen tarpeen yllättäessä, että asiantuntijarekrytointeja, joissa sukellat syvemmälle osaamisen ja persoonan maailmaan.

- Olemassa olevien asiakassuhteiden hoitaminen ja vahvistaminen Hannelen apuna, mutta fokus uusasiakashankinnassa

- Asiakkaiden tarpeiden kartoittaminen, analysointi ja ratkaisujen räätälöinti

- Rekrytointiprosessien laadukas ja tehokas läpivienti alusta loppuun:
- Työpaikkailmoitusten laadinta

- Työhakemusten läpikäynti, hakijoiden kontaktointi sekä työhaastattelujen pitäminen

- Kirjallisten ehdokasesittelyjen laadinta haastattelukommenttien pohjalta ja niiden esittely asiakkaalle

- Yhteydenpito hakijoihin ja jälkimarkkinointi


- Työntekijä- ja asiantuntijatason rekrytoinnit (monipuolinen roolikirjo)

- Osallistuminen some- ja brändimarkkinoinnin ideointiin sekä materiaalien tekemiseen ja julkaisemiseen eri kanavissa (Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Canva)

Millaisen tekijän näemme tässä roolissa?

Sinulla on jo kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta, rekrytoinneista ja mieluiten myös asiantuntijaprofiilien parista. Ehkä olet tehnyt paljon työntekijä tason rekrytointeja ja tunnet paloa kasvaa vaativampiin rooleihin. Tai ehkä toisinpäin – pääasia, että nautit monipuolisuudesta.

Pidät ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja viestimisestä, ja kirjoitat sujuvaa tekstiä eri kanaviin. Tartut toimeen rohkeasti ja pidät lupauksista kiinni. Ymmärrät B2B-ympäristöä ja arvostat pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Ja ennen kaikkea - Sinusta löytyy myynnillisyyttä, josta aiemmin jo mainitsimmekin.

Tunnet yritysmaailman, ja sinun on helppoa ja vaivatonta kontaktoida yritysten päättäjiä ja johtotason henkilöitä – ja viedä HR-ostopäätös maaliin saakka. Tällainen kokemus karttuu työvuosien kautta, ja sitä sinulta löytyy!



Miksi meille Talent ValtaGroupille?

Tarjoamme kiinteän kuukausipalkan ja myyntiin sidotun bonuksen. Lisäksi saat sairaanhoitotasoisen työterveyshuollon käyttöösi (Mehiläinen), vapaavalintaisen puhelimen ja kannettavan tietokoneen työkäyttöön. Pääset työskentelemään yhtiön perustajan/omistajan rinnalle, alan kokemusta jo vuodesta 1997 ja tulet varmasti saamaan työssäsi kaiken parhaan ja mahdollisen tuen sekä avun; jota Hannele pysyy Sinulle antamaan. Meidän arvot: tullaan toimistolle, tehdään etänä vain, jos ollaan asiakkaissa, mikäli asut ulkopuolella Pirkanmaan - niin etätyöskentely mahdollisuus 80%.

Jos ilmoitus herätti mielenkiintosi, lähetä hakemus ja valokuvalla varustettu CV tai muu vapaamuotoinen hakemus. Hakuaika alkaa nyt, mutta päätöksen me teemme vasta sen jälkeen, kun olemme 100% varmoja valinnasta - molemmin puolin!

Hakuaika: 24.9.2026–24.10.2026

Meissä jokaisessa on Talenttia.




Talent ValtaGroup Oy

Talent ValtaGroup on rekrytointeihin ja henkilöstövuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, jonka toiminnassa yhdistyvät vahva asiantuntemus ja aito välittäminen. Uskomme, että onnistunut rekrytointi ei ole pelkkää osaajien ja yritysten yhdistämistä – se on ihmisten urapolkujen ja organisaatioiden menestyksen rakentamista.

Meillä rekrytointi tehdään tunteella ja taidolla. Kohtaamme sekä asiakkaat että ehdokkaat yksilöinä, kuunnellen ja ymmärtäen heidän tarpeensa. Toimimme avoimesti, joustavasti ja vastuullisesti varmistaen, että jokainen rekrytointiprosessi on sujuva ja ehdokaskokemus laadukas.

Pitkä kokemuksemme eri toimialojen rekrytoinneista ja henkilöstövuokrauksesta on tuonut meille kyvyn löytää juuri oikeat osaajat oikeisiin paikkoihin – tavalla, joka tuntuu oikealta.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye superhelt medarbeider?
jobs.description:
Åpnet annonsen på Finn.no? For den beste leseropplevelsen anbefaler vi at du åpner annonsen i vårt rekrutteringssystem Teamtailor, ved å trykke "Søk her" til høyre for, eller i bunnen av Finn-annonsen.

Elsker du å jobbe tett med andre, og motiveres du av å skape resultater i team? I Big Bite er vi like opptatt av menneskene på begge sidene av disken, og vi definerer oss selv som Superhelter for sultne folk i farta!

Er du vår nye superhelt på Big Bite Horisont?

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger.

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent
  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo
  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg!

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite.

For ytterligere informasjon ta gjerne kontakt med franchisetaker Chanett Louise Mørner på tlf: 93219254

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Big Bite åpnet sin første avdeling i Trondheim i 1997 med en ambisjon om å lage rask og smakfull mat til folk i farta. I dag finnes Big Bite i hjertet av over 70 kjøpesenter og handlegater over hele Norge. Vi er en sterk nasjonal merkevare i vekst. Idéen er enkel, men supergod. Subs laget av ferske baguetter fra lokal baker, friske salater og lune wraps - servert innen sekunder med et smil på kjøpet.

jobs.title: Vuorenmaa Yhtiöt Oy: (Jr.) Kenttämyyjä (Vaasa)
jobs.description:
**Työsopimuksen tyyppi:** vakituinen

**Sijainti:** Kiillekuja 3, 65300 Vaasa

**Hakuaika päättyy:** 7.10.2026

Kiinnostaisiko sinua ura B2b-myynnissä ja haluaisit kehittyä teknisen myynnin ammattilaiseksi? Etsimme Vuorenmaalle Vaasaan kenttämyyjää, jolla voi olla jo aiempaa kokemusta myynnistä, tai joka on vasta ottamassa ensimmäisiä askeleitaan B2b-myynnin parissa. Tärkeintä on halu rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja kasvattaa liiketoimintaa vakaassa, 80-vuotiaassa perheyrityksessä?

**Mitä tulet tekemään?**

Kenttämyyjänä vastaat olemassa olevien asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä uusien asiakkuuksien hankinnasta Pohjanmaan alueella. Saat vastuullesi valmiin asiakaskannan, jota pääset kasvattamaan pitkäjänteisesti, ja lisäksi pääset avaamaan uusia asiakkuuksia erityisesti alueen teollisuuden ja kunnossapidon toimijoiden parissa. Työssä uusasiakashankinta on tavoitteellista, mutta sitä tukee laaja aiemmin asioineiden asiakkaiden joukko ja toimialueelta saatavat tarjouspyynnöt – kyse ei siis ole jatkuvasta kylmäsoittamisesta.

Arkeesi kuuluu asiakastapaamisia kentällä, tarjousten laatimista ja tilausten käsittelyä, asiakkuuksien kehittämistä sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä Vaasan toimipisteen, tuoteryhmäasiantuntijoiden ja valtakunnallisen kenttämyyntitiimin kanssa. Käytät työssäsi HubSpot CRM:ää, ERP-järjestelmää sekä Exceliä. Lisäksi osallistut tarvittaessa Vaasan toimipisteen asiakaspalveluun esimerkiksi lomien aikana. **Millaista osaajaa etsimme?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea myynnistä ja asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä innostuvaa tekijää, joka haluaa kehittyä B2B- ja teknisen myynnin ammattilaiseksi. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis kenttämyynnin konkari tai tuntea teknisen tukkukaupan tuotteita entuudestaan – tärkeämpää meille on oikea asenne, halu oppia ja rohkeus tarttua uusiin asioihin.

Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnissä, asiakaspalvelussa tai muussa asiakasrajapinnan tehtävässä. Voit olla jo B2B-myynnin parissa työskennellyt osaaja tai urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva tekijä, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen kohti itsenäisempää ja vastuullisempaa myyntiroolia.

Tehtävässä menestymistä auttaa kiinnostus teknisiä tuotteita ja asiakkaiden liiketoimintaa kohtaan. Aikaisempaa teknisen alan kokemusta emme kuitenkaan edellytä, sillä pääset perehtymään tuotteisiin ja toimialaan kokeneiden kollegoiden tukemana.

**Voisit sopia tehtävään, jos:**

- sinulla on jo jonkin verran kokemusta myynnistä, asiakaspalvelusta tai muusta asiakasrajapinnassa työskentelystä

- nautit asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä ja olet kiinnostunut myynnistä

- olet oma-aloitteinen ja uskallat aktiivisesti ottaa yhteyttä nykyisiin ja uusiin asiakkaisiin

- kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi

- sinulla on ajokortti ja mahdollisuus käyttää omaa autoa työssä

- hallitset Excelin perusteet ja opit mielelläsi uusia järjestelmiä


**Eduksi katsotaan aiempi kokemus:**

- B2b- tai kenttämyynnistä

- Teknisten tuotteiden parista

- Teollisuuden tai kunnossapidon parista

- Ruotsin kielen käyttämisestä työssä


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa B2b- ja teknisen myynnin ammattilaiseksi

- Kattavan perehdytyksen Vuorenmaan tuotteisiin, asiakkaisiin ja teknisen tukkukaupan toimintaympäristöön

- Valmiin asiakaskannan, jonka parissa pääset rakentamaan kasvua ja oman alueesi menestystä

- Kokeneiden myynnin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden tuen

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa Vuorenmaalla ja kehittyä tulevaisuudessa esimerkiksi vaativampiin myynnin tai tuotepäällikön tehtäviin

- Vakaan 80-vuotiaan suomalaisen perheyrityksen työympäristön sekä kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten ePassin, laajan työterveyshuollon ja koulutusmahdollisuudet.


**Käytännön asiat:**

Kyseessä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen tehtävä, jossa työllistyt suoraan Vuorenmaa Yhtiöt Oy:n palvelukseen. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Vaasassa, ja työssä noudatetaan joustavaa hybridimallia, jossa etätyötä on mahdollista tehdä noin kaksi päivää viikossa työn luonteen huomioiden. Aloitus tehtävässä on mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen mukaan.

**Kiinnostuitko?** Hienoa! Lähetä ansioluettelosi ja hakemuksesi PDF-muodossa viimeistään 7.10.2026 aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta osoitteessa: **https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/385067/create/**. Voit kertoa hakemuksessasi myös palkkatoiveesi sekä aikaisimman mahdollisen aloitusajankohtasi.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä, joten suosittelemme hakemaan mahdollisimman pian. Huomaathan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta.

Lisätietoja Vuorenmaasta löydät osoitteesta www.vuorenmaa.fi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa HR & Recruitment Consultant Paavo Pikkarainen (+358 50 406 1111, paavo.pikkarainen@atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbejdere, kranfører og finishmedarbejder søges til betonproduktion
jobs.description:
Vi søger 10 medarbejdere til en større produktionsvirksomhed inden for betonelementer i Kolind.

Har du erfaring fra produktion, byggeri, beton eller andet praktisk arbejde – og trives du med fysisk arbejde, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er vigtigt? Så kan det være dig, vi søger.

Der er tale om Try & Hire med henblik på fastansættelse hos virksomheden efter endt periode.

Vi søger 8 produktionsmedarbejdere

Du bliver en del af produktionen af betonelementer og kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:

  • Armering

  • Klargøring til støbning

  • Opbygning af træforskalling og støbeforme

  • Afformning og håndtering af betonelementer

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra beton-, bygge- eller produktionsbranchen, men det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt og klar på at lære.

1 kranfører

Du kommer primært til at arbejde med intern transport og håndtering af større betonelementer – blandt andet udendørs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har gyldigt krancertifikat m. tilladelse til 52 ton.

  • Har erfaring med krankørsel, gerne fra industri eller produktion

  • Arbejder sikkert og ansvarsbevidst

  • Er indstillet på udendørs arbejde året rundt

1 medarbejder til finish

Her bliver din primære opgave at sikre den sidste finish på betonelementerne, efter de er taget ud af formene.

Opgaverne består bl.a. af:

  • Mindre reparationer af betonelementer

  • Udbedring af kanter, hjørner og mindre skader efter afformning

  • Finish og kvalitetssikring

  • Andre praktiske håndværksmæssige opgaver

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet håndværker, men du skal gerne have hænderne skruet godt på og sans for kvalitet og finish.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er mødestabil og klar til en fysisk arbejdsdag

  • Trives i et produktionsmiljø

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team

  • Har en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Selv kan transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen

Arbejdstider

Arbejdstiden ligger som udgangspunkt:

Mandag–torsdag: kl. 06.00–14.10
Fredag: kl. 06.00–13.40

Der kan alternativt være mulighed for mødetid kl. 07.00.

Vi tilbyder

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

  • Fuldtidsarbejde

  • Løn efter gældende overenskomst

  • Ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • En arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for at lære og udvikle sig

  • Try & Hire-forløb med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Skriv gerne i din ansøgning, om du søger produktion, truck eller finish.
