jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 5 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics
jobs.description:
About the position

A 4-year position as PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics is available at the Natural History Museum (NHM), University of Oslo. The 4-year fellowship includes 25% career-enhancing work, such as curation, teaching, supervision, research support and public outreach.

The project is supervised by Dr. Andrew Foote (NHM).
The PhD project will reconstruct the colonisation of high latitudes by North Atlantic killer whales (Orcinus orca), to better understand how populations responded to past climatic warming at the Pleistocene–Holocene transition. Range expansions and demographic change leave signatures in the genome, including changes in genetic diversity and in how genetic variation is distributed within and among populations. These signatures are not uniform along the genome, but depend on local genomic parameters such as mutation and recombination rate.

The candidate will quantify changes in genetic diversity and variation through time, and investigate how these patterns vary across the genome. The project will combine an existing dataset of approximately 200 contemporary genomes with a new time series of ancient killer whale genomes generated within the project. The tasks will include ancient DNA laboratory work, bioinformatic processing of Next Generation Sequencing data, and population genomic analyses, including demographic inference.
The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The selected candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Within two months of commencing the position, the candidate must submit a PhD agreement, including a plan for the required doctoral courses and a project description. For more information about the programme, see: http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/   


Qualifications / Requirments 

You must have:
•    An MSc degree in evolutionary biology, population genetics, bioinformatics, or a related field.
•    Research experience in population genetics or population genomics.
•    Experience with bioinformatic analysis of Next Generation Sequencing data, including command-line work in a high-performance computing environment.
•    Programming or scripting skills (e.g., R, Python, bash).
•    Excellent written and verbal communication ability in English. English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8 

Desirable qualifications (in ranked order):
•    Experience with ancient DNA laboratory work.
•    Experience with demographic inference, coalescent methods, or population genetic simulations.
•    Strong interest in evolutionary responses to past climate change

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows, according to the Norwegian educational system:
•    The average grade for courses included in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The average grade for courses included in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The Master's thesis must have grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
See: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7 

The evaluation of applicants will focus on the following:
•    Relevance and quality of the MSc thesis
•    Relevance and quality of scientific publications (not necessarily expected at this level)
•    Grades at relevant university-level courses (population genetics, evolutionary biology, bioinformatics, statistics, programming, wet-lab molecular techniques)
•    The fit of the applicant's career plan, interests, and skills as formulated in the cover letter (see How to apply below)
•    Personal suitability (incl. collaborative skills) and motivation for the position
•    An interview, including a 15 minute presentation of your MSc thesis (only short-listed candidates)


What are we looking for in you?

•    Honesty and high standards for scientific integrity
•    Ability to give and receive scientific criticism in a constructive manner
•    A positive attitude and drive for learning skills, methods and theory
•    Ability to work in a structured manner, facilitating teamwork
•    Ability to prioritise and complete work tasks
•    Ability to work independently, as well as collaboratively in an international and interdisciplinary research environment
•    Careful and well-documented approach to laboratory and computational work

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents):

1.    Cover letter with a statement of motivation and research interests
2.    CV summarizing education, positions and academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experience
3.    Statement explaining how a PhD in population genomics will fit into the applicant’s career plan (max 1 page)
4.    Copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records (as a single PDF)
5.    Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
6.    Names and contact details of 2-3 references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). The references will be contacted if necessary. Letters of recommendation are therefore not required.

Applicants should deliver the application with the requested attachments through our electronic recruiting system. Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge. Click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


We can offer you

•    Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development. 
•    Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
•    Onboarding program for new employees.
•    Good welfare schemes.
•    A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
•    Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK), which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
•    Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
•    Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow (position code 1017) in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund (SPK).


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s most comprehensive natural history collection. For almost 200 years, specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils have been collected, studied and preserved here. The museum is located at Økern and in the beautiful Botanical Garden, which is not only popular for recreation, but is a scientific collection in itself.

jobs.title: Passionate about brewing and eager to learn and grow together with us?
jobs.description:
FLO continues to expand, new opportunities are constantly emerging across the company. For the right person, this role can be the beginning of an exciting career with us. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your technical skills, take on more responsibility and potentially move into other roles as the company grows. Based at our production facility in the countryside outside Oslo, you’ll become part of an ambitious and hands-on production team where quality, craftsmanship and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

 

The role

Reporting to our Head of Production, you’ll be involved throughout the brewing and production process – from brewing and quality control to carbonation, filtration and kegging. Your key responsibilities will include:

 

  • Brewing Operations: Execute brewing processes according to recipes and established procedures, ensuring excellent quality and consistency in every batch.
  • Quality Control: Perform quality testing using equipment such as the Anton Paar Alcolyzer, pH meters, Dissolved Oxygen meters and CO₂ measurement devices.
  • Carbonation: Manage and fine-tune beverage carbonation to achieve the desired specifications.
  • Kegging & Filtration: Operate kegging and filtration equipment, ensuring our products meet the highest standards.
  • Cleaning & Sanitation: Carry out thorough Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) procedures for tanks, hoses, carbonation units, pumps, the brewhouse and other production equipment in accordance with our SOPs.
  • Production Data: Accurately record and update production and quality data in our ERP systems Odoo.
  • Packaging Support: Support packaging operations when required and work closely with colleagues across production.

You’ll also play an active role in keeping our workplace clean, safe, organized and efficient – and we want you to contribute ideas. We believe the people closest to production are often the ones who see the best opportunities for improvement.

 

Who are you? You’re someone who takes pride in your work and cares about the details that make the difference between a good product and a great one. Ideally, you have formal education in brewing, beverage production, food science or a related field, combined with some practical experience from a brewery or similar production environment. However, we’re also interested in people with the right technical understanding, attitude and desire to learn. We think you’ll thrive at FLO if you: 
 

  • Have a genuine interest in brewing and beverage production
  • Have relevant education and preferably some practical brewing or production experience
  • Are technically minded, practical and comfortable working hands-on
  • Understand the importance of hygiene, accuracy and consistency
  • Take ownership and responsibility for your work
  • Enjoy working as part of a team
  • Are curious and always looking for ways to improve
  • Want to continue learning and developing professionally
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-moving company where things evolve as we grow

Why FLO?

FLO AS is an ambitious company with exciting plans for the future. We are investing in our growth, our production and, importantly, our people. Joining us now means becoming part of that journey. For the right person, there will be significant opportunities to learn, develop and progress within the company. As FLO grows, new positions and responsibilities continue to emerge, creating opportunities for internal promotion and career development. 

 

You’ll be joining a company you can build a career with. Our production facility is located in a rural area outside Oslo. Due to the location, having access to a car is strongly recommended. Candidates must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway. Applicants residing within the EU/EEA who are eligible to work in Norway are welcome to apply.

 

If you want to learn, develop and be part of building something exciting, we’d love to hear from you: Whether you already have brewing experience or are early in your professional brewing career, this could be your opportunity to take the next step. We’re looking for someone who wants to master the craft, contribute to the team and develop alongside a company with big ambitions. Add Persona is managing the recruitment process on behalf of FLO AS. If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are warmly welcome to get in touch with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

 

Come brew with FLO – and be part of what we’re building.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

FLO is a leading company in beverage development and production, known for our innovative approach, high quality standards, and strong customer partnerships. As a dedicated co-packer, we produce private-label beverages for customers in Norway, across the Nordic region, and in international markets, as well as manufacturing products for other brand owners.

 

FLO operates from modern, high-quality facilities at Sollihøgda. Today, we are a team of 29 employees with diverse professional backgrounds, united by a shared drive: to create together, deliver quality, and have fun along the way. We value diversity, continuous development, and a start-up mindset built on the belief that nothing is impossible. At FLO, success is not only about the results we achieve, but also about how we achieve them – as a team that supports, challenges, and celebrates together.

jobs.title: Anæstesisygeplejerske til elektiv kirurgi – primært i dagtimerne
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din anæstesifaglighed i et elektivt hospital med korte patientforløb, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og primært arbejde i dagtimerne?

Capio Privathospital Odense søger en anæstesisygeplejerske til en fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen.

 

En arbejdsdag med anæstesi og opvågning

Du bliver en del af vores anæstesiteam og arbejder cirka 75 % med anæstesi og 25 % i opvågningen. Vi varetager elektiv kirurgi inden for blandt andet ortopædkirurgi, rygkirurgi og mave-tarmkirurgi.

Arbejdet ligger mandag til fredag, primært i dagtimerne og med enkelte vagter frem til kl. 20.00.

Hos os arbejder læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige faggrupper tæt sammen om sikre, effektive og trygge patientforløb. Vi er et mindre hospital med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der er mulighed for at få indflydelse på både hverdagen og den fortsatte udvikling af området.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen

  • Primært arbejde i dagtimerne på hverdage

  • Cirka 75 % anæstesi og 25 % opvågning

  • Elektive og veltilrettelagte patientforløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og tværfagligt miljø

  • Grundig introduktion til hospitalet og vores arbejdsgange

  • Synlig ledelse og korte beslutningsveje

  • Løn efter DSR-overenskomst samt sundhedsforsikring

  • Personaleparkering under hospitalet

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er uddannet anæstesisygeplejerske

  • Arbejder fagligt sikkert og selvstændigt

  • Trives med både anæstesi og opgaver i opvågningen

  • Bidrager til et godt samarbejde og hjælper, når dagens program kræver fleksibilitet

  • Møder patienter og kolleger med respekt, ro og hjælpsomhed

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af vores faglige praksis

Er du forholdsvis ny i specialet, hører vi også gerne fra dig. Det vigtigste er, at du har et sikkert fagligt fundament og lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Om Capio Odense

Capio Privathospital Odense er et elektivt hospital med fokus på patientsikkerhed, høj faglig kvalitet og gode patientoplevelser.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne ansvar, respekt, hjælpsomhed og fleksibilitet. For os handler en god kultur om, hvordan vi samarbejder i hverdagen og løser opgaven sammen omkring patienten.

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning. Send dit CV og nogle få ord om, hvorfor stillingen interesserer dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Ved ansættelse indhenter vi børneattest og straffeattest.

jobs.description:
**Mielen ry hakee työhönvalmentajaa työkokeilun ja työhönvalmennuksen palveluun**

Mielen ry tuottaa työkokeilua ja työhönvalmennusta Pirkanmaalla Kelalle. Haemme nyt määräaikaista ja osa-aikaista (60% työaika) työhönvalmentajaa maaliskuun 2027 loppuun saakka. Tarvittaessa tuntimäärää voidaan kasvattaa asiakastilanteen mukaan.

Valmentaja suunnittelee, toteuttaa ja arvioi asiakkaiden työkokeilu- ja työhönvalmennusprosesseja. Työ sisältää säännöllisiä työpaikkakäyntejä asiakkaiden työ- ja harjoittelupaikoille, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan tehtävässä välttämättömäksi. Lisäksi valmentaja vastaa dokumentoinnista, tietosuojasta sekä yhteydenpidosta yhteistyötahoihin. Lisätietoja tuotettavasta palvelusta löydät seuraavasta linkistä. https://mielen.fi/kelan-ammatillinen-kuntoutus-amku/

Edellytämme:

- sosiaali- ja/tai terveysalan korkeakoulututkintoa esim. sosionomi (AMK), toimintaterapeutti (AMK), kuntoutuksen ohjaaja (AMK)

- valmentajalla on oltava työkokemusta tutkintoon valmistumisensa jälkeen aikuisten työttömien ammatillisen kuntoutuksen palveluista tai muista työllistymiseen tähtäävistä palveluista sekä työnantajayhteistyöstä vähintään 2 vuotta viimeisen 5 vuoden aikana.

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja

- kykyä työskennellä tavoitteellisesti sekä itsenäisesti että verkostoissa

- B-ajokorttia ja mahdollisuutta oman auton käyttöön


Tarjoamme:

- arvopohjaisen ja ihmisläheisen työyhteisön, josta löytyy monipuolista osaamista ja yhteistyötä

- työssä kehittymistä, koulutusmahdollisuuksia ja työhyvinvointia ylläpitävää toimintaa


Työsuhde on osa-aikainen (60% työaika) ja määräaikainen maaliskuun 2027 loppuun saakka ja siinä noudatetaan 3 kuukauden koeaikaa. Työaika on 23 h /viikko. Työ alkaa heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Kuopion alueelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Kuopion alueelle. Aloitus on mahdollisimman pian, joten toivomme hakemustasi pikaisesti.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


**Edellytämme sinulta**

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti


Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi.

Er du serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt? Vi søger lige nu servicemedarbejder til rengøring hos to af vores kunder i Helsingør.

 

Som vores nye kollega vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være kontorrengøring og øvrige faciliteter. Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en positiv indstilling, er omhyggelig og ønsker at levere en god service.

Din oplæring vil bestå af sidemandsoplæring, hvor du grundigt bliver introduceret til arbejdsopgaverne og de enkelte lokationer. Efter oplæringsperioden vil du arbejde selvstændigt med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver.

 

Arbejdstider

På den ene lokation udføres rengøringen uden for kundens normale arbejdstid. Arbejdet skal derfor enten være afsluttet inden kl. 08.00 eller påbegyndes efter kl. 16.00.

  • 4,75 timer ugentligt

  • Fleksibel arbejdstid inden for de angivne rammer

Den anden lokation er døgnåben, og rengøringen kan udføres på det tidspunkt, der passer bedst. Der er afsat 30 minutter dagligt, svarende til 2,5 timer ugentligt.

For at kunne arbejde på lokationen er det et krav, at du gennemfører kurset "Pas på banen". Kurset kan gennemføres på én dag og kræver, at du kan forstå dansk eller engelsk.

Kurset består af:

  • En online del på cirka 1 time

  • En fysisk undervisningsdag hos Banedanmark i Ringsted

 

Skab værdi med din service

Vi ønsker at levere den bedste service til vores kunder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og fokuseret på kvalitet i dit arbejde.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, gerne kontorrengøring, men det er ikke et krav

  • Er serviceminded, hjælpsom og positiv

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Har sans for detaljen og leverer et højt kvalitetsniveau

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Er villig til at gennemføre "Pas på banen"-kurset

 

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaverne

  • Selvstændigt arbejde med fleksible arbejdstider

  • Arbejdstøj og nødvendige arbejdsredskaber

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og god service

 

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og eventuelt en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket "Ansøg nu" senest d. 23. oktober 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Service Manager Nedzhati Nizamiev Hasanov på mail: nedzhati.hasanov@dk.issworld.com 

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør til kørsel med transportsneglemaskine
jobs.description:
Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør søges til opstilling og kørsel med transportsneglemaskine.
Der findes kun én maskine til dette formål i Nordeuropa og du skal lære at betjene, opstille og fremstille sneglespiraler til vores egen produktion og salg.

Du vil blive oplært af folk med flere års erfaring og undervejs lære at svejse, bruge skærebrænder, vinkelsliber og flere andre smedemæssige opgaver. Det tager ca. 1-2 år at bliver rigtig dygtigt til at betjene maskinen og der vil være meget manuelt smede- og opstilling og vedligeholdelses arbejde, hvor du bliver sort på hænderne.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har tålmodighed og gåpåmod også selvom arbejdet driller og ikke lykkedes første gang. (Vigtigt!)

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og har en positiv indstilling til teamwork.

  • Du er klar på at arbejde i et lille sammensluttet team med erfarne og gode kollegaer, hvor der er mulighed for at få råd, hjælp og vejledning i forhold til dine opgaver og udarbejdelse af transportsnegle.

  • Arbejdet kan til tider kræve god fysik.

  • Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Mulighed for at lære en helt speciel niché inden for smedefaget som kun få i verden er gode til.

  • Mulighed for gode lønvilkår som ufaglært.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdstid.

  • Løn der matcher dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter samarbejde og godt kollegaskab højt.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og specialisering inden for transportsnegle.

  • Mulighed for at deltage i spændende fremtidige projekter og udvikling af maskiner inden for udarbejdelse af snegle.

Arbejdstider:
Mandag til onsdag kl. 7.00-15.30, torsdag 7.00-14.45, fredag 07.00-14.30

Om Arni Maskinfabrik.

Lille familievirksomhed med 8 ansatte placeret ved Eskilstrup på Falster. 
Vores speciale er Transportsnegle, udarbejdelse af sneglevindinger og profilvalsning.
Besøg gerne vores hjemmeside eller Facebook for at se eksempler på vores projekter.
https://arni.dk/
https://www.facebook.com/ArniMaskinfabrik

Virksomheden fyldte 90 år i 2025 og gennemgår i disse år en opdatering hvad angår lokaler og maskiner.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Capabilities
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has been at the cutting edge of AI since before ChatGPT launched. The job of the Model Capabilities team is to keep us there. We own the model layer of Notion AI: integrating frontier models as they ship, keeping inference reliable and economical at scale, and building new capabilities that other teams take advantage of.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Bring new frontier models into production quickly, making them available for our users and our engineers.

 - Make inference reliable: better error categorization, self-healing retries, and cross-provider failover.

 - Own observability for the model layer, driving down both time to detection and time to fix.

 - Build new model-level capabilities and help product teams adopt them.

 - Act as connective tissue across Notion's AI teams: find the gaps, unblock people, and make sure fixes land with the right owner.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Comfort with a moving frontier: The model landscape changes monthly. You keep up with it, form your own view of what's real, and stay pragmatic about what's worth adopting now.

 - AI fluency as a practitioner: You use AI tools seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

 - Production AI systems experience: You've built and operated systems on top of LLM APIs, not just prototyped with them. You understand token economics, streaming, tool calling, context limits, and how each of these fails in production.

 - Measurement before conviction: You don't ship a prompt or model change on vibes. You define what "better" means, build or use the evaluation to test it, and are willing to be proven wrong by your own data.

 - Cost and performance instincts: You treat latency and dollars as product qualities, not afterthoughts, and you can reason about the tradeoff between them and output quality.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 – $300,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.description:
Senior PM Consultant – Fund Migration

We are looking for a Senior Fund Migration Consultant with a strong track record of delivering complex fund migration programmes end to end, from initial scoping through to post-migration stabilisation, across the full spectrum of asset servicing functions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex fund migration programmes, covering initial scoping, planning, execution, conversion, operational readiness, and post-migration stabilisation.
• Act as the primary project contact for clients, fund management companies, custodians, transfer agents, administrators, portfolio managers, brokers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, decision-making, and escalation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Define and maintain detailed project plans, migration roadmaps, wave plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, runbooks, stakeholder maps, governance materials, and status reporting dashboards.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams across fund administration, transfer agency, custody, middle office, fund accounting, client service, legal, compliance, technology, and operations to deliver against agreed scope, time, cost, and quality objectives.
• Oversee key migration activities including data readiness, data validation, file delivery, reconciliation, operating model design, service model changes, testing, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
• Chair working groups, steering committees, and governance forums, providing concise updates, recommendations, and decision papers to senior stakeholders.
• Identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues relating to data quality, system functionality, resource availability, client dependencies, regulatory constraints, and project scope.
• Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across migration methodology, documentation, controls, and reusable delivery frameworks.
• Support Client Service Delivery Managers in identifying service model impacts and ensuring changes are captured appropriately in service level agreements and handover documentation.

Requirements

• 5 to 10 years of consulting or project delivery experience within financial services, asset servicing, fund administration, or investment management.
• Demonstrable track record of delivering large and complex fund migration programmes as a consultant, including administrator transitions, fund conversions, launches, mergers, or liquidations.
• Strong understanding of investment funds and asset servicing operating models: fund administration, transfer agency, custody, middle office, fund accounting, and client service processes.
• Proven experience managing migration plans, conversion events, data validation, reconciliations, testing, cutover readiness, and post-implementation stabilisation.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, challenge, and build trusted relationships with senior clients, internal partners, and external service providers.
• Strong governance discipline, including experience preparing executive-level status reporting, steering committee materials, RAID logs, project plans, runbooks, and decision papers.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, competing priorities, and dependencies while maintaining delivery discipline and attention to detail under pressure.
• Fluent in English, mandatory; French and/or German would be an important advantage.
• Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent) is a valued plus.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support

• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.

2. Corporate, M&A and governance

• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.

3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation

• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.

4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance

• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.

5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions

• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures.

6. Commercial and employment

• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):

• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.
• Tax, KYC/AML and sanctions experience in a regulated or high risk environment.
• Experience advising founders, C level executives and Boards in a venture backed, high growth environment.
• English at level C (native/bilingual/proficient user).

The following are advantages (nice to haves):

• Postgraduate business qualification (MBA or equivalent).
• Formal training or certification in AI
• Recognised corporate governance certification (e.g. ILA CGO).
• Qualification or formal training in international taxation and in corporate compliance.
• Experience of a Luxembourg holding structure and of Luxembourg corporate and employment law.
• Additional languages, in particular Spanish, French, Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish.
• Prior experience in a matrix organisation or in the country or regional unit of a multinational group.

4 Personal attributes

• Commercial and pragmatic. Comfortable taking a risk-based position and defending it to the Board.
• Comfortable operating hands on in a lean team while also delegating and developing others.
• Able to work across cultures and time zones, and to hold credibility with founders, investors, regulators and counterparties.
• Willing to work in a business whose content categories include adult material.

5 Terms

• Contract: permanent (contrat à durée indéterminée), governed by Luxembourg law.
• Working time: full time, 40 hours per week, flexible arrangement.
• Place of work: [LuxCo address], Luxembourg, with hybrid working and regular travel, principally to London.
• Remuneration: gross annual salary between EUR 150,000 and EUR 250,000.
• Start date: as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie (m/f)
jobs.description:
Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels
Home Office Oui

Votre job en bref

Au sein de la Digital Transformation Factory Vie, vous portez la vision technique des solutions digitales du domaine Vie et accompagnez l'équipe dans la conception, le développement et l'exploitation de solutions robustes, sécurisées, simples et maintenables.
En tant que point de référence technique, vous veillez à la cohérence des choix réalisés avec les besoins métier, l'écosystème IT, les standards de l'entreprise et les principes d'architecture. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, les Business Analysts, le Product Owner, les architectes et les équipes d'exploitation, tout en conservant une dimension opérationnelle avec environ 50 % de votre activité consacrée au développement, selon les priorités de l'équipe.

Ce qui vous attend

Type de contrat : CDI
Type d'emploi : temps plein

• Vision et architecture : définir les orientations techniques locales en cohérence avec l'architecture d'entreprise et les architectes solution, promouvoir des solutions simples et maintenables, et garantir la cohérence entre les frontends Angular, les services REST backend .NET, les microservices de support et les échanges Kafka.
• Analyser en amont les impacts, dépendances et risques techniques, documenter les décisions structurantes et contribuer à la roadmap technique.
• Consulter les architectes et débattre avec eux de toute décision ayant un impact sur plusieurs applications ou équipes.
• Qualité logicielle : garantir la qualité des développements, la conformité aux standards techniques et la maîtrise de la dette technique ; intégrer les risques techniques et accompagner leur résolution.
• Réaliser des revues de code, prototypes et preuves de concept, intervenir sur les développements structurants ou complexes, veiller au respect des quality gates SonarCloud et promouvoir les tests automatisés.
• Accompagnement de l'équipe : faire progresser les membres sur les pratiques de développement et DevOps, contribuer au recrutement et à la montée en compétence, accompagner les choix de conception et d'implémentation, faciliter les décisions collectives et arbitrer lorsque nécessaire.
• Industrialisation : assurer une veille technologique, maintenir et améliorer les pipelines d'intégration continue dans Azure DevOps Services et collaborer sur les processus de déploiement continu gérés dans Jenkins.
• Garantir un niveau d'observabilité adapté grâce aux logs, métriques, tableaux de bord et alertes, et participer aux mises en production nécessitant l'intervention de l'équipe technique.

Ce que nous attendons

• Diplôme supérieur en informatique ou en ingénierie logicielle.
• Expérience significative en développement logiciel dans l'écosystème .NET et avec Angular, ainsi que dans un rôle de point de référence ou de leadership technique incluant l'accompagnement de développeurs.
• Très bonne maîtrise de C#, de .NET et de son écosystème, notamment EF Core et SQL Server, idéalement sur une version récente telle que .NET 10.
• Très bonne maîtrise d'Angular et de TypeScript.
• Bonne connaissance de Git, des revues de code et des stratégies de gestion des branches, notamment Gitflow.
• Expérience dans la conception d'API, de microservices, d'architectures distribuées et de solutions de messaging avec Kafka.
• Maîtrise des enjeux de performance, de scalabilité, de résilience applicative, de sécurité et d'observabilité.
• Expérience d'Azure DevOps Services pour l'intégration continue et connaissance de Jenkins pour le déploiement.
• Leadership technique, pragmatisme, autonomie, écoute et esprit d'équipe ; capacité à communiquer, coacher, décider et gérer plusieurs priorités sans posture autoritaire.
• Français et anglais courants ; l'allemand et le luxembourgeois constituent des atouts.
• Une expérience dans les secteurs financier, assurantiel ou de la gestion de patrimoine constitue un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/ICA PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA - AREA MANAGER
jobs.description:
ZIEGLER je proizvođač vatrogasnih vozila i opreme s tradicijom duljom od 130 godina. ZIEGLER Grupa zapošljava više od 1.200 djelatnika diljem svijeta, posluje na 9 proizvodnih lokacija te godišnje proizvede više od 900 vozila. Dio je velike globalne grupacije CIMC, vodećeg svjetskog dobavljača logističke i energetske opreme. ZIEGLER d.o.o. posluje u Hrvatskoj od 2000. godine te djeluje na dvije proizvodne lokacije – u Zagrebu i Kutini. Zbog razvoja našeg tima i daljnjeg širenja prisutnosti na tržištu tražimo: VODITELJA/ICU PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA – 1 izvršitelj – Mjesto rada: Zagreb ili Kutina Idealan kandidat:

  • VŠS ili VSS ekonomskog, poslovnog, tehničkog ili srodnog usmjerenja
  • Najmanje 1 godina iskustva u prodaji, razvoju poslovanja ili upravljanju ključnim kupcima
  • Izražene komunikacijske, pregovaračke i interpersonalne vještine
  • Dokazan pristup usmjeren na kupca, uz fokus na ostvarivanje prodajnih ciljeva i poslovnih rezultata
  • Aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno B2 razina)

  • Spremnost na putovanja unutar dodijeljene regije
  • Interes za automobilsku i vatrogasnu industriju
Prednost imaju kandidati koji imaju:
  • Iskustvo u prodaji u automobilskoj, vatrogasnoj ili srodnoj industriji
  • Poznavanje postupaka javne nabave i natječajne dokumentacije
  • Iskustvo rada u ERP sustavima
  • Poznavanje dodatnih regionalnih jezika
Opis poslova:
  • Razvijanje i održavanje poslovnih odnosa s postojećim i potencijalnim kupcima na dodijeljenom području
  • Prepoznavanje novih poslovnih prilika i aktivno širenje tržišne prisutnosti tvrtke
  • Upravljanje cjelokupnim prodajnim procesom – od prvog kontakta s kupcem do sklapanja ugovora

  • Posjeti kupcima, održavanje prezentacija, demonstracija proizvoda i vođenje pregovora
  • Praćenje tržišnih trendova, aktivnosti konkurencije i potreba kupaca te redovito izvještavanje uprave
  • Ostvarivanje dogovorenih prodajnih ciljeva i doprinos rastu poslovanja tvrtke
  • Izrada prodajnih izvještaja, prognoza i ostale povezane dokumentacije
  • Predstavljanje tvrtke na stručnim događanjima, sajmovima i konferencijama
Nudimo:
  • Rad u dinamičnom međunarodnom okruženju
  • Priliku za rad u rastućoj industriji
  • Profesionalni razvoj uz podršku iskusnog tima
  • Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zaposlenja na neodređeno vrijeme

Ako ste zainteresirani za ovu poziciju, pošaljite svoj životopis i motivacijsko pismo na e-mail posao@ziegler.hr ili ih dostavite osobno u Odjel ljudskih resursa najkasnije do 22.10.2026. ZIEGLER is a manufacturer of firefighting vehicles and equipment with a tradition of over 130 years. The ZIEGLER Group employs more than 1,200 people worldwide, operates at 9 production locations, and produces over 900 vehicles annually. It is part of the large global CIMC group, a leading world supplier of logistics and energy equipment. ZIEGLER d.o.o. has been operating in Croatia since 2000, with two production locations – in Zagreb and Kutina. Due to the growth of our team and further expansion of our market presence, we are looking for: AREA MANAGER - 1 position - Work location: Zagreb or Kutina

Ideal candidate:

  • University or higher vocational degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (VŠS/VSS)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in sales, business development, or account management
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Proven customer-oriented approach with a focus on achieving sales targets and business objectives
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken (minimum B2 level)
  • Highly organized, proactive, and results-driven
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned region
  • Strong interest in the automotive and firefighting industries

Advantage:

  • Knowledge of public procurement and tender procedures
  • Experience working with ERP systems
  • Knowledge of additional regional languages

Job description:

  • Developing and maintaining business relationships with existing and potential customers within the assigned territory
  • Identifying new business opportunities and actively expanding the company's market presence
  • Managing the complete sales process, from initial customer contact to contract signing
  • Preparing commercial offers, quotations, and tender documentation in cooperation with internal departments
  • Participating in public procurement procedures and coordinating the preparation of bids
  • Conducting customer visits, presentations, product demonstrations, and negotiations
  • Monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, and providing regular feedback to management
  • Achieving agreed sales targets and contributing to the company's growth objectives
  • Preparing sales reports, forecasts, and other related documentation
  • Representing the company at industry events, trade fairs, and professional conferences

We offer:

  • Work in dynamic international environment
  • Opportunity to work in a growing industry
  • Professional development within an experienced team
  • Fixed-term employment contract with possibility to extend to permanent duration

If you are interested in this position, please send your CV and Cover letter via e-mail to posao@ziegler.hr or submit to HR in person until 22.10.2026.

  • Provođenje mjera integriranih sustava upravljanja Društva
  • Primjena pravila ZNR i ZOP
  • Održavanje čistoće na svom radnom mjestu, čišćenje postrojenja
  • Ostali poslovi po nalogu neposrednog rukovoditelja, sukladno potrebama posla, osposobljenosti i osobnim radnim mogućnostima.

Uvjet:

  • SSS – strojarski, elektrotehnički ili kemijsko tehnološki smjer
  • poželjno radno iskustvo u struci.

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • izražene organizacijske vještine
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • odgovornost i pouzdanost.

Nudimo Vam:

  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad 6 mjeseci
  • naknadu troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla
  • naknadu za prehranu
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnica) sukladno odrebama Kolektivnog ugovora i Odlukama Uprave
  • priliku za rad na raznovrsnim i zanimljivim radnim zadacima u dinamičnom poslovnom okruženju
  • mogućnosti za učenje na radnom mjestu i izvan njega.

Ako ste u navedenom radnom mjestu prepoznali izazov za svoju karijeru i udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, prijavite se na email adresu: karijera@petrokemija.hr najkasnije do 29.9.2026. godine.

Razmatrane će biti samo pravovremene i potpune prijave (životopis i dokazi o ispunjenju uvjeta) pristigle pristigle na naznačenu e-adresu.

U prijavi obavezno naznačiti radno mjesto za koje se prijavljujete.

Više o nama saznajte na www.petrokemija.hr

jobs.title: RADNIK/RADNICA U ODRŽAVANJU PROČISTAČA OTPADNIH VODA
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
-Obavlja sve poslove na održavanju Uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda te ostale poslove vezane uz montažu i održavanje opreme, uočava nepravilnosti i prijavljuje ih rukovoditelju OJ u podružnici i direktoru podružnice ili voditelju odjela laboratorijskih poslova
- Održava čistoću pogonske zgrade i okoliša
- Vodi evidenciju o protocima izlaznih voda s UPOV-a
- Obavlja podmazivanje, remonte, izmjene pumpi,
- Provodi uzorkovanje otpadnih voda (UPOV i kontrola kanal. mreže) i aktivnog mulja,
- Otprema uzorke voda u ovlaštene zavode za analizu,
- Obavlja poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja OJ u podružnici i direktora podružnice te voditelja internog laboratorija i druge poslove u okviru svoje stručne spreme,
- Odgovoran je za uredno i pravovremeno obavljanje poslova iz svog djelokruga rada,
- Obavlja i ostale poslove u okviru svoje struke i stručnog znanja, a prema nalogu rukovoditelja OJ u podružnici i direktora podružnice te voditelja internog laboratorija,
- Odgovara za svoj rad predradniku na UPOV-u, rukovoditelju OJ u podružnici i direktoru podružnice
  
Stručni uvjeti: KV/SSS tehničkog smjera, vozački ispit, poznavanje rada na računalu.
Na oglas se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad.
  
U prijavi na oglas potrebno je navesti osobne podatke podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te po mogućnosti e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje.
Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.
Uz prijavu, kandidati  su dužni priložiti:
•životopis
•dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslika / scan osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice)
•presliku / scan svjedodžbe,
•vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
  
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici ili scanu, a prije izbora kandidat/kinja će predočiti izvornik.
Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se do 30. rujna 2026. godine na adresu VODNE USLUGE d.o.o., Bjelovar, Ferde Rusana 21, s naznakom - „prijava na oglas“ ili e-mailom na adresu: pisarnica@vodneusluge-bj.hr
Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u oglasu.
Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovremenu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz oglasa, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na oglas.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan/na je u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), dužan/a se u prijavi na oglas pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.  Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu je dužan osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.
Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz oglasa bit će proveden usmeni razgovor, a o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem kontakt broja telefona odnosno mobitela ili e-mail adrese iz prijave.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a nije pristupio/ila usmenom razgovoru više se ne smatra kandidatom/kinjom u postupku.
O rezultatima oglasa kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem.    
  
VODNE USLUGE d.o.o. pridržavaju pravo poništiti ovaj natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku, bez posebnog obrazloženja.

jobs.title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga
