jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
C-27001 HEAD OF INTERNAL AUDIT
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

Context

As the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead, structure and continuously develop LIST's Internal Audit Service, an independent and objective assurance and advisory function serving the Board of Directors through the Finance and Audit Committee.
The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.

In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. The role also leads specific assurance, advisory and investigation assignments and ensures that Internal Audit methodologies, policies, processes and the Internal Audit Charter remain robust and aligned with professional internal audit standards.

Working closely with the Board of Directors, the Finance and Audit Committee, the CEO, Executive Management, Risk Management, external auditors and auditees, you will provide clear insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making while safeguarding the independence, objectivity and credibility of the function.

Your team and environment

Your team - 3 people

• Head of Internal Audit - 1 | leadership of the function, audit strategy, governance and stakeholder engagement
• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activities

The Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.
You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. For administrative and day-to-day matters, you will report to the CEO.

Description

You will be mainly responsible for:

Internal Audit Leadership & Governance

• Lead and develop the Internal Audit Service, setting a high standard for performance, integrity, objectivity, confidentiality and competence
• Define and implement the internal audit strategy in alignment with LIST's goals and objectives
• Develop, maintain and continuously improve the Internal Audit Charter, policies, methodologies, processes and procedures
• Act as a trusted and independent reference for the Board of Directors, Finance and Audit Committee, CEO and Executive Management on governance, risk and internal control matters

Risk-Based Audit Planning & Delivery

• Identify and prioritise LIST's key risk areas and prepare the annual risk-based internal audit plan for validation by the Finance and Audit Committee and approval by the Board of Directors
• Oversee and conduct assurance, advisory and investigation assignments, including complex and specific missions, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards
• Adapt the audit plan and mission work programmes when emerging events or risks require timely action
• Ensure audit work is appropriately planned, documented, reviewed and archived, and that audit conclusions are supported by robust evidence

Governance, Risk, Internal Control & Compliance

• Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control systems and procedures, with a focus on preventing or detecting risks, losses, errors and fraud
• Coordinate Internal Audit activities with Risk Management and other assurance providers where appropriate, while preserving independence and avoiding duplication
• Escalate significant deficiencies, fraud concerns and other material issues to the appropriate governance bodies and management

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

• Review and validate internal audit reports and ensure recommendations are clear, concise, operational and improvement-oriented
• Present audit results, insights and recommendations to auditees, Executive Management, the Finance and Audit Committee and the Board of Directors
• Build constructive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders while maintaining the independence and objectivity required of the function

Follow-up, Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

• Lead the follow-up of agreed actions and report progress to the CEO, Finance and Audit Committee and Board of Directors, ensuring that actions are implemented or that residual risk is formally accepted by management
• Establish and maintain a quality assurance and improvement programme for Internal Audit
• Monitor developments in governance, risk management and internal audit practices, including relevant professional standards, and translate them into continuous improvement of the function

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Lead, coach and develop the Internal Audit team, supporting colleagues in complex assignments and helping remove obstacles to successful audit delivery
• Foster continuous learning and rapid familiarisation with audited subjects across a broad and evolving organisational environment
• Promote LIST's mission, values, internal codes and rules within the Internal Audit Service

Background & experience

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Audit, Internal Control, Risk Management or a similar field.
• Extensive experience in internal and/or external audit, with demonstrated exposure to complex assurance, advisory and investigation assignments.

jobs.description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI d.d. dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedna od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka za pripremu smjene Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:
  • Zaduženje za održavanje strojeva linije obrade duhana i otklanjanje pronađenih nedostataka najranije moguće.
  • Dnevno kontrolira čišćenje, podmazivanje, kontrole curenja ulja na svim strojevima.
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.
  • Dnevna kontrola i otklanjanje kvarova na sustavu linija otprašivanja.
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.
  • Radi na smanjenju potrošnje energije.
  • Izrada dijelova u skladu sa dostavljenim specifikacijama.
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.
  • Sudjeluje u instalaciji proizvodne opreme i strojeva.
  • Nadzire rad opreme i strojeva, brine o hidraulučnim platformama i pometačima podova u pogonu.
  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.
  • Po potrebi radi u drugim sektorima, sva područja obrade duhana (pakiranje, sušenje, biranje, ulaz, itd.), na sjetvi plitica, otkupu duhana.
  • Ostali zadaci u skladu s naravi i vrstom rada po nalogu neposredno nadređenog.
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema.
  • Zahtijevana struka: tehnička struke (elektro, strojarska).
  • Osnovno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Osnovno znanje rada na računalu: Ms Office.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.
  • Financijske pogodnosti: Božićnica, regres za godišnji odmor, naknada za podmirivanje troškova prehrane, potpora za rođenje djeteta, naknada za troškove prijevoza, itd.
  • Priznanja i nagrade: godišnji bonus, godišnja korekcija plaće, razna nefinacijska nagrađivanja putem nominacija za prepoznavanje truda i postignuća.
  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. jobs.description:

**Gesundheitsberater / Gesundheits-Coach (Quereinstieg)**

Sind Sie bereit für eine sinnstiftende berufliche Neuorientierung? Wir sind zukunftsorientiert im Bereich Healty Longevity (Langes gesundes Leben unterwegs. Hier suchen wir Sie mit Lebenserfahrung, die Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einem gesünderen Leben begleiten möchten. Auch ohne klassische Ausbildung im medizinischen Bereich ermöglichen wir Ihnen einen erfolgreichen Quereinstieg.

**Ihre Aufgaben: Was Sie erwartet**

Kunden/Interessenten Gewinnung Betreuung und Beratung
•     Sie führen Beratungsgespräche mit unseren Interessierten Kundinnen und Kunden (persönlich oder online).
•    Lösungsfindung: Sie unterstützen unsere Klienten dabei, gesundheitliche Ziele zu definieren und im Alltag umzusetzen (z.B. in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung und Stressmanagement).
•    Begleitung: Sie fungieren als kontinuierlicher Ansprechpartner/in und motivieren unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf ihrem Weg.
•    Administration: Sie erfassen die Beratungsgespräche und verwalten diese.
Ihr Profil: Was Sie mitbringen
•    Berufserfahrung: Sie haben bereits Berufserfahrung in einem anderen Tätigkeitsfeld gesammelt (z.B. aus Kundendienst, HR, Vertrieb, Pädagogik, Gastronomie oder Fitness).
•    Lebenskompetenz: Sie verfügen über eine hohe soziale Kompetenz, Empathie und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Gesundheitsthemen.
•    Kommunikationstalent: Sie sind ein starker Kommunikator, der gut zuhören kann und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklärt.
•    Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute mündliche Kenntnisse Schweizerdeutsch(weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).
•    Lernbereitschaft: Sie haben Freude daran, sich neues Fachwissen im Bereich Gesundheit und Prävention anzueignen.

**Unser Angebot: Was wir Ihnen bieten**
•    Strukturierter Quereinstieg: Ein umfassendes Einarbeitungsprogramm inkl. Mentoring.
•    Aus- und Weiterbildung: Interne berufsbegleitende zum zertifizierten Healthy Longevity Coach HLV Akad,).
•    Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Ein Job, bei dem die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden von Menschen im Mittelpunkt stehen.
•    Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice
•    Faire Entlöhnung: Ein attraktives Gehaltspacket sowie gute Sozialleistungen.

jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Søgaards Bryghus søger en General Manager til familiedrevet bryghus, gastropub, café og restaurant

Vi søger en empatisk leder der er nærværende og som kan tage ansvar for den daglige drift og samtidig være med til at skabe struktur og retning for virksomheden og sammen føre os ind i næste kapitel.

Som General Manager bliver du den daglige ansvarlige for ledelse og drift og for at udvikle Bryghuset i samarbejde med virksomhedens ejere.

Vi ønsker er synlig leder, som medarbejderne kan gå til, og dermed være med til at skabe en stærk kultur, hvor medarbejderne trives, tager ansvar og sammen skaber gode oplevelser for vores gæster.

Dine primære ansvarsområder :

●                             Overordnet ansvar for den daglige drift af hele Bryghuset

●                             Bryghusets økonomi, omsætning og specifikke nøgletal og opfølgning ift. afvigelser

●                             Ledelse, motivation og udvikling af medarbejdere på alle niveauer

●                             Ansvar for bemanding, vagtplanlægning, on-boarding og udvikling af medarbejdere

●                             Sikre høj kvalitet i service- og arbejdskultur i hverdagen, gode gæsteoplevelse og drift

●                             Håndtering af udfordringer som naturligt opstår i en travl hverdag

●                             Tæt samarbejde med lederne og virksomhedens ejere

●                             Udvikling af koncepter, arrangementer og forretningen i samarbejde med alle interessenter

Vores forventninger til den rette profil:

●                             Solid erfaring fra restaurant-, hotel-, bar- eller oplevelsesbranchen, samt erfaring med personaleledelse og kommunikation

●                             Synlig, nærværende og engageret i hverdagen

●                             Kan motivere og engagere forskellige typer medarbejdere

●                             Tør træffe beslutninger og tage ansvar

●                             Er struktureret og har styr på detaljerne uden at miste overblikket

●                             Har kommerciel forståelse og blik for en sund forretning                               

●                             Forstår, at god ledelse handler om mennesker, gæster og resultater,
få alle medarbejdere med dig

●                             Du befinder der godt både med at lede, men også med ”hands on” når situation kræver





Søgaards Bryghus tilbyder:

●                             En central lederrolle i en veletableret virksomhed

●                             Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på ledelse, kultur og udvikling

●                             Ansvar og indflydelse på den daglige drift

●                             Tæt samarbejde med ejerne og lederne på Bryghuset

●                             En arbejdsplads med masser af liv, personlighed og gæstekontakt

●                             En stor og alsidig medarbejdergruppe

●                             En attraktiv løn, som matcher dine kvalifikationer og huset.
Eventuel med mulighed for bonusordning.

Som Generel Manager vil du komme tæt på både gæster, medarbejdere og alle i den daglige drift. Nogle dage handler om personaleledelse og planlægning. Andre om økonomi og udvikling. Og på travle dage skal du være klar til at træde til og hjælpe med at få huset godt igennem dagen og sikre højt serviceniveau.

Dine arbejdstider være meget vekslende og du tilpasser dem naturligt til hele huset, så du har fingeren på pulsen, hvilket betyder din synlighed når huset er fuldt er afgørende vigtigt for stedet. Arbejdstiderne ligger alle dage og indenfor husets åbningstider.

Vi forventer, at du har lyst til at være en aktiv del af huset, samtidig med at du kan løfte blikket og arbejde strategisk med, hvor vi skal hen.

 

Send os en ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din ledererfaring og hvorfor du kunne se dig selv stå i spidsen for vores forretning. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

Ansøgningsfrist: 15/10-26

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Kontakt: Lisa Søgaard - Søgaards Bryghus Aps. Telefon: 51520825

Mail:

lisa@sbryghus.dk

jobs.title: Project Coordinator in Product and Supply
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator – Product & Supply

Do you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and coordinating projects across different teams? Are you highly organized, analytical, and motivated by making operations run more efficiently? Then you might be our new Project Coordinator.

As Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in driving smaller projects and continuous process improvements within our Product & Supply organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across different departments to map, optimize, and maintain operational processes while ensuring consistency and efficiency throughout the supply chain.

Your responsibilities

As our new Project Coordinator, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate smaller internal projects within the Product & Supply organization

  • Drive updates and continuous improvements to operational processes and procedures

  • Map, document, and analyze current supply chain processes

  • Develop, align, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments

  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather input and ensure alignment

  • Support timely execution of both operational tasks and longer-term initiatives

  • Facilitate recurring process reviews and operational performance updates

  • Participate in process discovery and optimization workshops

  • Gather and analyze operational data to support reporting and decision-making

jobs.title: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

  • Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

  • Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

  • Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

  • Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

  • A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

  • Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

  • A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

  • The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Prior research and publication experience.

  • Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

  • Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

  • Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

  • Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

  • A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

  • The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

  • Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

  • Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.

jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

  • Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

  • Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

  • Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

  • Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

  • Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

  • Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

  • Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

  • Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

  • Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

  • Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

  • Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

  • Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

  • Demonstrated passion for driving positive change for customers and their businesses, coupled with a willingness to travel both professionally and personally.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.

  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere

  • Work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

  • Experience a dynamic workplace where team spirit, joy, and productivity go hand in hand.

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.

  • A collaborative and inclusive work culture.

Workplace

Work from either our Copenhagen or Aalborg offices and have the chance to visit our Brisbane location. Join our global team spanning Denmark, Sweden, India, the US, and Australia.

How to Apply

For more details, please contact our People and Culture Team at hr@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
jobs.description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΣΗΣ
jobs.description: ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ, ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΣΚΥΡΟΔΕΤΗΣΕΙΣ. ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ, ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ. ΚΟΠΗ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΞΥΛΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΛΟΥΨΗ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΑΠΟΞΗΛΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΜΑΚΡΥΝΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟ. ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΑΤΙΘΕΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΠΡΟΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗΣ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΣΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΣΙΔΕΡΑΣ
jobs.description: ΥΠΟΒΟΗΘΗΣΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ, ΚΟΠΗ, ΛΕΙΑΝΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Prepare the offers and proposals in collaboration with Relationship Managers and regularly attend to those proposals pitchs.
Identify possible process quick wins and work proactively with the Management Team to improve the processes of the daily activities.
Contribute to overall onboarding of new joiners within the team.
Be potentially interested in growing into a Relationship Manager position in the coming years.

Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Key objectives of the role:

• Lead the Sales & Structuring function within CIB Financial Markets, providing strategic direction, team leadership, and oversight of business performance.
• Develop, manage, and distribute Financial Markets solutions, including structured products and OTC derivatives, ensuring innovative, client-centric offerings that meet market trends, risk standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Partner with business lines across the bank to deliver tailored investment solutions, provide product expertise and education, and support Advisors, Relationship Managers, and DPM teams in serving clients.
• Drive product governance and business development, overseeing product approval, issuance programs, process enhancements, counterparty relationships, and the expansion of sales and distribution capabilities.
• Ensure compliance and stakeholder alignment, working closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, regulators, counterparties, and other key stakeholders to maintain a robust and compliant operating framework.

Deliverables and key activities:

1. Leadership & Team Management

• Lead the Sales & Structuring function, setting strategic priorities, budgets, KPIs, and performance objectives.
• Develop the team as the bank's center of expertise for Financial Markets, Structured Products, and OTC Derivatives.

2. Business Strategy & Governance

• Define and execute the Sales & Structuring strategy, enhancing product distribution, sales processes, and client solutions.
• Coordinate with Relationship Managers, Advisory, DPM, and Business Development teams to implement strategy across the bank and international locations.
• Chair relevant committees and contribute to governance forums to align product development with client needs and business objectives.

3. Product Solutions & Distribution

• Oversee the development, approval, and management of structured products and derivative solutions for internal and external clients.
• Ensure offerings remain innovative, compliant, and aligned with client needs and the bank's strategy.
• Manage strategic partnerships, distribution agreements, issuance programs, and product distribution channels.

4. Stakeholder & Market Engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, counterparties, partners, and internal stakeholders.
• Promote product adoption, identify market opportunities and trends, and support business growth across the bank.
• Represent the bank with industry participants, partners, and regulators.

Your skills:

• Minimum 12 years of experience in Investment Banking, Financial Markets, Asset Management, and/or Private Banking.
• Strong hands-on experience with complex investment products, risk management, structuring, trading, and sales.
• Demonstrated people management and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop multidisciplinary teams.
• Deep expertise in Financial Markets, with a focus on the sales of financial market instruments and the structuring of structured products and derivatives (vanilla and exotic), encompassing pricing and issuance activities, and supported by a strong understanding of Risk, Regulatory, Legal and Compliance requirements.
• Solid understanding of balance sheet management, sensitivities, and derivative pricing models.
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field with a strong quantitative focus (MBA or equivalent preferred).
• Fluent in English; French and German are considered an asset.
• Knowledge of VBA, Python, C++, or other programming languages is a plus.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Transport manager (2 years contract)

• Zone PED 4801 Rodange, 4801 Rodange, Luxembourg
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 73,710 - EUR 117,936 - yearly

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Compensation & Benefits: Benefit from a labor agreement with salary increases, a qualified social minimum wage, and automatic salary indexation to inflation. Enjoy a seniority incentive, profit sharing, and a 13th-month salary (with the option to convert it into additional leave).
• Continuous Development: Access extensive training and certification opportunities, local mentorship programs, and leadership development initiatives (including development discussions and Talent Management programs).
• Flexibility & On-site Perks: Embrace flexible work arrangements for white-collar roles. Enjoy a subsidized canteen, an annual gift for employees and children, and a mobile app that centralizes services, benefits, vouchers, and discounts.

To help us process your application quickly, please upload your CV in either PDF or Word format. We also kindly ask that you submit your resume in the same language as this job posting.

Why join Avery Dennison

We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. As part of the Biotechnology Unit, and particularly the Bioformulation Group, you will contribute to the machine learning assisted structure-function study of soluble dietary fibres (galactomannans) isolated from underexplored leguminous seed bioresources in the framework of the ENTANGLE FNR funded project. • Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Corporate
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the Corporate Finance team, you'll own the consolidated view of Notion's financial performance — the corporate model, the monthly close-to-reporting cycle, and the numbers that reach our executive team, Board of Directors, and investors. You'll immediately take ownership of core corporate FP&A workstreams, which include the consolidated P&L forecast, the monthly budget-vs-actual and reforecast cycles, and the planning systems that produce them.

 

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the consolidated corporate model and the monthly reporting cadence — close actuals, budget-vs-actual, and the rolling reforecast — and connect reported performance to the revenue, headcount, and spend drivers behind it

 - Maintain and evolve Notion's planning system, primarily Pigment: maintain the corporate model structure, run the monthly data loads and scenario snapshots, reconcile the P&L, headcount, and departmental views, and build new models and views as the business changes

 - Assist in preparing and delivering presentations that effectively communicate Notion's financial performance and outlook to Notion's executive team, Board of Directors, and investors

 - Raise the quality and scalability of our reporting infrastructure, using AI, automation, and stronger data workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and surface insights faster — challenging existing processes and data inconsistencies that get in the way

 - Work cross-functionally across Accounting, BizTech, People, and our Business Partnership (BP) Finance team to keep source data, mappings, and the chart of accounts aligned as operating complexity grows — tightening the handoffs between close and forecast along the way




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundations Lead)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one—partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability—and align engineers and partner teams around it.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

 - Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

 - Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

 - Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

 - Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

 - Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work—finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions with long-term consequences.

 - Team-building and talent development. You have attracted strong engineers, grown people across career stages, developed technical leaders, and created clarity when expectations or performance needed to change.

 - Hands-on engineering judgment. You stay close to critical systems and designs and know when to prototype, simplify, buy, build, or migrate. You can go deep while preserving ownership for the engineers leading the work.

 - Platform-product thinking. You understand the needs behind partner requests and turn repeated patterns into safe, ergonomic, self-serve capabilities rather than accumulating bespoke solutions.

 - Organizational influence. You create clarity across team boundaries, surface uncomfortable technical or organizational risks early, and help engineers do their best work through strong context, delegation, feedback, and coaching.

 - You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, move faster, and build more creatively.




THE SYSTEMS AND PROBLEMS YOU MAY LEAD

 - Evolving Notion’s data lake toward an S3 + Iceberg lakehouse with stronger governance, discoverability, schema evolution, and lifecycle controls

 - Scaling Kafka and Debezium-based streaming infrastructure that powers real-time product, analytics, and AI use cases

 - Improving Spark and distributed-compute performance, workload isolation, developer experience, and cost efficiency

 - Designing EKM, data residency, and compliant processing capabilities across Notion’s data estate

 - Creating clear platform interfaces and self-serve primitives for Data Engineering, Search, AI, and product teams




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Notion’s data infrastructure is no longer only an internal analytics layer. It increasingly powers customer-facing features, AI systems, enterprise controls, and high-volume product workflows. The team needs a leader who can see across these systems, build the technical leadership and operating culture required for that responsibility, and find the problems that matter before they become roadmap blockers. Success means Data Foundations has a strong, growing team with clear direction and dependable execution—and teams across Notion can build ambitious data-powered products faster without compromising customer trust.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $281,000 - $334,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply.
